Med reminders and history with full offline privacy
 Stay In Control of Your Medications with MedTimer
 MedTimer is an open-source medication reminder app designed to help you manage your medications and pills effectively and with full control of your sensitive data.
 Flexible & Personalized Reminders:
 - Manage unlimited medications with customizable reminders per medication (including simple defaults for daily reminders). - Create flexible reminders with breaks and specific days (e.g. for birth control pills). - Weekend mode: Delay reminders to a defined time on chosen days. - Snooze notifications for later reminders or be reminded repeatedly. - Location-based snooze: be re-notified when arriving home after snoozing. - Add extra doses on the fly. - Create interval based reminders, reminders following each other in intervals or interval reminders constrained with a start and end time per day. - Use alarm type reminders to ensure notification even when the device is set to silent mode.

 Privacy & Offline Accessibility:

izzyondroid:shub39.momentum.name: Momentum: Daily Photo Montage
izzyondroid:shub39.momentum.summary: Turn daily photos into a progress montage. Private, offline, automatic.
izzyondroid:shub39.momentum.description:
Momentum is a privacy-friendly, offline-first way to track your progress and turn everyday photos into a beautiful progress montage — without thinking about storage, editing, or accounts.
 📸 Snap a photo a day Create a project for anything you want to track — fitness, skincare, a beard, a plant, a painting, a trip. Momentum nudges you with a daily reminder so you never miss a day. Add photos from the gallery or take one right in the app with the built-in camera.
 🎬 Make montages in seconds Pick your photos and Momentum renders a smooth montage video for you. No timeline scrubbing, no export menus, no video editor to learn. Adjust frames per image, frames per second, video quality, background color, date style, and text font, then export and share your progress video.
 😊 Auto face stabilization Powered by on-device face detection, Momentum keeps faces aligned and stable across your montage, so the result looks polished even when you were not perfectly framed. Optionally highlight or censor faces with a single tap.
 📅 Calendar and timeline Browse everything you have captured in a beautiful monthly calendar or a linear timeline, mark favorites, and add a comment to any day to remember the context.
 🔔 Reminders that actually work Set a daily reminder time and Momentum will keep you on track. Reminders survive reboots, and tapping a notification jumps straight back into the app.
 🎨 Yours to make it yours Material You dynamic color from your wallpaper, AMOLED dark mode, multiple palette styles, custom fonts, and a full Material 3 Expressive interface that adapts from phones to tablets and foldables.
 🔒 Private by design Everything is processed and stored on your device. No account, no cloud, no tracking, no ads. Momentum is open source and available as a FOSS build with all features unlocked and no in-app purchases.
 💾 Backup and restore Export all of your project data to a single .zip file and import it back whenever you like. Move to a new phone without losing your history.
 Momentum Plus unlocks extra customization (video quality, custom fonts, background colors, AMOLED, custom palettes) and lets you keep as many projects as you want. Every purchase supports independent development.
 Turn a year of ordinary photos into something worth watching. Start your Momentum today.

fdroid:app.matthieu.cairngps.name: CairnGPS
fdroid:app.matthieu.cairngps.summary: Hike tracking, live GNSS satellite view, achievements. Works fully offline
fdroid:app.matthieu.cairngps.description:
CairnGPS turns your phone into a real GNSS receiver.
Watch the satellites that locate you in real time from all constellations on a 3D globe, a sky plot and a detailed list. Record your hikes, drop waypoints, unlock achievements.
The app reads your device's raw GPS through Android's own LocationManager rather than going through Google Play Services. It contains no Google libraries at all, needs no account and no network connection: everything works fully offline, and every position, track and waypoint stays on your phone.
REAL-TIME POSITION
Coordinates in decimal degrees or DMS, geoid-corrected altitude using the EGM96 model, speed in km/h and m/s, horizontal and vertical accuracy with a colour indicator. You always know how much to trust your fix.
FULL SATELLITE VIEW
Every visible satellite listed, constellation by constellation. An azimuth and elevation sky plot. And a custom-built 3D globe showing the real geometry of the constellation above you: you finally see where your GNSS signals are coming from.
COMPASS
Heading dial referenced to magnetic or true north, your choice. Point-to-point navigation with arrow, distance and bearing to any waypoint you pick.
TRACK RECORDING
Start a session and put the phone back in your pocket. Distance covered, average and maximum speed, elevation gain and loss, minimum and maximum altitude.
WAYPOINTS
Mark what matters (water source, campsite, trailhead, etc.) with customizable icons. Every waypoint stays linked to the session it was dropped in.
TRIP LOG
Browse all your past sessions with elevation profile, route trace and full statistics. GPX export so you can open your tracks anywhere.
ACHIEVEMENTS AND LEVELS
Over 25 achievements across families: altitude, from your first summit to Kilimanjaro. Speed. Simultaneous satellites. Total distance. Number of trips. Plus a few special ones: cross the 45th parallel north, get tracked on both sides of the equator, drop a waypoint before 6 a.m. Every achievement earns XP and levels you up, and your personal records carry over from trip to trip.
BUILT FOR THE OUTDOORS
Readable in direct sunlight, light and dark themes, controlled battery use, metric or imperial units, backup and restore of your data.
PLEASE NOTE
CairnGPS is a GNSS tool and a trip log, not a mapping app: it does not display a base map and does not calculate routes. It complements your map app rather than replacing it.
PERMISSIONS
Precise location is required, including in the background while a session is recording, so the app can keep following your route with the screen off. Recording never starts on its own: it begins only on an explicit action, and a persistent notification shows it at all times.

fdroid:com.fpink.capture.name: FPInk
fdroid:com.fpink.capture.summary: Capture handwritten fountain-pen notes, recognized offline by default
fdroid:com.fpink.capture.description:
FPInk captures handwritten fountain-pen notes and turns them into searchable text, while keeping the original ink colour information alongside each note.
Recognition runs entirely on-device with two bundled strategies: Cursive (the default) for handwriting and Printed for printed text. Pick the default in Settings, or choose per photo when using the camera. It currently requires an ARM64 device. Optional cloud-based recognition services may be available in privately built variants of this app, but they are never enabled in this build and would require explicit selection before ever being used.
After a photo is recognized, FPInk opens a review screen listing every generated paragraph as a separate note. Correct any transcription in place, then save the changes; leaving the screen with unsaved corrections asks for confirmation first, and declining to save keeps the notes you already captured.
From the notes list you can press and hold a note to start selecting, tap rows or checkboxes to change the selection, or use "Select all" to include every note, even ones off screen. Choose "Delete selected" and confirm once to permanently remove the selection; a shared source photo is kept until every note that uses it has been deleted.
FPInk's original source code is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 only (GPL-3.0-only). Third-party dependencies and bundled assets retain their own licenses.

fdroid:com.github.ktsr42.rsyncserver.name: Rsync Server
fdroid:com.github.ktsr42.rsyncserver.description:
This app makes the shared storage of the device available via the Rsync protocol.
Shared storage is what you can see in the "File Manager" app that usually comes with
the device. This includes the 'DCIM' camera image folder as well as 'Downloads'.
When the "start" button is pressed and the device has Wifi connectivity, the app will
open a rsync server on a random port with a random tag ("module" in rsync parlance).
It will display all necessary details on how to connect to that server while it is
running, e.g.
rsync://192.168.123.123:66671/abcdef/
Using a standard rsync client the server can then be interrogated and files moved back and
forth, i.e. to and from the phone. The benefit is that the transfers can be driven from
the client desktop, the keyboard and mouse interface of which making the process much
more convenient.
Note: This app has not been widely tested and should therefore be considered alpha quality.

fdroid:com.hobbyone.HashDroid.name: Hash Droid
fdroid:com.hobbyone.HashDroid.description:
Hash Droid is a free utility to calculate a hash from a given text or from a file stored on the device.
In this application, the available hash functions are : Adler-32, CRC-32, Haval-128, MD2, MD4, MD5, RIPEMD-128, RIPEMD-160, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, Tiger and Whirlpool.
The calculated hash can be copied to the clipboard to be reused elsewhere.
The first tab enables to calculate the hash of a given string.
The second tab helps you to compute the hash of a file located on the internal or external memory of your device. The size of the file and the last date modified are also displayed.
The last feature helps you to compare the calculated hash with another given hash but more generally, you can compare any hashes by just pasting them.
A hash (also called checksum or digest) is a digital fingerprint, uniquely identifying a string or a file.
Hash functions are often used in cryptography to generate strong passwords. They are also employed to check the integrity of files.
Hash Droid is often used to check an Android ROM before flashing it.

fdroid:knightloader.halleluja.design.name: KnightLoader
fdroid:knightloader.halleluja.design.summary: Remote control for the KnightLoader download manager you host yourself.
fdroid:knightloader.halleluja.design.description:
KnightLoader is a download manager you run yourself, on a home server, a NAS or your computer. This app is its remote control: it shows what your instances are downloading, and you add links and steer the queue from your phone. The downloads themselves run on your instance, never on the phone.
What you can do
• See every instance in your group on one screen: whether it is online, how many files are left and how fast it is going
• Follow one instance's queue as it runs, with progress and speed for each file and a plain explanation when a download fails
• Start and stop the queue, switch single links or whole packages on and off, and remove packages
• Paste links and send them to an instance
• Answer many of the captchas that hold up a download, right on the phone
• Pick light or dark, a corner style and an accent colour, or let the app take its look from your instance
To connect, type the twelve-word connection phrase your KnightLoader shows, or scan its QR code. Every instance in the group appears at once. You need no account, no address and no open port.
The app reaches your instances through a relay. The developer runs the default one, parleyport.halleluja.design. If your instance uses a ParleyPort relay of your own, the app follows it when you scan the instance's QR code. Requests and answers between the app and your instances are end-to-end encrypted with a key that comes from your phrase, so the relay passes them on without being able to read them. The app shows no ads.
To tell you about captchas and finished or failed downloads while the app is closed, it keeps its own connection to your instances through the relay. With "Stay connected", which is on by default, it does so all the time: Android shows a quiet notification, and while nothing happens the app checks about once a minute. You can turn it off under Settings › Notifications.
You need a running KnightLoader instance. KnightLoader is free and open source under the AGPL-3.0: https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader
KnightLoader is at an early stage and changes quickly, and an update to your instance can need an update to the app as well. Please report problems on GitHub.
When you answer a captcha, the app loads that captcha service's own widget (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha or Cloudflare Turnstile) in a web view.
The app uses the camera only to scan the QR code of your phrase.

If an advanced nation-state level cyber attacker were to compromise the mobile device of even just one of your key employees, imagine the level of damage they could do to your entire organization’s network, cloud assets and sensitive information. Not just passwords copied but 2FA/MFA prompts silently accepted on the mobile device by the attacker without any user input or knowledge followed by the attacker using the device’s VPN access to relay into your network. It’s even more damaging than a laptop being compromised. The attacker would be able to fully impersonate the legitimate owner of the compromised device with no way for you to distinguish the difference.
Am I Secure? Endpoint Security is the most comprehensive security solution for iOS. It is the only solution that performs daily forensic analysis of iOS system diagnostic "sysdiagnose" data, which is necessary to successfully detect the malware and spyware of the most advanced nation-state level cyber attackers and commercial spyware companies that sell to authoritarian regimes. To perform an advanced security scan that can detect malware and spyware, users first initiate the system diagnostic functionality built-in to iOS. This collects detailed data on the operating system (iOS), information such as what processes and threads are actively running. This level of data is not available to MDM/MTD solutions, without the user generating and sharing it no iOS solution can access it. The user then shares this data with the Am I Secure? Endpoint Security app which uploads it to our analysis servers. A combination of automated analysis powered by artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), along with targeted manual review, is used to identify compromised devices. Results are delivered back to the app for the user and also shared with your organization, managed security provider, or SIEM.
Mobile Device Management (MDM) that employees do not trust and do not want on their devices is NOT required, especially important for BYOD organizations. Am I Secure? Endpoint Security does not require or request access to any personal data.
Additional features include:
• Routine auditing and compliance checks that run in the background to compare a device against your organization's mobile device security policy, e.g. iOS up to date, passcode enabled, Lockdown Mode enabled, no 3rd party keyboards/keyloggers installed, etc.
• Prompting your users to rectify any compliance issues and reporting back if they do not do so in a timely manner, less user management costs and wasted time for your team reminding employees.
Go from near zero visibility of your organization’s mobile device security policy compliance to a full picture of all of your iOS mobile devices. It's like having a dedicated mobile device forensic team and a mobile threat hunting team on staff checking all of your organization's devices, all through one easy to use solution. Fill the gaps in your cyber security and meet your regulatory audit and compliance requirements.

apple-macos:6762677151.description:
NetScanPro turns your iPhone or iPad into a professional-grade Wi-Fi network scanner. Discover what's on your network, identify what each device actually is, see which services are exposed, and understand what might be at risk — with all scanning and identification happening on your device.
FEATURES
Device Discovery
- Finds devices on your local Wi-Fi network using four discovery methods working in parallel: TCP probing, Bonjour/mDNS, SSDP/UPnP, and ICMP ping
- Shows IP and IPv6 addresses, MAC addresses where available, hostnames, and device categories
- Search by name, IP, vendor, model, MAC address or service, and group devices by type
- Works with Macs, PCs, smart TVs, printers, speakers, Fire TVs, Apple TVs, routers, smart-home and Matter devices, and more
Device Identification
- Identifies devices from Bonjour records, UPnP announcements, open-port patterns, and — for devices that broadcast one, such as AirPlay and Chromecast hardware — MAC vendor prefixes matched against the full IEEE manufacturer database, bundled offline
- Recognizes your router from its UPnP announcement, a known router hostname, or your network's gateway address
- Every identification carries a confidence level, so you can tell a confirmed match from a best guess
- The device you're scanning from identifies itself
- Devices that share nothing identifiable stay unlabeled rather than mislabeled
Port Scanning with Plain-Language Descriptions (Pro)
- Tap any device to scan 27 common TCP ports
- Identifies HTTP, HTTPS, SSH, FTP, SMB, IPP, RDP, VNC, and more
- Tap any port to learn what it actually does — no networking degree required
- Security guidance for sensitive ports explains real-world risks like WannaCry, credential exposure, and exposed cameras and printers, with severity tiers so you know what needs attention
- Devices with a web port open get a one-tap link into Safari — the fastest way to identify something that won't tell you its name
Network Security Summary (Pro)
- Scan every device on your network at once and see all your security findings in one place
- Findings grouped by service and ordered worst-first, so you can spot patterns across your whole network at a glance
- Tap any finding to see exactly which devices are affected
Network-Aware Scanning
- Each Wi-Fi network keeps its own separate device list
- Switch between networks (home, work, anywhere) with a tap
- Per-network scan history, device renaming, and PDF reports that open with a summary of what the scan found
- Rename a device and the name sticks, even after your router hands its address to something else. When NetScanPro can't tell whether a device moved, it asks instead of guessing, and the answer can be undone for two weeks
- Create networks manually and pin a scan to one, so two sites that look identical (same subnet, same gateway) stay separate
On iPad
- A sidebar for your networks, Security and Scan History, with device details beside the list
- Scan History shows which devices were new or missing in each scan
- Keyboard shortcuts: ⌘R to scan, ⌘F to search
Privacy First
- Face ID, Touch ID or passcode locks the app — optional in Settings
- All scanning and identification happen on-device, with no cloud lookup — nothing leaves your local network
- No accounts, no analytics, no tracking SDKs
- Your scan history stays on your device
Freemium
- Free: unlimited device discovery, 3 network scans per day
- Pro ($9.99 one-time): unlimited scans + port scanning on every device + network security summary + PDF report export + device renaming. No subscriptions.
The help screen in Settings explains how device discovery works and which devices may not appear (some IoT and privacy-mode phones don't expose themselves to any iOS scanner).
Feedback or feature requests? I'm a solo developer and I read every message — contact@fogartyholdings.com
Note: NetScanPro is designed for use on networks you own, administer, or have explicit permission to inspect.

apple-macos:6778381283.name: Vittly: Food Hygiene Ratings
apple-macos:6778381283.description:
Vittly shows the official food hygiene rating for places you're about to eat at — and, just as importantly, when that rating was given.
A hygiene rating is a snapshot from one inspection. A 5 from last month and a 5 from four years ago are not the same thing, so Vittly always shows the date beside the score and flags a rating that's getting old.
WHAT YOU GET
• Ratings near you — a map of nearby places colour-coded by rating, with clustered pins that show the spread of scores in an area at a glance.
• Search by name or place — find a specific restaurant, cafe, takeaway, pub, school or shop.
• The full inspection detail — the overall rating, the date behind it, and the three underlying scores (Hygiene, Structure, Management) with the FSA's own wording for each.
• Plain-language explainers — tap any of the three scores to see what that area actually covers, what the inspector checks, and what it doesn't tell you.
• Food recalls and allergy alerts — the FSA's alerts feed, with the allergens named.
• The 14 allergens explained — what each one covers, the other names it hides behind on a label ("whey", "casein" and "ghee" all mean milk), and where it's easy to miss.
• Save the places you care about, and get told when a saved place's rating changes.
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, plus Siri and Shortcuts support.
• Fully available in Welsh as well as English.
BOTH UK SCHEMES, RENDERED PROPERLY
England, Wales and Northern Ireland use FHRS — a 0 to 5 number. Scotland uses FHIS, which gives a named result (Pass, or Improvement Required) and no number at all. Vittly shows each scheme in its own terms and never converts one into the other or ranks them against each other.
HONEST BY DESIGN
• Nothing is averaged, estimated or predicted. If a place has no rating, Vittly says so.
• Places awaiting a first inspection are listed as awaiting inspection, not quietly dropped.
• Exempt premises are shown as exempt.
• Ratings that are getting old are flagged as old.
• On the three underlying scores, lower is better — Vittly says so rather than assuming you know.
STILL THERE?
The FSA register can lag behind reality, so Vittly cross-checks free public sources — including Companies House for registered companies — to flag a place that may have closed or changed hands. You can also tell Vittly a place has closed, and see how many other people have reported the same.
FREE, WITH NO CATCH
Everything Vittly does is free, forever. No accounts, no adverts, no subscription, and no feature locked behind a purchase. If you want to support it there's an optional one-off Supporter purchase and a tip — the Supporter unlocks alternate app icons and a badge, and nothing else.
PRIVACY
Vittly has no analytics and doesn't track you. When you search near you, your coordinates go to the Food Standards Agency only to run that one search — never stored, never tied to you. The one thing it records is
optional: if you report that a place has closed, that report is published to a shared public database so other people can see it. It carries the place's FSA id, a timestamp, and a pseudonymous account identifier that Apple attaches to it — never your name, email or location — and you can remove it at any time. That single feature is the only reason Vittly's App Store privacy label isn't "No Data Collected".
WHAT A RATING IS NOT
A hygiene rating covers food safety at the last inspection. It is not a judgement of the food, the service, or how a kitchen handles allergens. If you have an allergy, always tell staff.
Vittly covers the United Kingdom.
Rating and alert data from the Food Standards Agency, under the Open Government Licence. Company data from Companies House. Maps by Apple.

flathub:com.adilhanney.saber.description:
Saber is the notes app built for handwriting.
 It's designed to be as simple and intuitive as possible, while still delivering unique features
 that you'll actually use. Additionally, Saber is available across all your devices, large and small,
 and syncs between them seamlessly.
 Notably, it can invert your notes when you're in dark mode. This allows you to write with white
 ink on a black background, which is much easier on the eyes in low-light environments like when
 the teacher turns off the lights in class.
 Images and PDFs are also inverted, so you can still use a digital printout or a textbook without
 the fuss.
 Saber uses a dual-password system to protect your notes from anyone but you, even if they have
 complete control over the server. You can safely store your notes on the official Saber server,
 another server, or even host your own!
 The app is completely open-source so that anyone can view the source code and see exactly what
 it's doing and how it handles your data. Many other note-taking apps are closed-source and proprietary,
 meaning that their inner workings are a mystery to the public.
 As someone who studies maths, highlighting multi-line equations was always a hassle with other
 apps, where the highlighter would change color when it overlapped with itself. Another problem
 I had was that in some apps, the highlighter would render on top of the text, fading it out and
 making it hard to read.
 Saber's highlighter has no such issues. It utilizes canvas compositing to render the highlighter
 in a way that is consistent with/better than traditional paper, where it handles overlaps and maintains
 color consistency.
 Saber has everything you need to keep your notes organized. Create folders inside folders inside
 folders to your heart's content with no limit on the number of nested folders. And even though
 a note may be buried deep within a nested folder, you can still access it easily with your most
 recent notes always available on the home screen.
 Discover a whole new way to capture and organize your thoughts with Saber. Whether you're a
 student, professional, or creative mind, Saber is your trusted companion for digital handwriting.
 Download now and let your ideas flow freely!

firefox-addons:2862763.name: Torii Image Translator — AI Manga Translator
firefox-addons:2862763.summary: Translate any image on any website in any language! Perfect for Manga, Manhwa, Manhua, Comics, Memes or any image at all!
firefox-addons:2862763.description:
Translate manga, manhwa, webtoons and comics right where you read them. Torii finds the text in any image on any website, translates it with the AI model of your choice, and typesets the translation back into the speech bubbles.
Made by a solo developer, updated almost every week, with an active Discord community of 2,000+ readers and scanlators.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• One-click translation: hover any image and click, or switch on auto-translate for the whole page
• Bulk translate a full chapter, then download every page as a ZIP or PDF
• Choose your AI model: Gemini, GPT, DeepSeek, Grok, Claude and more, or bring your own API key
• Japanese, Korean and Chinese to English, plus 120+ other languages
• Context sharing across pages keeps names and terms consistent through a chapter
• Custom prompts to steer tone, honorifics and terminology your way
• Translation history: browse and reopen everything you've translated
A REAL EDITOR, IN YOUR BROWSER
Torii is the only manga translation extension that lets you edit the result in place:
• Move, resize, rotate and restyle every text box, with your own custom fonts
• Erase, paint and AI-inpaint to clean the original text away
• Find and replace across pages, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts, undo everything
• Export layered PSD files for further work in Photoshop
A FULL SCANLATION WORKSPACE ON THE WEB
For bigger jobs, the web app at toriitranslate.com gives you a complete project workspace with the same editor:
• Upload whole chapters or volumes at once: images, ZIP archives, PDFs or saved Torii projects
• Organize pages into folders, then translate everything with one click
• Import and export the original and translated scripts, and crop pages
• Save the project and pick it up later, or download it all as ZIP, PDF, PSD or a Torii project file
WORKS EVERYWHERE YOU READ
Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera, Firefox (including Android), Safari on Mac, iPad and iPhone, and the web app at toriitranslate.com . One account and one credit balance across all of them.
PRICING
Torii includes a free trial. After that, translations use credits that you buy as you go. There's no subscription to cancel.
Questions or ideas? Join the Discord from toriitranslate.com . I read and reply to every message.

bluejetty:00161969:ios.description:
Válogass több száz magyarországi internetes rádió és élő FM rádió közül egyetlen helyen! A My Online Rádió alkalmazással az online rádióhallgatás ingyenes, egyszerű és kényelmes. Hallgasd a legnépszerűbb magyar rádióállomásokat bárhol és bármikor iPhone-on vagy iPad-en!
iOS alkalmazásunkat a magyarországi online rádiókat tömörítő myonlineradio.hu weboldal mobil verziójaként hoztuk létre. Segítségével nemcsak hallgathatod a kedvenceidet, de élőben láthatod az aktuálisan játszott dalok címét és borítóképét is. A részletes műsorújságban és a lejátszási listákban akár egy hónapra visszamenőleg is visszakeresheted, milyen zenék szóltak a rádióban. Állítsd össze saját kedvencek listádat, hogy egy gombnyomással elérd a legjobb online rádiókat!
Főbb funkciók és tulajdonságok:
- Apple CarPlay támogatás
- AirPlay és Chromecast kompatibilitás
- Podcastok és archív adások visszahallgatása (pl. Balázsék, Bochkor)
- Játszási lista, dalkijelzés és borítókép az aktuális dalhoz
- Ébresztő és időzített kikapcsolás
- Hangszínszabályzó, Equalizer
- Témák, háttérkép módosítás
- Beépített webkamera nézet a rádiók stúdiójába
- Adatforgalom számláló és szerver választó (High, Medium, Mobil)
- Felhasználói profil létrehozása
- Prémium funkciók előfizetéssel: hozzáférés több mint 20 ország rádióihoz (földrajzi kötöttségek nélkül), dalfelismerés, dalszöveg megjelenítés, reklámmentesség, profil megosztása más eszközökkel
A legnépszerűbb magyar rádiók az alkalmazásban:
Rádió 1, Retro Rádió, Klubrádió, Petőfi Rádió, MegaDance Rádió, Kossuth Rádió, OXYGEN MUSIC, DeJa Vu Rádió, Park FM - Budapest Park rádiója, BEST FM - Debrecen és Budapest, Danubius Rádió, Sláger FM, Szépvíz FM, Laza Rádió, Mulatós Rádiók, Rock FM, Karc FM - Hír FM, Dankó Rádió, COOL FM, Mix Rádió, Rádió88, Rise FM, Rádió GaGa, Rocker Rádió, Deejay Rádió, Rádió Dikh, Jazzy Rádió, Poptarisznya, Juventus Rádió, Sunshine Rádió, radiocafé 98.0, Deep House Radio, Gong Rádió, Marosvásárhelyi Rádió, Forrás Rádió, Roxy Rádió, InfoRádió.
Ha nem találod a kedvenc rádiódat a listában, használd az alkalmazás fejlécében lévő kereső ikont, amely hangalapú keresést is támogat! Prémium előfizetéssel a kereső földrajzi kötöttségek nélkül biztosít találatokat, így egyetlen felületen, zökkenőmentesen válthatsz a hazai és a több mint 20 országot felölelő nemzetközi rádió kínálat között.
Az elérhető online rádiók teljes listáját megtalálod weboldalunkon: https://myonlineradio.hu
Hasznos információ: Ha az online stream akad, azért nem a rádió alkalmazás, hanem az adott adó stream szervere a felelős. Ilyenkor a szerver általában túlterhelt a nagyszámú hallgató miatt. Erre az alkalmazásnak sajnos nincs ráhatása.

bluejetty:00127284:ios.description:
Turn any video or Live Photo into a GIF in seconds. No ads, no account, no learning curve.
Pick a clip, trim it to the best moment, add a caption, and share it. GIF Maker is the quickest way to make reaction GIFs, memes and loops of your pets, friends and favorite moments.
MAKE GIFS FROM
• Videos in your library
• Live Photos
• New videos you record in the app
• Videos shared from other apps: tap Share, then GIF Maker
EDIT IN A FEW TAPS
• Trim: keep just the moment you want
• Crop: frame it the way you like
• Speed: slow motion down to 0.2× or fast-forward up to 5×
• Text: add captions in 10 fonts and any color, then drag them into place
• Filters: 18 looks, from Noir and Vintage to Thermal, Glitch and Cartoon
• Stickers: 90 stickers and emoji to set the mood
SAVE AND SHARE ANYWHERE
• Save GIFs to Photos
• Send them in Messages, WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Discord and any other app
• Download your edit as an MP4 video too
• All your GIFs stay in one place in the app
FREE, WITH NO ADS
Make as many GIFs as you like for free. There are no ads, ever. GIFs made with the free version include a small watermark.
PREMIUM PASS
Remove the watermark from every GIF. Choose the Monthly Pass, which starts with a 1-week free trial, or the Lifetime Pass, a one-time purchase.
The Monthly Pass is an auto-renewable subscription. After the free trial, payment is charged to your Apple Account, and the subscription renews automatically each month unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of the free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Made for iPhone and iPad.
Privacy Policy: https://float.support/gif-maker/privacy
Terms of Use: https://float.support/gif-maker/terms

To use Dialer, you hold your phone's speaker up to a telephone handset or microphone and play the tone by pressing a button or by selecting one of your saved favorites.
Store up to five favorites in the free version for easy dialing, such as calling cards, teleconference numbers, or complicated phone tree's. Commas act as pauses during the dialing tone sequence to allow time for prompts and other delays. Simply hold up your iPhone speaker to the landline telephone's microphone or handset and press dial.
Some other devices also use DTMF tones to configure, Dialer is great for these as well. Volume is controlled by your devices volume buttons, so you can easily turn it up or down for just the right volume of your tones. Unlock Dialer Pro features such as unlimited favorites, and the ability to set the dial tone length and pause length (for commas).
**Please note that some Voice over IP (VOIP) systems can have trouble recognizing the tones, for those systems try a longer key press allowing enough time for the system to register the tone.
Purchase the optional upgrade to unlock these features:
- Dial with precision: Unlock the power of four additional expanded DTMF tones – A, B, C, and D. Whether you're interacting with automated systems, entering passwords, or accessing exclusive services, Dialer Pro has got you covered.
- Save your favorites effortlessly: With Dialer Pro, you can save an unlimited number of favorites directly from the main dialer screen, ensuring quick and easy access whenever you need it.
- Customize your dialing experience: Take control over tone length and pause time when dialing your favorites. Tailor your settings to match your unique requirements, ensuring seamless compatibility with any phone system.
ACCESSIBILITY FEATURES:
Dialer is now fully accessible with comprehensive VoiceOver support:
• Complete screen reader compatibility for blind and visually impaired users
• Custom accessibility actions for DTMF tone testing via swipe gestures
• Configurable VoiceOver delay timing for optimal audio experience
• Clear button labels and navigation hints throughout the app
• Accessible favorites management and editing
Download Dialer today and make your dialing experience smarter, faster, and more enjoyable.

bluejetty:00128305:ios.summary:

Whether you're a beginner, a pro, or a kid just getting started — FlipKit's intuitive interface ma
bluejetty:00128305:ios.description:
Create your own frame-by-frame animations — just like a real flipbook! FlipKit gives you everything you need to bring your drawings to life.
Whether you're a beginner, a pro, or a kid just getting started — FlipKit's intuitive interface makes animating easy and fun. Draw with Apple Pencil or your finger, add shapes and stickers, and watch your creation come to life.
Need inspiration? Dive into ready-made examples and templates to get started right away.
Import photos from your library or use the camera for the perfect background. Combine photos with your drawings to create stop-motion animations. Advanced artists will love separate foreground and background layers, onion skinning, and fine-tuned animation controls.
Flip through your animation like a real physical flipbook or preview it on the canvas. When you're done, export as video, animated GIF, or PNG sequence and share your creation with the world.
No account required. No data collected. Just create.
DRAWING TOOLS
* Draw with pencils, brushes, pens, erasers, and more
* Insert shapes, text, emojis, and custom stickers
* Fill enclosed areas with color
* Copy and move parts of your drawings with the lasso tool
* Full support for Apple Pencil
* Zoom, rotate, and pan your canvas
ANIMATION
* Create animations frame by frame with onion skinning
* Swipe the filmstrip to flip through your animation
* Separate foreground and background layers
* Control frames per second, background color, and playback mode (loop, ping-pong, once)
* Import photos for backgrounds or stop-motion animations
* Various examples and templates for an easy start
EXPORT & SHARE
* Export as video (MP4), animated GIF, or PNG sequence
* Export single frames or transparent image sequences
* Share your creations on social media or with friends
DESIGNED FOR YOU
* Place the filmstrip on the left or right (for right- or left-handed use)
* iCloud Drive keeps your animations in sync across all your devices
* Automatic backups keep your animations safe
* Dark Mode support
* No account setup — FlipKit respects your privacy and does not collect any data linked to you
CONTACT
Questions or wishes? Write us: info@tinkado.at

Discover the authentic taste of Mexican made fresh — right from your phone. The Uncle Julio’s App makes it easier than ever to enjoy your favorites, earn exclusive rewards, and stay connected with everything happening at your local restaurant.
Earn Rewards & Offers
Join our loyalty program and start earning rewards every time you dine with us. From bonus points to limited-time offers and special birthday surprises, the more you enjoy, the more you earn.

At Uncle Julio’s, we believe every meal should be made with care, craftsmanship, and a touch of celebration. From sizzling fajitas and fresh-made tortillas to hand-shaken margaritas and our one-of-a-kind Chocolate Piñata, each dish is prepared to delight and impress — bringing family and friends together over flavors you’ll crave again and again.

bluejetty:00018591:ios.summary:
Du stehst mal wieder vor der Frage: »Was koche oder backe ich heute?« Dann bist du bei Chefkoch mit über 370.000 leckeren und gesunden Rezepten genau richtig! 
Ob kochen oder backen, für dich allein oder um deine Gäste zu beeindrucken, für
bluejetty:00018591:ios.description:
Du stehst mal wieder vor der Frage: »Was koche oder backe ich heute?« Dann bist du bei Chefkoch mit über 370.000 leckeren und gesunden Rezepten genau richtig! 
Ob kochen oder backen, für dich allein oder um deine Gäste zu beeindrucken, für Anfänger oder Kochprofis – bei Chefkoch findest du Rezepte für jeden Geschmack und jede Ernährung – von der Community vielfach nachgekocht und bewertet.
Chefkoch Features
► wähle aus über 370.000 Rezepten: Low carb, Smoothie, Vegetarisch, Vegan, Keto uvm.
► teile und bewerte deine Lieblingsrezepte
► speichere und verwalte Rezepte in deinem eigenen Kochbuch
► finde Tipps und Trends der Redaktion zu verschiedenen Ernährungsweisen
► lasse dich durch vorgeschlagene Back- und Kochrezepte inspirieren
► notiere dir eigene Anmerkungen am Rezept
► plane deine wöchentlichen Mahlzeiten und behalte den Überblick mit dem Essensplaner
► schreibe alle Zutaten auf deine persönliche Einkaufsliste und spare Zeit
► genieße den Vorzug des Abos und erhalte Rezepte bekannter Köche und Köchinnen
► profitiere im Abonnement von zusätzlichen Features wie dem Wochenplaner und der Werbefreiheit
+++ Rezepte suchen +++
»Was koche ich heute?« oder »Was backe ich heute? «
Ob Anfänger oder Koch-Profi – in unserer Rezeptsuche findest du immer die passenden Rezepte für dich. Nutze entweder die voreingestellte Suche oder gib deine eigenen Wünsche ein – zum Beispiel Suppen, Auflauf, Fingerfood, Torten oder Plätzchen backen. Du kannst auch einzelne Zutaten eingeben, die du noch im Kühlschrank hast und wir schlagen dir mögliche Rezepte vor, mit denen du deine Reste verwerten kannst. Von Alltagsküche, Superfoods, Low Carb, High Protein, Diät, zum Abnehmen, Fasten, nachhaltigen Rezepten, Paleo, Keto, Basisch, Vegan, Vegetarisch & Glutenfrei über internationale Küche wie italienisch, indisch oder mediterran ist alles dabei. Lass dich inspirieren!
+++ Von Chefköch:innen bewertet +++
Schau dir an, wie andere ein Rezept bewertet haben und vergib Sterne für deine eigenen Favoriten. Die Kommentare zu Rezepten helfen für hilfreiche Tipps und geben Anregungen für Variationen. Teile deine Meinung mit anderen Kochbegeisterten und tauscht euch aus!
+++ Kochbuch +++
Du hast ein großartiges Rezept für deine Heißluftfritteuse entdeckt? Kein Problem! Speichere es einfach in deinem eigenen Kochbuch und finde es jederzeit problemlos wieder. Du kannst persönliche Sammlungen anlegen, um deine Lieblingsrezepte oder Rezepte nach Ernährungsweisen übersichtlich zu sortieren. Du hast eigene kreative Ideen, um ein Rezept noch besser zu machen? Füge Notizen zu einem Rezept hinzu, damit du dich beim nächsten Mal direkt an deine Abwandlungen erinnerst.
+++ Mehr als nur Werbefreiheit im PLUS-Abonnement +++
Keine Lust auf Werbung? Mit einem Abonnement hast du die Möglichkeit, die App ohne Bannerwerbung und Werbung vor den Videos zu nutzen. Darüber hinaus erhältst du Zugriff auf unseren praktischen Wochenplaner mit Einkaufsliste sowie Zugang zu Premium-Rezepte bekannter Köche und Köchinnen. Wähle zwischen einer Laufzeit von einem Monat oder einem Jahr. Dein Abo kannst du bis zu 24 Stunden vor Ablauf deiner Laufzeit kündigen. Sichere dir einen kostenlosen Probemonat und tauche ganz ungestört in die Rezeptwelt von Chefkoch ab. Jetzt testen!
Chefkoch liefert dir die besten Rezepte und Zubereitungsarten für das Kochen und Backen – von traditionellen, regionalen und saisonalen Gerichten bis zu herzhaften und süßen Klassikern wie Brot, Pfannkuchen, Lasagne, Auflauf und Salat: Chefkoch wünscht einen Guten Appetit!
Unsere Allgemeinen Geschäftsbedingungen findest du hier: https://www.chefkoch.de/agb/
Unsere Datenschutzhinweise findest du hier: https://www.chefkoch.de/magazin/datenschutz.html
Fragen, Anregungen oder Hunger?
Wir freuen uns über deine Bewertung und dein Feedback, um Chefkoch stets zu verbessern und weiterzuentwickeln. 
Für Anregungen und Vorschläge schickt uns eine E-Mail an: support-ios@chefkoch.de
Dein Chefkoch-Team

Du kannst persönliche Sammlungen anlegen, um deine Lieblingsrezepte oder Rezepte nach Ernährungsweisen übersichtlich zu sortieren. Du hast eigene kreative Ideen, um ein Rezept noch besser zu machen? Füge Notizen zu einem Rezept hinzu, damit du dich beim nächsten Mal direkt an deine Abwandlungen erinnerst.

Keine Lust auf Werbung? Mit einem Abonnement hast du die Möglichkeit, die App ohne Bannerwerbung und Werbung vor den Videos zu nutzen. Darüber hinaus erhältst du Zugriff auf unseren praktischen Wochenplaner mit Einkaufsliste sowie Zugang zu Premium-Rezepte bekannter Köche und Köchinnen. Wähle zwischen einer Laufzeit von einem Monat oder einem Jahr. Dein Abo kannst du bis zu 24 Stunden vor Ablauf deiner Laufzeit kündigen. Sichere dir einen kostenlosen Probemonat und tauche ganz ungestört in die Rezeptwelt von Chefkoch ab. Jetzt testen!

Chefkoch liefert dir die besten Rezepte und Zubereitungsarten für das Kochen und Backen – von traditionellen, regionalen und saisonalen Gerichten bis zu herzhaften und süßen Klassikern wie Brot, Pfannkuchen, Lasagne, Auflauf und Salat: Chefkoch wünscht einen Guten Appetit!

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewertung und dein Feedback, um Chefkoch stets zu verbessern und weiterzuentwickeln. 
Für Anregungen und Vorschläge schickt uns eine E-Mail an: support-ios@chefkoch.de

Dein Chefkoch-Team

bluejetty:00069012:ios.name: Countdown to Anything!
bluejetty:00069012:ios.summary:
Count down to anything - birthdays, vacations, weddings, baby due dates and more - with no ads!
FEATURES
• Create countdowns to any future date and time, or even countups from a past event
• Customise your countdowns with hundreds of cute
bluejetty:00069012:ios.description:
Count down to anything - birthdays, vacations, weddings, baby due dates and more - with no ads!
FEATURES
• Create countdowns to any future date and time, or even countups from a past event
• Customise your countdowns with hundreds of cute icons for birthdays, vacations, weddings, baby due dates and lots more
• Add a widget to your home screen showing your favourite countdown
• Get notifications when your countdowns end
• Share your countdowns privately with your friends, even if they don't have the app
• Create repeating countdowns, such as yearly countdowns for a birthday, or even a weekly countdown to Friday evening!
• Got lots of countdowns? Add custom tags to them so you can see similar countdowns at once. Try creating a "Birthdays" tag!
• Add notes to your countdowns, like birthday present ideas, or travel details
• No ads! I really don't like ads in apps, so there are no ads and no data sharing at all in Countdown to Anything
PREMIUM FEATURES
• More widgets - add as many as you want, plus a widget showing a list of your next countdowns
• 240+ extra icons for every occasion
• Unlimited colours, plus a hex picker for when you need it to be just right
• Get reminder notifications before a countdown ends, not just when it ends
• Extra layout options, custom time units, and more
Premium is available as a one-time lifetime purchase or a yearly subscription. You can try Premium free for 7 days to see if you like it.
BUILT-IN COUNTDOWNS
Countdown to Anything also has a huge selection of built-in countdowns so you can easily count down to major events.
Built-in events include holidays like New Year's Day, Christmas, Hanukkah, Diwali, Easter Sunday, Halloween, St Patrick's Day, Valentine's Day, and Chuseok, as well as sporting events including the World Cup and Olympics.
ICONS
There are icons for every occasion: vacations (including holidays, flights and cruises), concerts and festivals, movie and game releases, exams, anniversaries, parties, retirement, moving house, and hundreds more. In the unlikely event you can't find what you're looking for, contact me from the Settings screen in the app and I'll do my best to add a new icon for you!
ABOUT ME
Hi! I'm Gary, the developer behind Countdown to Anything. I handle the whole app myself, from development and design to support, bug fixes, and updates. I've built Countdown to Anything to be the kind of app I'd want to use: simple, useful and private. I hope you like it!
ABOUT PURCHASES
Premium is an optional upgrade, available as an annual subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Annual subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is tuned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period. You can manage your subscription on the Premium screen in the app, or in your iPhone's Settings app.
Terms of Service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00062586:ios.name: Prayer Times - Qibla & Salah
bluejetty:00062586:ios.summary: Salah is one of the fundamental pillars of Islam. It’s not just a random prayer but a holistic physical activity that breaks you free from worldly bondages and brings you closer to Allah. Salah is also referred to as Namaz and is offered fi
bluejetty:00062586:ios.description:
Salah is one of the fundamental pillars of Islam. It’s not just a random prayer but a holistic physical activity that breaks you free from worldly bondages and brings you closer to Allah. Salah is also referred to as Namaz and is offered five times a day around the world. There are multiple requirements for a successful salah and some of them are absolutely necessary to carry out. For example, each salah has a particular time. Besides, the prayer must be offered in the direction of Qibla.
To ensure Muslims fulfill these requirements satisfactorily, the IT Department of Dawat-e-Islami has developed this amazing Prayer Times app. With this app, you can not only know the exact times for each salah, but also find Qibla direction and make use of several other interesting features. Let’s learn about the amazing variety of features below.
Features:
Prayer Timetable
This option allows you to see the prayer times worldwide and follow the timetable according to your geographic location.
Prayer Timings Alert
The alert option allows you to become alert of salah before the actual time occurs, so you can prepare in advance.
Location
You can choose the right location for the region in which you’re currently looking for namaz timings.
Qibla Direction
The app tells you the exact Qibla direction no matter where you are located. This helps you offer salah in the accurate Qibla direction.
Qaza Namaz
This option notifies you of Qaza namaz so that you can be aware of the prayers you missed out on and compensate later.
Tasbih Counter
There’s a tasbih counter which gives you opportunity to chant holy verses and litanies and count them as you do.
Calendar
Both Islamic and Gregorian calendars are available on this app. This means you can mark important dates easily.
Multiple Languages
With this option, the language barrier is also no more. Given multiple languages, you can use this app in your native language.
Different Jurisprudence
There are two different lists of namaz timings available for both Hanafi and Shafai jurisprudences.
Recite Quran
With the Quran option, you can recite any surah of the Holy Quran whenever you want. All you need to do is click.
Hajj and Umrah App
This app also contains all the necessary details of Hajj and Umrah so you can learn how to perform each confidently.
Newsfeed
The newsfeed is an essential feature and contains media including articles and images on Islamic learning for all.
Hadees Section
The hadees section features important and soulful hadees of the Holy Prophet (PBUH). Find a list of ahadees.
Share Namaz Timing
You can freely share namaz timing with anyone in the world. This is great for those who need to know exact timings.
Rohani Ilaj
The Rohani ilaj option assists you in finding powerful verses to treat any illness and rid yourself of any negative influences.
Multiple Theme
You can choose the theme of your preference and find the best theme that suits your temperament.
Automate Islami Date
You can automate Islamic dates according to the Islamic calendar and ensure you stay up to date with important events.
Daily Inspiration
The daily inspiration feature gives you motivational stuff to feed your mind with positive Islamic content every day.
Tajweed
You can now recite important surahs with tajweed thanks to this amazing feature which helps you with Quran recitation.
Share
This app has a share option so that it can be shared on social media easily. Feel free to share with friends and family.

bluejetty:00160403:ios.description:
Welcome to Tile Voyage – where tile matching meets pure relaxation!
If you love classic tile games and match 3 puzzles, you've found your new favorite. Tile Voyage brings you the perfect mix of brain-teasing challenges and chill vibes. Match tiles, clear the board, and lose yourself in this beautifully crafted puzzle experience.
What Makes Calm Tiles Special:
- Addictive Tile Matching: Jump right into classic tile puzzle action with a fresh twist. Make triple matches, clear tiles strategically, and watch the board come alive with every move.
- Stunning Visuals: Every level features gorgeous, calming designs that make tile matching a visual treat. From peaceful gardens to zen landscapes, each puzzle is a work of art.
- Endless Puzzle Challenges: Start easy, then push your skills to the limit. Hundreds of levels keep the tile matching fun going, with new puzzles added regularly to keep you hooked.
- Smart Boosters: Stuck on a tricky match? Use power-ups and special tiles to blast through tough spots and rack up massive scores.
- Relaxing Sounds: Chill music and satisfying sound effects make every tile match feel rewarding. Perfect for unwinding after a long day.
- Daily Bonuses: Come back every day for free rewards that help you master even the trickiest tile puzzles.
Whether you're a match game veteran or new to tile matching puzzles, Calm Tiles delivers the perfect balance of relaxation and challenge. It's not just another match 3 – it's your daily escape into a world of beautiful tiles and satisfying matches.
Ready to match, relax, and conquer? Download Tile Voyage now and start your tile matching journey today!

bluejetty:00144973:ios.summary: Tracking calories is the foundation of every successful diet. Calowise encourages you to not just count your calories but to focus on your nutrition as a whole. Count calories, ensure you're meeting nutrient targets, and see your progress o
bluejetty:00144973:ios.description:
Tracking calories is the foundation of every successful diet. Calowise encourages you to not just count your calories but to focus on your nutrition as a whole. Count calories, ensure you're meeting nutrient targets, and see your progress over time. Start your nutrition count journey today and improve your overall health! 
How much should you really focus on calories when you’re trying to lose weight, and what are the best ways to count them? Calowise provide tips, tools, and diet plans can help you get a better sense of how many calories you’re consuming to support your weight loss goals. 
We have a very large food database and provide you with calorie count, nutritional information and serving sizes for millions of foods. Use the barcode scanner to quickly scan items or create your own custom foods. 
Not sure what to eat? Calowise can suggest simple, healthy foods based on your dietary preferences and daily calorie goal. To get started just input your profile details with your goal weight and we’ll calculate the daily calorie budget best for you. Next, easily track your food, weight, and activity and get ready to celebrate your weight loss victories.
Why choose us 
- 2 lbs of weight loss on average by our active members each week.
- We provide not only calorie counting, but also recording and analysis of up to 28 vitamins and minerals;
- We provide an original weekly nutrition report function, which helps you analyze whether your weekly diet is healthy enough through an intuitive five-dimensional chart.
- We are a sufficiently professional and dedicated team, and we will continue to provide new services to help users achieve their goals.
What we offer
- Quickly and easily count calories, protein, carbs, fat, sugar, cholesterol, sodium, fiber and dozens of other nutrients.
- A daily breakdown of your carb, protein, and fat intake allows you to better understand how your food choices impact your overall health. 
- After assessing for weight, age, gender and height, the app provides users with a daily calorie budget and the choice of either a weekly weight loss rate or target date. Whichever choice is selected, users can customize their dashboard to suit their needs including an easy-to-understand graph that breaks down macronutrient targets. 
- Scans barcodes easily and even remembers what you eat and can calculate the calories of food defined by yourself.
- With over 1,000,000 food items in its database, users praise for its straightforward calorie-tracking since it can combine the calorie content of common packaged food ingredients and restaurant items with everyday fresh foods. 
- Allow widget for quicker and easier tracking, ideal for people who are deterred by documenting their daily intake. It’s require fewer steps than other apps to log foods.
- Apple Health integration - read/write Steps data to Apple Health.
Contact us: https://calowise.uploss.net/
Privacy Policy URL: https://calowise.uploss.net/privacy
Terms of service URL: https://calowise.uploss.net/terms

bluejetty:00120411:ios.summary:
Animal Tower Ark is a fun app with zoo animals for kids and toddlers.
Rescue animals on Noah's boat, learn animal sounds and explore savanna animals, strange animals, farm pets, polar creatures and dinosaurs.
***** Kids love this classic a
bluejetty:00120411:ios.description:
Animal Tower Ark is a fun app with zoo animals for kids and toddlers.
Rescue animals on Noah's boat, learn animal sounds and explore savanna animals, strange animals, farm pets, polar creatures and dinosaurs.
***** Kids love this classic animal ark game. Download it now! *****
A tiny little boat, many animals and a delicate balance! 
Help get the animals on the ark, balance them on board and bring them to safety, or freely explore the world and discover hidden characters.
FREE ANIMALS
Explore the savanna for free and play with 8 wild animals from Africa: lion, zebra, flamingo, elephant, crocodile, rhino, giraffe and hippo.
SPECIAL ANIMALS
Add special worlds if you want even more animals to rescue.
• Farm animals and pets: cow, horse, pig, sheep, chicken, dog, cat and donkey.
• Jurassic dinosaurs and prehistoric animals: Tyrannosaurus Rex (T. Rex), Brontosaurus, Triceratops, Mammoth, Elasmosaurus, Stegosaurus, Spinosaurus and Glyptodont.
• Polar animals: penguin, polar bear, seal, walrus, Arctic hare, reindeer, husky and musk ox.
• Australian animals: koala, kangaroo, colour-changing chameleon, kiwi, platypus, lemur, wombat and echidna.
This app is like a zoo full of mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, shells and dinosaurs. Rescue them all!
***** Featured by Apple on “Our Favorites Made in Italy” *****
***** Winner of a Digital Ehon Award, in Japan! *****
***** Featured on major newspapers and TV channels *****
***** Highlighted among the best baby games by Tech Radar, Mamamo and BCBF Award! *****
***** Wonderful illustrations! Selected for the Illustrators Annual! *****
KIDS EXPLORE, PLAY, LEARN!
• Learn the animal sounds!
• Plunge into a wonderful sea with fun, realistic water effects!
• Enjoy changing the weather: sun, rain, storm, hail, and snow!
• Listen to relaxing music and try to immerse an animal underwater … the music fades out!
• Play with cute animals and pets!
• Collect photos of your animal tower!
EDUCATIONAL, SIMPLY DESIGNED FOR CHILDREN AND TODDLERS
• Animal app designed for 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 ... 100 years old children!
• Simple, no reading skills needed.
• Multi-touch, meaning baby kids can play with one or more fingers at the same time.
• Toddlers can play either alone, independently, or with a friend, or even with mom and dad!
• Safe with integrated parental control.
• No time limits, no points, no stress! Children can take a break whenever they want. Take a picture of your animal tower to save the level, and enjoy a break in the open air! You can find all of your photos in the app gallery and from them restart to play.
This lovely baby app is inspired by traditional wooden, educational toys; like them, it develops your child's eye-finger coordination, imagination, sense of balance and concentration.
NO WI-FI NEEDED
Once downloaded, this app also works offline, without Wi-Fi or internet connection, so that children can play anywhere, even on long journeys!
FREE CONTENTS
You can play for free with 8 savannah animals, listen to their sounds and save them as many times as you want!
Add farm animals, polar animals, dinosaurs and strange animals from Australia, New Zealand and Madagascar!
This animal app is ideal for kids, babies, toddlers, boys and girls, from 3 years upwards. Try it now!
PRIVACY and SECURITY
Our kids games do not contain third-party advertising and never collect any personal data. You can read our full privacy policy here: www.lolaslug.com/privacy-policy/
LOLA SLUG (Giulia Olivares + Giordano Scalzo)
We are an Italian creative studio that designs quality apps and innovative games for children all over the world. Imagery, colours, characters, everything in our contents is designed to meet the cognitive needs of the little kids and to encourage their development.
To stay updated on the latest promotions, please visit www.lolaslug.com and subscribe to the newsletter!
CONTACTS
support@lolaslug.com
www.lolaslug.com

bluejetty:00148776:ios.description:
Game Maps IRL: Experience the World Through Iconic Game Maps
Transform your everyday navigation into a thrilling adventure with Game Maps IRL. This innovative app lets you view your current location reimagined in the distinctive styles of classic game maps. While we draw inspiration from these beloved titles, please note that Game Maps IRL is completely unofficial and not affiliated with any of the mentioned games.
Features:
- Stylized Maps: See your location reinterpreted in the style of your favorite game maps.
- Apple CarPlay: Best turn-by-turn navigation experience available on CarPlay.
- Iconic Inspirations: Choose from map designs inspired by favorite games.
- Navigation Made Fun: Get directions to your desired destinations.
- Personalized Experience: Save your home location for quick and easy access.
Whether you're exploring a new city or navigating your daily route, Game Maps IRL offers a fresh and engaging perspective on mapping technology. Step into a world where the digital meets the real, and experience navigation like never before.
Disclaimer:
Game Maps IRL is an entirely independent and unofficial application. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or in any way associated with the developers or publishers of any game titles. The map styles featured in this app are solely inspired by these popular games to offer a unique, artistic view of your surroundings.
Some features requires in-app purchases. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use — https://retryapps.co/game-maps-irl/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy — https://retryapps.co/game-maps-irl/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00149348:ios.description:
Monitor and stay in control of your home or business from anywhere! Guardian Protection’s mobile app allows for 24/7 interactive security, video monitoring, energy management, and home automation to make life easier, safer, and more connected. Enjoy!
Remote control features:
Arm and disarm your Guardian security system
Watch live or recorded video clips from your security cameras
Turn lights on or off
Adjust thermostat settings
Lock or unlock doors
Open and close garage doors
Change user codes
Receive real-time text or email alert for specific system-related events
View system history
And much more!
Note: This app requires you to be a Guardian Protection customer and subscribe to Guardian’s Remote Home Control Services. Feature availability is based on your system equipment and monitoring services agreement.
Additional benefits:
Guardian will provide monitoring of your system 24/7 and can direct police, fire, and EMS to your home depending upon the signal received and your pre-established protocol.
You can receive real-time non-alarm email, text message, and push notifications for a variety of specific events, for example:
If protected sites within your property experience tampering, e.g.: liquor, gun and medicine cabinets, and even gaming consoles
When your children arrive home from school
When sub-contractors such as cleaning services and sitters arrive to perform work and also when they leave
When the garage door is left open
When a thermostat setting is changed
And much more!
ABOUT GUARDIAN PROTECTION
Protecting homes and businesses since 1950, Guardian Protection is one of the nation’s largest and most highly regarded security companies. We provide smart technology, 24/7 professional monitoring, and peace of mind to hundreds of thousands of customers. Our products are installed by experts, monitored by real people, and truly make a difference — protecting valuables and lives every day. We do what we do because of one simple truth: life is better when it’s safe.

bluejetty:00138095:android.description:
Introducing the enhanced HDFC Bank MobileBanking App, your one-stop solution to a seamless and secure banking experience. Experience the convenience of doing 150+ transactions through our MobileBanking app. Download now for effortless banking, fund transfers, card management, loans, investments, and many more. 
 🔒 Instant Access: 
Experience hassle-free logins via biometric options and a 4-digit login PIN, ensuring the security of your accounts.
 💸 Effortless Transactions: 
Make quick transfers using UPI, ensuring real-time fund transfer. Safeguard your account with the ability to block debit services against fraud. 
🔢 Banking Simplified: 
Get a consolidated view of your account balances, fixed/recurring deposits, credit card bills, and utility bills—all in one dashboard. 
🏦 Deposits Made Easy: 
Book FDs and RDs effortlessly with just a tap, providing a smart way to save money anytime, anywhere. 
💳 Manage Cards Seamlessly: 
Easily apply for credit cards, pay bills, manage cards limits, including blocking or hotlisting lost or stolen cards—all conveniently accessible from one place.
📈 Investment Tracking: 
Track & manage your investments, demat account and effortlessly engage in mutual funds transactions.
📱 Bill Payments On-the-Go: 
Pay utility bills, DTH, electricity, gas and mobile bills instantly. Set up automated monthly payments for added convenience. 
🔄 Quick Money Transfers: 
Transfer funds effortlessly between HDFC Bank accounts or other accounts via IMPS, UPI, NEFT and various payment methods. 
🔒Security Enhancements: 
Your financial security is our top priority. We are continually enhancing the security features for the safety of your account and transactions. With Device Registration for login from a single trusted device and RASP (Runtime Application Security Protection), we protect you from frauds involving remote control apps, data leakage, and screen mirroring.
We have an enhanced layer of security known as Mobile Number Verification. This feature ensures access to your MobileBanking App only through devices with the SIM card of your bank-registered mobile number, significantly boosting protection against cyber fraud and enhancing your account's security.
Please Note, you need to - 
• Ensure the SIM card of your bank-registered mobile number is in your Mobile device.

Free Gifts!

Stay Tuned!

Log in daily to earn special rewards, including the adorable Bunny “Marshmallow” and a cozy bunny hammock, plus much more!
Welcome to Bunny Haven, where the enchantment of bunnies knows no bounds! Hop into this adorable bunny game, where you take the reins of a bunny rescue sanctuary. Adopt adorable rescue bunnies, transform your garden into their loving haven, operate a cozy cafe, and play matchmaker for customers and bunnies!
Features:
- Rescue Cute Bunnies: Embark on a heartwarming journey to rescue a diverse array of cute bunnies, each graced with unique markings, colors, and endearing personalities, making your sanctuary their forever home.
- Style Your Sanctuary: Infuse your sanctuary with your unique aesthetic as you adorn it with charming furniture and accessories. Craft a cozy haven that not only delights your bunny floofs and cafe customers but also mirrors your distinct sense of style.
- Cafe Management: Your responsibilities extend beyond the adorable bunnies, as you'll be in charge of the garden cafe, and serving up scrumptious orders for your cafe customers.
- Match Customers with Bunnies: Pair up cafe customers with their perfect bunny companions and watch heartwarming connections bloom.
- Real-Life Personalities: Every rabbit in Bunny Haven draws inspiration from real-life rabbit species, capturing their quirks and characteristics.
Why Play Bunny Haven?
- Bunny Haven is a relaxing and therapeutic space where you can interact with cute rescue bunny floofs!
- Discover an array of cute bunny species that you'll instantly want to cuddle, watch, and spend quality time with, creating unforgettable memories with your furry friends.
- The decoration mechanic empowers you to transform the garden of Bunny Haven into a reflection of your personal aesthetic. 
- If you're a fan of cafe games, restaurant games, animal games, or pet games, Bunny Haven is a must-try for you!

Do you want to learn about the healing properties of crystals and how you can use them to meditate, calm anxiety stress and sleep better？
Wish you could find your perfect crystal you come across in your travels!
People around the world have become interested in the healing properties of crystals in recent years. But with thousands of different crystals, each with unique and interesting properties, it can be difficult to correctly identify and use them for your own healing journey. 
Healing Pal:Crystal identifier is a powerful app that can identify any crystal in seconds with a quick snap. Simply take a photo of any crystal, wait a few seconds, and you’ll have an accurate identification in no time. Each identification provides a wealth of in-depth information about each crystal. You’ll learn the properties of the crystal, its healing potential, and how to use each one in your own healing journey. As different crystals connect with different chakra points, you’ll begin to access the deeper connection that exists through your whole body, unlocking new pathways for healing and growth.

The result is a complete database of crystals and their healing properties that’ll allow you to explore your consciousness, connect with your body and mind, relieve stress, and more.

- Learn about their properties and healing potential, find your perfect crystal

bluejetty:00175578:ios.description:
Your Elgato capture card or camera now works with iPad! 
Meeting up? Throw your iPad and capture card into your bag. Traveling? Leave your laptop at home. Now you have an ultra-compact yet powerful capture setup that can go anywhere whether you're an aspiring streamer, a content creator, or just want to relive your gaming moments. Connect one of these Elgato devices to your setup and unlock a world of possibilities: 
- HD60 X: Experience crisp, high-quality game capture with ease. 
- HD60 S+: Elevate your streaming game with seamless, low-latency recording. 
- Cam Link 4K: Unleash the potential of 4K video recording. 
- Facecam and Facecam Pro: Perfect for vlogging – try recording with the integrated iPad microphone or connect an Elgato Wave:3. 
With Capture, you have complete control over your recording experience: 
- Custom Video Settings: Choose your preferred video input format, including resolution and frame rate, to ensure your content looks exactly the way you want it. 
- Audio Management: Choose your preferred audio input from your capture device, or the iPad’s integrated front microphone. Toggle passing the audio to the speakers on and off as needed. An integrated audio meter ensures your audio setup is always on point. 
- Capture and Store: Record your gaming sessions, take screenshots, and effortlessly store them in your preferred location – Photo Library, Internal Storage, or even External Storage like a USB SSD or SD card. 
- iPad Monitoring: Utilize your iPad as a dedicated full-screen monitor, so you can game on-the-go.
Elevate your content and share your gaming journey with the world like never before. Download Capture today and start capturing your epic moments with your Elgato devices!
Compatibility:
Works on iPads with native USB-C connector, i.e. iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd generation and later), iPad Pro 11-inch, iPad (10th generation and later), iPad Air (4th generation and later), and iPad mini (6th generation and later). Does not work on iPads with Lightning connector.

bluejetty:00160814:ios.description:
Pizza Maker Kids Cooking Game: Create, Bake & Serve Delicious Pizzas!
Want to own your very own pizza shop? Pizza Maker Kids Cooking Game is here to make all your dreams come true! This fun cooking game is perfect for both boys and girls, inviting you to step into the shoes of a master pizza chef. Get ready to serve customers from all around the world, cater to their unique tastes, and become the most famous chef in town!
Why is Pizza Maker Kids Cooking Game a must-play for kids?
• Over 91 Ingredients to Choose From! Let your culinary creativity run wild with vegetables, meats, seafood, candy, and fruits to create the pizza of your dreams!
• Unexpected Customer Reactions! Will they be happy, frustrated, disgusted, or even breathing fire from the spiciness? Their interactive feedback makes every order exciting!
• Customize Your Chef! With over 700 parts, you can mix and match facial features, outfits, and accessories to create your unique look in this fun chef game!
• Realistic Cooking Animations! Watch your ingredients sizzle and pop in the oven, releasing mouth-watering aromas that might make you crave pizza for dinner tonight!
• Kid-Friendly Controls! Easy to play without parental supervision, making it perfect for kids of all ages.
• Play Offline Anytime, Anywhere! No internet connection needed.
• Safe and Third-Party-Ad-Free! Kids can play safely with no interruptions.
Your pizza shop is now open for business! Let's start making some delicious pizzas:
Take Orders from Hungry Customers! They come from all walks of life: princesses, adventurers, workers, kids, and even wanderers. They’re all starving and can’t wait to taste your handmade pizzas in this exciting restaurant game!
Create Pizzas with a Variety of Toppings! Pick your favorite dough, spread on sauces of different flavors, and make your pizza vibrant with toppings! Did the customer order pepperoni? Add some green peppers and black olives to make it even tastier! Place it in the oven and watch the ingredients sizzle and pop, just like in a real cooking simulator.
Enjoy Hilarious Customer Feedback! Some customers will dance with joy when they get their perfect pizza, while others might hide their eyes if you include ingredients they dislike. Keep them satisfied to grow your pizza shop's reputation!
As your cooking skills and fame spread, customers will flock to your pizza restaurant from all corners of the globe. So, put on your apron, grab your rolling pin, and let’s create some mouth-watering masterpieces in the world of pizza!
Features:
• 91 Ingredients to Choose From: Let your culinary creativity run wild in this ultimate pizza maker game!
• Interactive Customers: Engage with fun and quirky characters in this chef game designed for kids!
• Customize Your Chef: Over 700 items to personalize your character!
• Realistic Cooking Animations: Experience the joy of cooking with lifelike animations!
• Kid-Friendly Controls: Simple and intuitive gameplay suitable for children.
• Offline Play: Enjoy the game anywhere, anytime—no internet required.
• No Third-Party Ads: Play safely with no interruptions.
Download Pizza Maker Kids Cooking Game now and start your cooking adventure today!

bluejetty:00122003:ios.summary: "What's that song? Shazam will instantly identify music playing around you or in apps like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & Snapchat. Discover concerts near you, song lyrics, videos & more. With tens of millions of daily users, Shazam is truste
bluejetty:00122003:ios.description:
"What's that song? Shazam will instantly identify music playing around you or in apps like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & Snapchat. Discover concerts near you, song lyrics, videos & more. With tens of millions of daily users, Shazam is trusted by music lovers worldwide.
Shazam has thousands of five star reviews and is a top rated music app.
""Shazam is a gift... a game changer"" - Pharrell Williams, GQ
""I don't know how we ever survived before Shazam"" - Marshmello
“Shazam is a kind of magic… You hear a song, hold your phone up like a wand and it tells you exactly what song it is, who sang it and lets you add it to your playlist or share it to your social media… How is that not magic?!” - Calum Scott
WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
* Identify music in an instant.
* Discover live shows near you from your favorite artists or through curated recommendations.
* Recognize songs even when you're offline, using headphones or on a different app. 
* Revisit your music discovery history in your library anytime.
* Get recommended songs and playlists similar to the music you’ve discovered.
USE SHAZAM ANYWHERE, ANYTIME
* Enable the Shazam widgets on your Lock Screen or Home Screen.
* Ask Siri: “What’s this song?” to use Shazam hands-free.
* Automate music discovery with the Shazam Shortcut in the Shortcuts app.
CONNECT WITH YOUR MUSIC
* Unlock extras from artists around the world.
* Open any song directly in Apple Music, Spotify, Youtube Music, Amazon Music & Deezer.
* Listen and add songs directly to your Apple Music playlists.
* Watch music videos of the songs you discover in Apple Music or YouTube.
* Follow along to songs with real-time, karaoke-style lyrics.
* See what’s trending locally and globally with Shazam Charts. 
Optional App Permission
▪ Microphone: To identify a song that’s playing around you when you tap to Shazam.
▪ Location: To show you where your songs were identified, display upcoming events in your area, and improve the quality of the service.
▪ Notification: To send you notifications that are personalized based on your Shazam activity.
You can use Shazam even without providing consent to any of the above optional app permissions. However, some features of the service may not be available.
Availability and features may vary by country.
For more information on Shazam's privacy practices, please read the Privacy Policy, available at: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/.
Find out more and get support from AppleCare at: https://support.apple.com/guide/shazam/welcome"

bluejetty:00169998:ios.description:
Welcome to "Offroad Climb 4x4", where the hills are alive with the roar of engines! This isn't just a game; it's an off-road odyssey. Imagine climbing up hills, navigating through a scrapyard of cars, scaling rocky terrains, and conquering snow-laden paths – all from the comfort of your phone.
Each level in "Offroad Climb 4x4" brings a new challenge, demanding skill, guts, and a love for adventure. Choose from a fleet of off-road beasts, each designed to tackle the toughest of terrains. Whether it's a steep gravel track or an icy mountain slope, your driving skills will be put to the ultimate test.
But that's not all – every climb earns you coins, which you can spend on upgrading your ride or boosting your in-game earnings. The better your vehicle, the tougher the levels you can conquer. It's a never-ending cycle of upgrades, challenges, and triumphs!
Whether you're a hardcore off-road enthusiast or just looking for some casual hill-climbing fun, "Offroad Climb 4x4" has something for everyone. So, buckle up, start your engines, and let the off-road adventure begin!
