bluejetty:00122327:ios.description:
Proudly featured on:
https://www.touchtapplay.com/woody-battle-puzzle-tips-guide-to-win-all-your-battles/
https://www.pocketgamer.com/articles/080121/woody-battle-brings-the-block-battling-to-your-phone/
https://www.levelwinner.com/how-to-get-started-in-woody-battle-the-1v1-block-based-puzzler/
It’s smart, competitive and joyously good fun for those who thrive in contests of skill where you can outsmart, outmaneuver, and outplay your opponents.
Woody Battle promises a fair game for all players with its randomly generated blocks. In a match, both players will be given the same blocks set. And the winner is the one who scores higher. And because matches are only three minutes long, you can get a game in anytime.
TOP FEATURES
- Real-time 1v1 battles against real players from across the world
- Live streaming your opponent’s progress
- Replay System allows you to watch previous matches back - with interest. You’ll be able to analyze what went wrong or right. The Replay System is a great tool for both improving your game, as well as creating some amazing in-game clips and sending them to your mates.
- Fight for the top of the leaderboards in global rankings
- When you need something less competitive, play Solo Practice Mode and enjoy endless hours of fun.
- Play with your friends by sharing your Invite Code
HOW TO PLAY
- Drag the given blocks and drop into the grid space.
- Remove the blocks by making a full line horizontally or vertically.
- Get 10 points for each line destroyed
*** Beware! The game will be ended when you don’t have enough space to put a given block into the grid.
HOW TO WIN
- The goal of each player is to reach the target score faster than the opponent before time’s up.
- Each match will be 3 minutes long. After time’s up, if no one reaches the target score, the winner is the one that has higher score.
- If both players are out of moves, the winner is the one that outscores the opponent.
Important notice
Woody Battle is free to play, but you can make some purchases for in-game extra coins (you can disable this in your device settings)
We hope you find this new game fresh and joyful.
CONTACT
For any questions, suggestions, feedbacks or comments, please e-mail us at support-woodybattle@athena.studio
COMMUNITY
Join 30,000+ fellow players for free: https://www.facebook.com/groups/292183968063626/
We will be constantly updating the feature to enhance the experience, improve quality and reliability for you!
Looking forward to hearing from you!
Lots of love.
Woody team

bluejetty:00131205:ios.description:
Want a 99% chance of passing your DMV Permit Test? With DMV WRITTEN TEST you get state-specific DMV practice tests that are the same as the real test.
HOW IT WORKS
• No Need for the Driver's Manual: We provide you with the most up-to-date questions based on the current version of your state's official driver's handbook. Don't be surprised with outdated test questions. We cover every DMV, DDS, BMV, MVA, RMV, DOR, MVC, MVD, DOT, DOL in the country.
• Take Comprehensive Practice Tests: Our tests cover every section of the driver's manual so no matter what state you're in, you'll be well prepared. Go through our practice tests and when you take the real thing, it will seem easy.
• Pass the DMV Test: Once you've practiced enough and are passing the practice exams, you should be ready to make an appointment with the DMV. With a 99% chance of passing, you'll be ready to pass the test the first time!
PRACTICE DMV TESTS MAKE YOU PASS FASTER
A whopping 5 out of 10 people fail the DMV test the first time they take it, but the people that use DMV Written Test see a 99% pass rate. We also let you take every sample DMV permit test and DMV license test as many times as needed so you can be sure you're ready for the real thing.
WHY CHOOSE DMV WRITTEN TEST?
• State-Specific Tests: Because each state has different driving laws and restrictions, we've tailored our tests to each specific state. This isn't one of those generic DMV practice tests. 
• Accurate & Up-to-Date: We constantly monitor the newest versions of your state's official driving handbook and traffic laws and then update our test questions accordingly. They are always accurate and up to date.
• The Same Content: Since we take our facts directly from the handbooks, it allows us to create practice test questions that are very similar, if not identical, to the questions found on the actual driver's license test.
WHY WE’RE SO EFFECTIVE
• Know what to expect: Our tests have the same number of questions and the same passing score requirements as the actual tests so you'll know what to expect.
• Feel confident as you walk into the DMV: You've seen it all before and know what's coming. You got this!
• Stay motivated to study: With our practice tests you'll learn as you go and see your own progress in real time.
HAVE ANY QUESTIONS OR COMMENTS?
If you have any questions, want to report a bug, or notice any errors, feel free to reach out to us.

HOW IT WORKS
The app uses iOS accessibility features to record your exact tap locations, timing intervals, and sequence patterns. You demonstrate the tapping pattern once by manually touching the screen locations you want automated. The app captures coordinates down to the pixel level and records the millisecond timing between each tap. Once recorded, it replays your pattern with mechanical precision — no human variation in timing or location. Sessions can run for preset durations or loop indefinitely until you stop them manually.
KEY FEATURES
- Custom Tap Sequences — Record multi-step tapping patterns with different locations, delays, and repetition counts. Perfect for games that require tapping multiple buttons in sequence or apps with complex navigation flows.
- Precision Timing Controls — Set exact delays between taps from 100 milliseconds to 60 seconds. Essential for games with cooldown periods or apps that need time to load between interactions.
- Multiple Saved Patterns — Store unlimited tapping sequences with custom names and descriptions. Switch between different automation patterns for different games or tasks without re-recording.
- Background Operation — Continue automated tapping while using other apps or when your screen is locked. The automation runs independently of your active app usage.
- Loop and Duration Settings — Run patterns for specific time periods or tap counts, or loop continuously until manually stopped. Includes safety timeouts to prevent accidental infinite loops.
WHO USES THIS APP
- Mobile gamers who play idle clicker games, farming simulators, or RPGs with repetitive grinding mechanics that require constant tapping to progress efficiently. These players want to maintain game progress without developing repetitive strain injuries.
- App testers and developers who need to simulate user interactions for quality assurance testing. They use automated tapping to stress-test apps, simulate heavy usage patterns, or test user interface responsiveness under consistent load.
- Accessibility users who have limited mobility or dexterity challenges that make repetitive tapping difficult or painful. The automation provides an alternative way to interact with apps that require frequent touch inputs.
- Productivity users who work with apps that lack proper automation features and require repetitive manual interactions. They automate routine tasks like form filling, data entry, or navigating through multi-step processes.
HOW TO GET STARTED
1. Open the app and grant accessibility permissions in iOS Settings
2. Position your target app or game on screen
3. Tap Record and demonstrate your desired tapping pattern
4. Set timing delays and repetition preferences
5. Save your pattern and tap Start to begin automation
Tip: Start with simple single-tap patterns before creating complex sequences. Test timing settings with short durations first.

bluejetty:00025783:ios.description:
Welcome to the sweet kitchen!
Get ready for a delightful adventure in the world of confectionery with our interactive game designed for children aged 3 to 5. Here your little ones can unleash their creativity while learning about the joy of baking and making delicious sweets. Let's dive into the sugary fun! No third-party advertising.
Features:
~ Variety of sweet recipes
Our game offers a wide array of delicious treats to prepare, including cakes, cupcakes, éclairs, donuts, lollipops, and chocolates. Kids can simply choose their favorite dessert and follow easy recipes and on-screen hints to prepare it step by step.
~ Interactive cooking experience
Kids can immerse themselves in the virtual kitchen and enjoy a variety of hands-on activities that improve their motor skills and coordination. The intuitive controls and vibrant visuals make the cooking process both fun and educational.
~ Creative Freedom
Let their imaginations run wild! Little kids can personalize their creations by choosing from a wide range of decorations, frostings, sprinkles, and toppings. Whether it's a rainbow-colored cake or a chocolate-covered donut, the possibilities are endless.
~ Fun Learning
While having fun in the kitchen, children learn basic cooking techniques like mixing, baking and decorating without mess or risk of burns. Kids learn how to follow instructions, develop their cognitive abilities and complete tasks step by step.

bluejetty:00070943:ios.summary: Justice is in your hands – step into the shoes of a top-tier investigator in "Unsolved Case: Fatal Clue", the free-to-play crime investigation of hidden object games. Unravel unsolved mysteries games packed with intrigue, and bring justice
bluejetty:00070943:ios.description:
Justice is in your hands – step into the shoes of a top-tier investigator in "Unsolved Case: Fatal Clue", the free-to-play crime investigation of hidden object games. Unravel unsolved mysteries games packed with intrigue, and bring justice to a dangerous world of crime. With cunning criminals and elusive clues, your skills to find hidden objects will be put to the ultimate test. Solve mystery games, clever puzzles, and interact with suspicious witnesses to uncover the truth. Are you ready, Detective?
You have a new case. An architecture firm employee has been murdered, and it happened in Central Park. It's an unprecedented act of violence, and the bureau's image could be damaged. Scott Matthews has volunteered to work with you on this case. Turns out being a brilliant detective doesn’t mean having great people skills, so it falls to you to gain the witnesses' trust. Remember, none of them will share information with you willingly, be creative. 
- Hidden Object Gameplay!
Explore detailed crime scenes as you take on a variety of hidden object games. From crowded offices to eerie parks, every location is packed with clues waiting to be uncovered. Be prepared for solving puzzles or tracking down intricate details, finding hidden objects is at the heart of your investigation!
- Crime Investigation!
Join gripping detective games as you tackle the murder of an architecture firm employee in Central Park. Uncover motives, gather evidence, and play unsolved mysteries games that will keep you guessing until the very end!
- Dynamic Storytelling!
Gain the trust of uncooperative witnesses and navigate a web of lies in one of the most exciting unsolved mysteries games. Your choices and actions determine how well you can find hidden objects and extract critical information.
- Strategic Witness Interactions!
Charm, persuade, or outsmart reluctant witnesses to uncover hidden truths in our detective games. As you find hidden objects, collect unique items that enhance your investigative prowess. Enjoy a world where every decision impacts your ability to solve unsolved mysteries games!
Prepare to unravel the most complex crime investigation yet in "Unsolved Case: Fatal Clue". Download and play now for free!
-----

bluejetty:00120017:ios.description:
Learn CFOP, the most popular speedcubing method, one case at a time. Every F2L, OLL and PLL algorithm, with flashcards, quizzes and a timed drill to make them stick.
EVERY CASE OF CFOP
• 41 F2L, 57 OLL and 21 PLL cases, plus 2-Look OLL and 2-Look PLL to get you started.
• Alternative algorithms for many cases: pick the one that suits your hands, or write your own. The editor checks that it solves the case.
• Watch any algorithm on a 3D cube, and tap a move to play up to it.
• See any F2L, OLL or PLL case from each of its four angles, and write the algorithm for that angle, or create it from your Front one.
• Setup moves for each case, and room for your own alias and note.
• Search by name, alias, group or note.
LEARN WITH FLASHCARDS
• Add the cases you are working on to Learning.
• Spaced repetition brings each card back when it is due. Grade it Again, Hard, Good or Easy.
• Practice your hard, new or random cards whenever you like.
• Report: a heat map of your study days, your streak, and what is due in the next 7 days.
PRACTICE UNTIL IT IS AUTOMATIC
• OLL and PLL Recognition Quizzes: name the case from its pattern, against the clock.
• 2-Sided PLL Quiz: name the PLL case from the top and the two sides you see, as on the cube in your hands.
• Random AUF and Random Front Color: meet each case with its top layer turned, and in every color.
• F2L Corner Quiz: name the sticker a corner hides.
• Execution Drill: time a case and beat your best.
GUIDES
• The CFOP method step by step: Overview, Cross, F2L, OLL and PLL. The Cross guide starts from the daisy, for a first cross.
• Example Solve: watch one whole solve on the 3D cube, with every step and case named.
• Notation, with every move shown on a cube.
• Finger Patterns: the triggers and grips behind fast turning.
MADE FOR THE WAY YOU CUBE
• Your color scheme and the way you hold the cube.
• Light, Dark or System appearance.
• English, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese or German, switched right in the app.
• iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with two-column layouts on wide screens and hardware keyboard shortcuts.
One purchase. No ads, no subscription, no account and no usage analytics.

bluejetty:00090752:ios.description:
Make screen time meaningful with Giggle Academy, the free English learning app for children. Through fun educational games, interactive stories and speaking activities, children build English skills while enjoying every lesson.
Giggle Academy helps children develop vocabulary, phonics, reading, listening and speaking through a structured learning journey designed by educators. Every lesson is interactive, engaging and encourages children to learn with confidence.
WHY CHILDREN LOVE GIGGLE ACADEMY
- Learn English through fun educational games for kids
- Interactive speaking practice
- Engaging stories that build vocabulary
- Structured lessons that grow with every kid
- Rewards that keep kids motivated
- Track learning progress
- No ads
- No payments or subscriptions
- Completely free
LEARN ENGLISH THROUGH PLAY
Children learn best when learning feels like play. Giggle Academy combines kids learning games with interactive activities that help children practise English naturally while having fun. Our AI-guided animated lessons achieve over 95% speaking participation, while gaining attention and keeping children motivated.
Children can explore hundreds of lessons that introduce new words, reinforce learning through repetition and build confidence one step at a time. It is the perfect preschool learning and kindergarten learning companion.
SPEAK ENGLISH WITH CONFIDENCE
Learning a language means speaking it. Interactive speaking activities encourage children to listen, repeat and answer questions while practising their pronunciation and communication skills. Regular speaking practice helps children speak English confidently in everyday situations.
INTERACTIVE STORIES CHILDREN LOVE
Stories help children discover new words, improve listening skills and understand English in context. Interactive stories make learning enjoyable while reinforcing vocabulary and supporting reading development. 
STRUCTURED LEARNING PATH
Giggle Academy offers a structured curriculum that guides children through English step by step. This includes activities that develop:
- Vocabulary
- Speaking and pronunciation
- Conversation skills
- Listening
- Phonics and letter sounds
- Reading
- Early literacy
- Creativity (drawing, music)
STAY MOTIVATED WITH REWARDS
As children complete lessons, they unlock new activities, earn English rewards and continue exploring more games, stories and learning experiences.
TRACK LEARNING PROGRESS
View completed lessons, monitor progress and watch your child grow more confident with every activity. Clearly see which skills the child is mastering and where more practice is needed.
EXPLORE HUNDREDS OF LESSONS
From first words to conversations, Giggle Academy is packed with games, stories and speaking activities that keep children learning every day. 
BEYOND ENGLISH: STORIES, SONGS & MORE
Discover children’s stories, picture book stories, bedtime stories, nursery rhymes, children’s songs, flashcard vocabulary activities, interactive workbooks and English speaking practice—all in one app. Giggle Academy offers a growing collection of English learning content for children and families to enjoy together.
Parents who are exploring educational apps such as Duolingo ABC, Khan Academy Kids, and Lingokids can also discover Giggle Academy’s free English learning experience.
NO ADS. NO PAYMENTS OR SUBSCRIPTIONS. FREE LEARNING.
Giggle Academy is designed to provide a safe learning experience for children. It is a child-friendly learning environment with continuous access to learning content. Enjoy offline access to learn anytime, anywhere, even without an internet connection. Unlike some apps that require a paid upgrade, we give you everything upfront: 100% free, with no in-app purchases, no ads, and no hidden fees.
Download Giggle Academy today and discover a fun, engaging way to learn English for kids.
Giggle Academy official website: https://giggleacademy.com/
Email: info@giggleacademy.com
X：https://x.com/GiggleAcademy

bluejetty:00176091:ios.description:
Help your baby fall asleep – the easy, calm way
Baby Sleep is the simplest way to soothe your child (and yourself!) to sleep. Pick one of 28 calming sounds, press play, and let the gentle endless loop do the work. No complicated settings – just sleep.
28 SOOTHING SOUNDS IN 5 CATEGORIES
• Nature: rain, ocean waves, campfire, forest, stream, night, heartbeat and waterfall
• White noise: three different flavours of classic white noise
• Lullabies: gentle music box melodies
• Home: kitchen hood, fan, hair dryer, vacuum cleaner, washing machine, shower, radio, clock, refrigerator and a purring cat
• Transport: car, bus, airplane and train – the sounds that always put babies to sleep
SLEEP TIMER WITH GENTLE FADE-OUT
Set the timer from 1 minute to 8 hours. The sound slowly fades out so your baby is never woken by a sudden stop.
GENTLE NIGHT DESIGN
Choose whether the app follows your phone's theme or stays always light or always dark. The starry night theme is easy on the eyes in a dark nursery.
PERFECT LOOP – ALL NIGHT LONG
Every sound plays in a seamless loop with no gaps or clicks – even with the screen off and your iPhone locked. Control playback right from the Lock Screen and Control Center.
WHY WHITE NOISE WORKS
White noise and monotonous sounds resemble the sounds of the womb and mask sudden noises that can wake your baby. It helps newborns, toddlers and adults with restlessness, colic or tinnitus fall asleep faster and sleep deeper.
- FREE to use
- Works with the screen off
- Sleep timer with fade-out
- English and Danish
Download Baby Sleep today – for calmer evenings and better nights for the whole family

bluejetty:00136534:ios.description:
Help Anna Gray find her daughter and husband after disappearing on Thanksgiving Day!
Play the hidden object game, solve puzzles, find lost items and enjoy mystery detective!
________________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to solve the mystery of Grim Tales 24: All Shades of Black? Immerse yourself in a mystery detective game and solve puzzles. Be a detective, search and find all the hidden objects and find out the solution to the Gray family's disappearance!
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game.
You can get the full walkthrough by means of an in-app purchase.
Dorian, Anna and Alice go to the Crimson Hollow mansion to celebrate Thanksgiving Day. Suddenly, during the festive dinner, Dorian crumbles into dust, and Alice disappears in front of Anna's eyes. Moreover, Anna discovers that Dorian’s portrait has gone missing. Where did the portrait go? What happened to Alice and Dorian? How will helping Anna affect Anastasia Grim? Find out all this in an exciting hidden object adventure!
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO DORIAN AND ALICE
Travel back in time, solve puzzles and mini-games, find clues, explore hidden object scenes and find out why Dorian and Alice Gray disappeared and who is responsible for their disappearance.
FIND OUT WHO IS RESPONSIBLE FOR DISAPPEARANCE OF ALICE AND DORIAN
Anna continues searching for clues connected with the disappearance of Dorian and Alice. She gets on the trail of the artist who painted Dorian's portrait, but someone insistently doesn't want Anna to be able to return her loved ones. Will Anna Gray be able to save her family and defeat a new evil?
FIND OUT WHAT THE PAINTED WORLD IS HIDING IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Play as Anna Gray and find out what happened to the artist who painted Dorian's portrait. Travel to the past and new worlds. Face a new threat looming over Anna's future and prove yourself.
Grim Tales 24: All Shades of Black is a hidden object game where you need to seek and find missing objects like Sherlock. Be a detective and find out why Anna's family disappeared at the party in this mystery detective game!
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, and more!
Zoom in on the scenes to help search and find all hidden objects, and use hints if you get stuck.

bluejetty:00157288:ios.description:
How It Works:
1. Snap a Photo: Take a pic of your homework / test / assignment
2. Get instant answers that click*
3. Solve and Win your school game
4. Easy exam prep: Past answers and explanations saved for you for test preparations
+5. Automatic subject detection
+6. Two AI modes supported: swift mode for everyday tasks and deep thinking mode for complex problems
Our smart AI delivers A+ results fast, so you can save time and boost your grades.
Why It’s Awesome:
• Ask Unlimited Questions: No limits - math, science, english, anything.
• Scan & Solve: Snap it, solve it - in seconds.
• Exam prep: We save every Q&A for you makes this app the prefect study companion.
• State of the art AI: Accurate results, every time.
• Turn tough problems into A+ wins.
• No more manual subject selecting: All subjects and topics are recognized automatically by our smart algorithm
• Switch anytime between swift & deep thinking AI mode. Works for any subject
School just got easier - Download Now and start winning!
----------
What is ThinkAssist?
ThinkAssist is an AI homework & assignment helper with automatic subject detection and detailed, step-by-step explanations. With two AI mode available:
swift mode for most problems and deep thinking mode for complex queries and hard math problems.
What makes ThinkAssist different?
ThinkAssist isn't just a solver; it’s a personalized AI Tutor for iOS. We utilize advanced AI to generate detailed, step-by-step logic for every solution. Whether you are stuck on a complex Calculus graph or need to outline a History essay, ThinkAssist breaks down the "how" and "why" so you actually learn the material.
How does the homework scanning work? Can it read handwriting?
Yes, it can read handwriting. Our built-in scanner uses advanced AI models to instantly analyze your assignment. You can snap a photo of a textbook, a digital screen, or even handwritten notes. The app automatically detects the subject - be it Geometry, Chemistry, or Literature - and provides an instant, accurate solution.
What math subjects can ThinkAssist solve step-by-step?
ThinkAssist covers the full K-12 and University math curriculum. Our deep-thinking mode handles:
- Basic Math & Pre-Algebra
- Algebra I & II (Linear equations, inequalities, polynomials)
- Geometry & Trigonometry
- Calculus (Derivatives, integrals, limits)
- Statistics & Probability
We show every single step of the calculation, so you can check your work and understand the methodology for exams.
Can this app help with word problems and non-math subjects? What subjects are supported?
Yes. ThinkAssist is a multi-subject scholar. You can upload word problems, history questions, or science concepts (Biology, Physics, Chemistry). The AI parses the text within the image, identifies the core question, and delivers a comprehensive explanation, not just a numerical result.
Is it suitable for exam preparation and test review?
Yes, absolutely. The app features a "Smart History" function that saves all your scanned queries and solutions. You can use this to create personalized study guides, review past difficult problems, and practice methodologies before your midterms or finals. It’s like having a 24/7 tutor in your pocket.
What about complex problems?
In the app you can switch between two modes: swift mode for everyday tasks and deep thinking mode for complex and hard problems. If you are not satisfied with the result - just turn on ThinkDeep mode and we guarantee you will get the results you want.
Does the app simply do the homework for me?
Yes. ThinkAssist is designed as an educational tool to unblock students who are stuck by providing immediate answers and granular explanations.
Can I use it for language learning?
Yes. Even though ThinkAssist is not a specific *language learning app*, thanks to the flexible and user friendly interface, combined with a powerful AI backend it is a perfect tool for language learning.
ThinkAssist - Homework Made Easy
* Requires subscription

Welcome to State .io, the epic strategy game that lets you conquer an alternative world! In this cell battle game, you'll command your troops to capture all the states while challenging your logic and reaction time.
State .io is an abstract real-time strategy game, a tactical clash of dots, and an exciting countries takeover. Fight against armies by solving strategic puzzles to beat your rivals and expand your superiority in the world arena. Lead your army to victory in this epic battle game and become a war strategy winner!

This war simulator demands tactics, not power. You are to use your brain, not muscles. Become a hero by solving tactical dot puzzles! You will definitely have a lot of fun struggling on different maps we have added especially for you.

bluejetty:00085715:ios.description:
MyBible helps you study, explore, and read the Bible, always having it with you without requiring an Internet connection. Bible translations are available in more than three hundred languages, including original texts and ancient translations in Ancient Greek, Biblical Hebrew, and Aramaic, as well as biblical and explanatory dictionaries and commentaries.
More detailed information about the project, as well as a description of the module format, is available at:
https://mybible.zone
FEATURES:
 • Bible text display settings: viewing all chapters of a book (not just one chapter at a time), grouping verses into paragraphs, headings, displaying verses with or without numbering, highlighting the words of Jesus, night mode.
 • Two or three Bible windows with different translations; the windows are automatically synchronized to the current position but can also operate independently.
 • Fast search within the Bible text.
 • Working with the Bible text: convenient paging and scrolling, categorized bookmarks, comparison of selected verses across different translations.
 • Built-in information on differences between chapter numbering traditions in the books of Psalms, Job, and Song of Songs (Masoretic tradition and the Septuagint tradition). This feature is currently available only for selected translations and enables correct parallel reading.
 • Auxiliary tools that can be displayed within the Bible text: cross-references, links to commentaries, Strong’s numbers.
 • Display of dictionary entries by double-tapping a word in the Bible text. Dictionary word search.
 • Strong’s numbers and Strong’s Lexicon: activated by double-tapping a word or a Strong’s number; searching by Strong’s number can replace a printed concordance.
 • Display of commentaries.
 • Copying selected verses and verses found through search.
BIBLE TRANSLATIONS AND OTHER MODULES:
MyBible provides Bible translations and dictionaries that are not protected by copyright (public domain), collected from various sources and converted into the MyBible format.

- 인쇄가 아닌 정통 은염 인화방식을 고집하는 이유,

- 3X5 기본 사이즈부터 넉넉한 A3사이즈까지,
다양한 사이즈로 인화하세요.

[ 아크릴 압착 사진, 사진액자, 대형사진, 콜라주 ]
- 내 사진 넣은 고품질 액자를 빠르게 주문할 수 없을까?
- 스마트폰 사진도 크게 뽑을 수 없을까? 
- 베스트샷이 너무 많은데 하나로 모을 수 없을까?
- 사진을 내 마음대로 편집한 사진상품을 만들 수 없을까?
- 사진에 대한 고민을 모두 해결할 대형사진+로
사진 이상의 사진상품을 경험해 보세요. 

[ 포토카드 ETERNY ]
- 가속열화시험으로 타사 대비 뛰어난 보존력이
증명된 진짜 사진 포토카드에요. 
- 무광 인화지를 양면 접합한 형태로
앞뒷면 모두에 사진을 넣을 수 있어요. 
- 변색 없이, 영원히 유지되는 고화질 사진 굿즈로
내 최애를 가장 귀하게 소장하세요.
 
[ 포토캘린더 ]
- 날짜만 확인하는 달력이 아닌, 내 사진을 담아 
추억과 시간을 함께 보내는 데스크테리어 소품이에요.
- 기념일, 중요한 약속은 일정 추가 기능으로 
달력에 기록해 보세요.

bluejetty:00171445:ios.description:
Discover the true value of your collectibles with the Collectibles.com app! Whether it's coins, comics, cards, or other rarities – our app provides you with all the tools you need to effortlessly manage and evaluate your collection.
Unleash the power of our AI-driven app for collectors to easily identify and appraise your valuable collectibles. With just a few clicks, you can scan any collectible and determine its value.
Join our community of collectors where you can connect with like-minded enthusiasts, share your passion, and discover hidden treasures. From trading cards and vintage toys to coins, comics, and rare sports memorabilia – Collectibles.com highlights the stories and personal experiences behind each valuable collectible.
Features that enhance your collecting experience:
► Scan and Identify: Use the integrated AI to scan collectibles and determine their value in real time.
► Valuation: Instantly find out what your collectibles are worth and stay updated with current market prices.
► Personal Profile: Showcase your unique collection on a personalized profile page and share your passion with the world.
► Collection Management: Organize and track your entire collection in one place – accessible anytime, anywhere.
► Market Comparison: View price trends and current sales values in the collector’s market.
► Discover New Collectibles: Explore new collectibles, popular categories, and learn from the expertise within our community.
► Get Rewarded: Earn points for your contributions and exchange them for exclusive perks and rewards to make your collecting journey even more rewarding.
► Explore Various Categories: Coins, stamps, watches, jewelry, art, video games, books, antiques, comics, wines, sneakers, postcards, toys, trading cards.
Whether you are an experienced collector or just starting out, Collectibles.com is your ultimate companion. With Collectibles.com, you have everything you need as a collector in one app. Download the app now and discover the true value of your collection!

Privacy Policy: https://collectibles.com/privacy
Questions or comments? Let us know: support@collectibles.com

Formerly known as Cardbase, we started in 2020 as a valuation and collection management service for sports cards. Thank you for your support!

bluejetty:00033998:ios.name: Electoral college map USA 2024
bluejetty:00033998:ios.summary: The 2024 Electoral College Vote Map app is an interactive visualization tool that allows users to explore potential outcomes of the U.S. presidential election. The map displays all 50 states and the District of Columbia, each represented by
bluejetty:00033998:ios.description:
The 2024 Electoral College Vote Map app is an interactive visualization tool that allows users to explore potential outcomes of the U.S. presidential election. The map displays all 50 states and the District of Columbia, each represented by a specific number of electoral votes, determined by the U.S. Census. This tool is designed to help users understand the importance of swing states and how different voting scenarios can affect the overall result.
Key Features:
1. Interactive Elements: Users can click on individual states to change their electoral outcome between Democratic, Republican, or undecided. The total electoral votes for each candidate update in real-time based on these selections.
2. Color-Coded Representation: States are color-coded based on party affiliation: traditionally, blue represents Democratic votes, red represents Republican votes, and gray indicates undecided or uncommitted states.
3. Vote Tally: The map includes a tally of electoral votes for each candidate, helping users visualize the path to the necessary 270 electoral votes needed to win the presidency.
4. Scenario Analysis: Users can simulate various election scenarios, such as flipping specific swing states or considering the impact of third-party candidates.
The 2024 Electoral College Vote Map is an excellent educational tool for students, teachers, and anyone interested in American politics. It offers a hands-on way to learn about the Electoral College process, the significance of each state in the election, and the potential impact of voter turnout and campaign strategies.
This tool is invaluable for political enthusiasts, analysts, and educators, offering a clear and interactive way to understand and predict the outcomes of the 2024 U.S. presidential election. By engaging with the map, users gain a deeper appreciation of the complexities and dynamics of the Electoral College system.

Be a space goat and build a space colony by headbutting people and taking their money. Who knows best how to spend it but a goat? Build a Command bridge training simulator, a space museum or even your very own spaceship. Shoot down asteroids and space pirates or travel to a nearby planet.

* Be the first goat in space
* Crowdfund a space colony and get other people to pay for it and do all the work!

* There is one planet nearby though. Go to that one
* Learn how to be a real bridge commander like that spock dude from mars or whatever
* The biggest map in goat simulator history
* So much content you will have to charge your phone lots of times
* Tons of unlockable goats with special powers - Create black holes, 3D print stuff in the world and fling people with your mind

FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
Enter an enchanting world of legends and magic, filled with gloomy forests, forbidden temples, and abandoned castles; a realm of dark secrets, where your destiny was written long before your birth...
Within the shadow of an ancient forest, on the bottom of a foggy valley, stands the lonely village of Ravenbrook. The folk there are cheerful and diligent, yet warily superstitious. They surround the village with countless charms to keep the evil spirits at bay, for on the other side of the forest, there lies a seemingly bottomless pit, known as the Abyss. It is the place the villagers of Ravenbrook fear most...
On this night, a young woman is returning home for her twin sister’s wedding. The sisters haven’t seen each other in years. Yet the invitation was strange, almost as if someone else wrote it, other than her twin. But still she comes, ignorant of the danger that awaits...
For just before the wedding, amidst the happiness and reverie, a stranger arrived in Ravenbrook...

• 39 beautiful, hand-painted locations

bluejetty:00063733:ios.description:
Enter the battlefield in Modern Ops, a pure first-person shooter (FPS) focused entirely on tactical gunplay, precision aiming, and real-time firefight engagements. Designed for players who want authentic multiplayer FPS combat, the game delivers fast TTK battles, accurate shooting mechanics, and skill-driven gunfights.
Battle players from all around the world in epic military operations!
Dive into the best online shooter on iOS and prove your combat skills!
TRUE FIRST-PERSON COMBAT
Modern Ops provides accurate hit registration and responsive aiming. Master headshots, control angles, predict enemy movement, and secure key positions in intense encounters that reward pure shooting skill.
COMPETITIVE MULTIPLAYER FPS MODES
Fight in real-time 5v5 FPS matches, classic team firefights, and fast-paced deathmatches. Every mode is built around gunplay, tactical positioning, and coordinated pushes without RPG, survival, or casual elements.
MODERN FIREARMS AND SHOOTER ACTION
Equip a full modern arsenal including assault rifles, carbines, SMGs, LMGs, shotguns, sniper rifles, pistols, and tactical grenades. Customize sights, barrels, grips, and other attachments to refine your preferred playstyle and dominate every firefight.
TACTICAL MAPS BUILT FOR GUNFIGHTS
Each map offers flanking routes, cover-based combat, long sightlines, and CQB zones. Use positioning, crossfire, and smart engagement timing to outplay opponents with superior tactics and shooting accuracy.
RANKED FPS COMPETITION
Climb through competitive leagues by winning pure skill-based shooter matches. Matchmaking prioritizes meaningful FPS metrics such as accuracy, K/D, and overall combat impact to ensure fair and intense battles.
ESSENTIAL SHOOTER FEATURES
- Authentic first-person shooter gameplay
- Real-time multiplayer gunfights with up to 10 players
- Modern weapon classes with unique stats
- Tactical 5v5 FPS modes focused on aim and positioning
- Precision ADS aiming and headshot-focused combat
- Weapon attachments and loadout customization
- Killstreaks for advanced tactical control
- Stable performance and low-latency firefights
- Regular shooter-focused updates
PURE FPS. PURE SKILL.
Modern Ops is built for players who want competitive first-person gun combat with no distractions — just aim, accuracy, and tactical execution.
FOLLOW US
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Modern_Ops/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/modernopsofficial/
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCtVNQDXXPifEsXpYilxVWcA
SUPPORT
info@edkongames.com
Internet connection required.

bluejetty:00021600:ios.summary:
Hey all novel lovers!
We are InkTale – a carefully crafted reading app dedicated to bringing readers wonderful stories from around the world. Whether you enjoy heartwarming romance, imaginative fantasy, or engaging fictional tales, InkTale
bluejetty:00021600:ios.description:
Hey all novel lovers!
We are InkTale – a carefully crafted reading app dedicated to bringing readers wonderful stories from around the world. Whether you enjoy heartwarming romance, imaginative fantasy, or engaging fictional tales, InkTale offers a vast and growing library for every book lover.
We feature original English stories created by talented authors from all over the globe. Our rich collection includes many beloved genres such as heartwarming romance, imaginative fantasy, charming teen stories, heartfelt contemporary fiction, and imaginative werewolf-themed tales focused on friendship, destiny, and emotional connections.
Popular genres loved by our readers include:
· Heartwarming romance and sweet love stories
· Fantasy tales filled with magic and adventure
· Werewolf stories centered on fate, destiny, and emotional bonds
· Youth and coming-of-age stories
· Modern romance and heartfelt relationships
· Engaging long-form series and concise short stories
With over a million chapters of genuine, high-quality stories, you can always find something that fits your mood. Explore popular titles such as Honey, Let's Get Married, Ex-husband's Regrets Worth Nothing, Poor Luna, His Regret: Carrying the Alpha's Hidden Son, and many more exclusive stories updated regularly.
We strive to provide the best reading experience possible:
· Enjoy daily new chapter updates from your favorite series
· Discover trending books through our curated rankings
· Clear and detailed categories to help you find your next favorite read
· Personalized recommendations based on your reading habits
· Adjustable fonts, text sizes, and eye-friendly night mode
· Free rewards and coins to unlock premium content
· Easy-to-use interface that supports reading anytime, anywhere
InkTale also supports aspiring authors to share their creativity with the world:
· Publish your own stories and reach millions of readers
· Gain exposure through our in-app and social promotion channels
· Receive professional guidance and editor support
· Participate in writing courses to improve your skills
· Earn fair rewards and revenue share for your work
Join millions of readers and writers in our growing community. Whether you love reading or creating stories, InkTale is the perfect place for you.
Download InkTale now and step into a wonderful world of stories.
[Subscription Agreement]
1. Service Name: Week Subscription
2. Subscription Period: 1 week
3. Subscription Price: $19.99(1 week) 
4. Subscription Benefits: subscribers can claim 200 coins every day
5. Buying a weekly subscription service will automatically debit your iTunes account and extend the service period of one week 24 hours before the week service expires.
6. If you want to unsubscribe, please open the iOS "Settings" --> enter "iTunes Store and App Store"
-> click "Apple ID", select "View Apple ID", go to the "Account Settings" page, click "Subscribe" ", choose Week Subscription to unsubscribe. If you do not unsubscribe at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period, this subscription will be automatically renewed.
User Agreement: https://www.inktale.net/#/userAgree
Privacy Policy: https://www.inktale.net/#/privacy

bluejetty:00185420:ios.description:
Welcome to HD Poker - Join Millions in the Ultimate Poker Showdown!
Get your friends together and crush the competition in HD Poker — the ultimate place to Unlock your Happy Within™ with the best vibes and an awesome community!
Experience poker in High Def and jump into a massively multiplayer casino world. Compete with players worldwide for chips and prizes — build your bankroll to billions and climb the ranks to become a poker champion.
CREATE YOUR CREW – Invite friends and family to your private tables or jump into thrilling Sit & Go’s, Shootouts, and Time Bomb tournaments. Customize your tables and avatars for a unique poker experience.
FREE CHIPS – Start with a welcome gift of $5,000,000 FREE chips and collect a free bonus every 4 hours. Every 5th collection earns you a Bonus Chest packed with chips and prizes!
AWESOME FREE WELCOME CHEST – Pop your first checst and start with tickets to spin the Super Mega Wheel, an avatar, two poker rooms, and two XP boosts!
HOME GAMES – Create your own private tables and play with friends. Customize your table and make it uniquely yours!
SIT & GO’S – Play fast-paced single-table tournaments with thrilling prize pools and compete for the top spot!
MTT TOURNAMENTS – Join exciting multi-table tournaments with massive prize pools and intense competition. Rise through the ranks in large-scale events and prove your poker skills!
TIME BOMBS – Experience intense, fast SnGs where the bomb explodes and all players go All-In. Spin the wheel for huge prizes and try to gain the chip lead before it’s too late!
CUSTOMIZE – Personalize your HD Poker experience with hundreds of avatars and vote for your favorite poker rooms.
CHEST DROPS – Feel the suspense when a random chest drops into the pot during the hand. Win the main pot, win the chest!
TRADE – Build your collection and trade with friends for avatars, chests, keys, poker rooms, emotes, and more.
VIP SYSTEM – Unlock exclusive rewards, bonuses, and privileges as you climb the VIP ranks. The more you play, the better your perks!
GO PRO – Climb the Trophy Leaderboard globally and for your country. Earn trophies for winning hands and skillful play. Rank up weekly to earn the best rewards.
PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS – Invite friends to join HD Poker and earn an exclusive Referral Chest! Send them a link by tapping an empty seat at a table.
JACKPOTS – Hit a Royal Flush or trigger the Bad Beat Jackpot for massive chip wins! Watch out for the Mega Drop every 4 hours!
MINI GAMES – Use tickets to spin the Super Mega Wheel and win the biggest prizes.
PLAY ANYWHERE – Link your account at hd.io and take your progress across Mobile, Desktop, and Web — play anytime, anywhere.
ALWAYS EVOLVING – Look forward to new avatars, poker rooms, special events, and game modes coming soon!
Join the action now and start crushing the competition! Download HD Poker today and embark on an epic poker adventure!
PLEASE NOTE! HD Poker is free to download and play. Some items can be purchased with real money. Manage purchases in your device settings. An internet connection is required.

Facebook: facebook.com/hdpoker

Discord: discord.gg/hdpoker
Visit us at: www.hdpoker.com

bluejetty:00061975:ios.description:
Strengthen your faith and stay connected to every prayer with Athan, the all-in-one Islamic companion trusted by millions of Muslims worldwide.
Prayer Times Widget:
Athan's Prayer Times Widget is available now to see daily Prayer Times right on your device’s home screen. It is simple, convenient and completely free for all users.
Daily Goals, Tasks and Streaks:
Simplify your daily spiritual Islamic lifestyle with Athan. Complete the following Daily Goals and Tasks to become a better Muslim:
1- Log Your daily Five Prayer
2- Listen to Al-Quran
3- Complete a Daily Tasbih / Dhikr
4- Optional Tasbih / Dhikr (Tasbih Counter)
5- Give Sadaqah (Optional)
6- Offer Nafl Prayer (Optional)
7- Customize Daily Goals as per your need
Athan is the most trusted prayer time app for accurate Salah times and also includes features: 
- Prayer Times with Azan Alarm:
- Athan Stories (short Islamic Videos) with Infinite Scrolling
- Al-Quran with Audio
- Dua & Athkar
- Qibla finder
- Menstrual Mode for Women
- Islamic calendar
- Tasbih Counter
- Hajj and Umrah Guides
Azan Alarm & Prayer Times:
- Accurate prayer times worldwide for daily Five Prayer
- Listen to adhan five times a day by enabling azan notifications / azan alarm
- View the remaining time for each Salat & see accurate Muslim prayer times of the entire day
- Never miss any of the daily Five Prayers alongwith sunrise and Qiyam time through app notificiation
Athan Stories (short Islamic Videos):
Athan Stories is a feature where you can watch and learn new things about Islam on a daily basis through short Islamic videos with infinite scrolling.
Al Quran:
- Read the Holy Quran in English and other 45+ languages Translations & transliterations
- Bookmark surah & ayah of your choice Quran for iPhone
- Get 2 free Holy Quran themes
- Shareability of any ayah from the azan app on social media
- Lookup any word, surah or ayah in the search bar on Quran for iPhone
- Adjust font size & switch translations and transliterations on/off
Menstrual Mode for Women
Athan’s Menstrual Mode is a convenient experience for women's Prayer needs. 
- Mark Prayers as excused 
- Duas you can during menstruation
- Dua & Athkar reminder 
- Customized notifications
Dua / Athkar (Supplications):
- Quranic and masnoon supplications / athkar & dua
- Dua of the day card to strengthen your Imaan, daily Athkar & dua
- Listen to Duas with Dua Audio
Tasbih Counter:
- Count your daily Dhikr, Tasbihat and Wazaif with the help of Tasbih
- Complete Tasbeeh e Fatima with Tasbeeh Counter
- Tasbeeh Counter with dark and light color themes
- User friendly Tasbeeh Counter for Azkar and Dua’s
- Make Tasbihat and Azkar with Tasbih (تسبيح) counter/Dhikr Counter
Qibla Finder:
Integrated Qibla finder / Qibla compass / Qibla direction worldwide with the help of our Qibla finder feature
Gregorian and Islamic Calendar / Hijri Calendar:
- View current Islamic / Hijri & Gregorian calendar dates and Umm-al-Qura Calendar
- View list of Islamic events of Hijri year
In-App Purchases:
- Enjoy smooth Ad free experience with Athan Pro version (Monthly and Yearly Subscriptions)
Note: Enable Auto settings to get the most accurate Islamic Prayer Times for your location.
Second, kindly rotate your phone and make an 8 in the air in order to get accurate Qibla direction

bluejetty:00148080:ios.description:
English:
Our goal is to digitize the transportation system in Kazakhstan and provide accurate and timely logistics information for all shipments across the country, ensuring your package is delivered to the exact destination on time. 
1. You can track the location of your shipment using the transport number directly from the app.
2. Easily calculate the exchange rate between Yuan and Tenge based on the set rate.
3. Get complete information about our team and how to order goods from China.
4. Receive notifications on your phone about your shipment status through this app.

1. Вы можете отслеживать местоположение вашего груза по номеру отправки прямо в приложении.
2. Легко рассчитывайте обменный курс между юанем и тенге по установленному курсу.
3. Получите полную информацию о нашей команде и о том, как заказать товар из Китая.
4. Получайте уведомления на ваш телефон о статусе доставки через это приложение.

Game Introduction: Idle: GoatSummoner
Greetings, and welcome to the realm of brave summoners in "Idle: GoatSummoner," where you embark on an adventure to explore the dark world!
Courageous Summoner :
You are a summoner with the bravery to summon powerful minions, delving into the secrets and conquering the darkness that shrouds the land.
Unique Minion Summons :
Utilize your unique ability to summon minions, creating extraordinary creatures with special abilities. Each minion holds unique powers that will prove invaluable in various battles.
Conquer Dark Dungeons :
Embark on a journey to conquer the dark dungeons in "Idle: GoatSummoner." Face formidable bosses, claim rewards, and unveil the secrets of the world as you summon new minions along the way.
Effortless Idle Gameplay :
The game offers a simple idle gameplay experience. Log in at any time to check your accumulated resources and upgrade your minions.
Distinctive Art Style :
"Idle: GoatSummoner" presents a PetitGore-style art that is truly one-of-a-kind, expressing the dark world in a way you won't find anywhere else. Immerse yourself in its unique visual sensibility.
In "Idle: GoatSummoner," you are invited to embark on an adventure as a courageous summoner, conquering the dark world. The doors to adventure are wide open. Do you have the courage to challenge the shadows?

bluejetty:00070654:ios.name: My GPS Location °
bluejetty:00070654:ios.summary: Using our 'My GPS Location' app, you can easily check your current location based on data from various sources within your phone, such as the internal GPS antenna and Wi-Fi network. The app is ideal during trips, sports, treasure hunting (g
bluejetty:00070654:ios.description:
Using our 'My GPS Location' app, you can easily check your current location based on data from various sources within your phone, such as the internal GPS antenna and Wi-Fi network. The app is ideal during trips, sports, treasure hunting (geocaching), solo travel and any other activities out in the world that require location data.
In the basic view you will see following data:
- latitude and longitude in formats:
- decimal degrees
 - degrees, decimal minutes
 - degrees, minutes, seconds
 - UTM
- altitude
- GPS accuracy
- speed (km/h, m/s, mph)
- direction
- location address (if available)
In addition, on the main view screen, you can save your exact location and take a photo and our application will plot any data you wish on it.
In the map view, you can see your current position and saved locations as well as add new places. Thanks to this function, you can easily find beautiful beaches from last summer, hidden treasures, favorite restaurants or even a place to park your car. To add a new place, just press and hold a button and then enter the name. You can switch to four different map types - normal, terrain, hybrid, satellite. In this view, a coordinates finder is available based on your current address - all you need to do is enter the address and the application will determine the location data, such as latitude and longitude or vice versa.
On the history screen you will see all of your saved places. A chronological sorting is also available, in alphabetical order, based on distance from your current location. The application displays the name of the place, save date, latitude and longitude, distance from current position based on WGS84, direction and saved photos. An interesting feature is the possibility of transferring a given place to another person using our application and the import / export function. 
In addition, the app makes it possible to provide an up-to-date GPS location with a link to Google Maps via text message, email, FB messenger, and other available options. This is especially useful in dangerous situations where you have no access to data transmission.
Terms and conditions: https://mysticmobileapps.com/legal/terms/mygpslocation
Privacy policy: https://mysticmobileapps.com/legal/privacy/mygpslocation

bluejetty:00116106:ios.description:
The 28-Day Military Fitness Challenge for Men
Tired of soft living and feeling unprepared for life's physical challenges? Ready to trade comfort for capability and build a body that's not just for show, but for performance? Introducing Military Workout, your tactical command center for building elite-level fitness, mental toughness, and a soldier's physique—using only your bodyweight, anywhere, anytime.
Why This is Your Ultimate Mission to Get Tactically Fit:
This isn't another generic workout app. This is a structured mission plan inspired by the principles of military conditioning, designed for men of all fitness levels who crave discipline and results. Whether you're a veteran maintaining readiness, preparing for basic training, or a civilian who respects the military ethos, this app provides the no-nonsense, high-intensity training you need. 
Operational Features Designed for Maximum Impact:
1) The 28-Day Basic Training Protocol: Your mission begins here. A progressive, strategic plan that starts by drilling foundational movements and systematically advances in intensity. 
2) Bodyweight Battle Drills: No gym? No problem. Our workouts use proven bodyweight exercises that build functional, military-inspired strength and explosive power. 
3) Clear, No-Fail Exercise Intel: Execute every move with precision. High-definition video demonstrations and clear audio coaching ensure your form is perfect from day one.
4) Adaptable Mission Durations: Your mission, your time. Choose from intense 10-, 15-, 20-, or 25-minute sessions designed to deliver maximum results in minimum time. 
5) Performance Recon & Tracking: Log your missions, track your weight, and measure your progress as you advance through the ranks. Watch your stamina increase, your body transform, and your confidence soar with every completed workout.
How Your Deployment Works:
· State Your Mission Objective: Define your goal—lose weight, build functional muscle, enhance endurance, or simply prove to yourself that you can complete the challenge.
· Personalize Your Intel: Input your stats—age, height, weight, and fitness level. This allows us to tailor the training intensity to your specific starting point.
· Receive Your Orders: Get your unique, day-by-day training plan. The workouts are designed to challenge you at your level, ensuring you are constantly pushed but never overwhelmed.
· Execute Your Drills: Follow your daily missions with clear guidance. The program is structured to build upon itself, creating a cumulative effect that drives rapid transformation.
· Debrief and Advance: Log your results, track your streaks, and witness your daily progress as you shred fat, build strength, and develop the discipline of a soldier.
Stop with ineffective routines and half-hearted efforts. Your 28-day mission to a tougher, stronger, and more capable you begins now. Embrace the challenge, commit to the process, and transform your body and mindset.
Answer the Call. Enlist and download today!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Get a 7M Supporter subscription and enjoy full access to all features and content. The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.
Note: This app is developed for informational purposes only. You should always consult your physician or doctor before starting any new fitness program.
This app integrates with the Apple Health app.

- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up at your requested address.
- Share your ride with others.
What we’re about:
IMMEDIATE
Our App will have a driver outside your door within 30 minutes of your confirmed reservation to take you to your requested destination. 
AFFORDABLE.
Each ride on ORT On-Demand has zero fare! At no cost to you, ride quickly and affordably around each of our unique service zones in Rogers, Bentonville, and East Fayetteville. 
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at ORTOnDemand@ozark.org or call us today at 479-756-5901.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

Travelers: Translate menus, street signs, and documents instantly.

Complete solution: Photo, Voice, Text, and Document translation in one app.
Fast & accurate AI-powered translations.
Easy-to-use, intuitive design for everyone.
Download AI Photo Translator today and translate anything instantly—photos, voice, text, and documents across 100+ languages.

bluejetty:00018662:ios.summary: 200+ gluten free recipes for your indulgence! Adopting a gluten free diet doesn’t have to be a dull and flavourless one. We’ve jam packed delicious flavoursome recipes into an easy to follow and visually inspiring app just for you. You’ll f
bluejetty:00018662:ios.description:
200+ gluten free recipes for your indulgence! Adopting a gluten free diet doesn’t have to be a dull and flavourless one. We’ve jam packed delicious flavoursome recipes into an easy to follow and visually inspiring app just for you. You’ll find great ideas for gluten free breakfasts, lunches, dinners, snacks and even indulging desserts.
Gluten can cause serious health complications. About 1 % of the population have celiac disease, an autoimmune disease. If they consume gluten it triggers an immune response where the body attacks itself, destroying the small intestine and making it very difficult to absorb nutrients. Sufferers must follow a strict gluten free diet.
Don’t be fooled, Gluten does not only affect celiac suffers. Gluten is a staple in many peoples diet and is commonly found in sneaky processed foods. People from all walks of life are suffering from gluten sensitivity everyday. It can trigger nasty symptoms such as stomach aches, heartburn, headaches, joint pains, bloating rashes, fatigue and insomnia to name a few.
We can all reap the benefits of going gluten free to increase energy levels, lower bad cholesterol and to assist the body’s digestive processes.
Our app is highly visual. Our goal was to offer a wide variety of recipes and a highly usable and visually appealing application, and we have delivered.
Browse beautiful pictures of delicious food and make the dish yourself using our recipe instructions on either iPhone or iPad. 
FEATURES
> Over 200 (and growing) Gluten-free recipes divided into tons of categories including vegetarian, vegan, breakfast, lunch, dinner, dessert, snacks, sides, and raw
> Beautiful views of recipes on both iPad and iPhone, a very photo-centric approach
> Well designed ingredient and instruction pages on both iPhone and iPad to make the best use of screen space
> Share your delicious creations on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, email or text
> Save your favourites to refer to later
This app contains additional recipes which require an in-app purchase to unlock. This is not required to enjoy the app and access many recipes.
SUPPORT
support@burleighcreative.com

bluejetty:00039776:ios.description:
Ysos is a discreet and secure dating app that allows you to find out if there is an affinity with other profiles nearby according to your interests! 
Practicality to have a safe date
how ysos works: When registering your account, tell us a little about yourself and who you are looking for. Complete your information and mind your description to stand out. You will meet interesting people nearby and find out if you are have chemistry. When you have a mutual like, the chat is released to get to know each other better!
Real people online!
Search for real singles and couples close to you and start a chat to ensure the best experiences. At ysos, we verify the cell phone number when creating the account to avoid fake profiles. You'll find real like-minded people for dating!
Say goodbye to unwanted contacts with interest filters
You choose which profiles you want to relate to and only those who interest you will be able to chat and meet you.
Messages released!
Chat without having to be a subscriber! If you like a profile and get liked back, send unlimited private messages for FREE.
More control and privacy for your photos.
You decide who can see your private photos. Uploaded images have an extra layer of watermarked security.
Secrecy and Discretion
Screen Lock (PIN) allows only you to access the app, keeping its content secret. Thus, your private photos and your account are in a safe environment.
ysos is free to register and use. But you can get access to some exclusive benefits and additional features by subscribing to ysos Gold (Optional).
To access and use ysos you must be at least 18 years and comply with our Privacy Policy Terms and Conditions.
More information on the links:

bluejetty:00163187:ios.name: Adibou by Wiloki – ages 4 to 7
bluejetty:00163187:ios.summary: Your child will join Adibou and his friends in a color-packed, interactive universe where they will learn to read, count, cook, tend to the garden and go on exciting adventures together! Each activity has been carefully designed to inspire
bluejetty:00163187:ios.description:
Your child will join Adibou and his friends in a color-packed, interactive universe where they will learn to read, count, cook, tend to the garden and go on exciting adventures together! Each activity has been carefully designed to inspire curiosity and foster creativity. 
In ADIBOU'S HOME, the garden, house, and the Tower of Knowledge are filled with a whole host of activities: reading, counting, gardening, cooking, listening to stories, and much more. Your child will learn and explore at their own pace in a playful and engaging way. 
Your child can now also discover THE FIREFLIES' SONG, Abidou's new adventure! This exciting new game will take your child on a special mission with Adibou to save the realm’s magical fireflies. Across five enchanted lands, they will solve puzzles, take on creative challenges, and learn more about sustainability. 
Next stop: the Island of Arts with THE SECRET OF THE ARTISTS, the brand-new expansion in Adibou’s world! Guided by colorful and lively artists, your child explores the island and uncovers the wonders of art—painting, film, music, architecture, and more. An adventure full of surprises that sparks artistic curiosity and fires up creativity.
Try it for free: Start exploring with limited content or unlock unlimited access to each game module with a one-time payment. 
WHY LEARN WITH ADIBOU? 
- Stimulates passion for learning and discovery 
- Automatically adapts to the child’s individual learning pace 
- Designed by educational experts 
- 100% safe and secure 
Adibou by Wiloki was imagined and designed by teachers and digital experts to meet the developmental needs for young children from pre-k to 1st grade. With over 1,500 activities, your child will learn the fundamental aspects of their early years' education, from reading and writing in the English Room to counting and recognising shapes in the Mathematics Room. Each activity is specially designed for children ages 4, 5, 6, and 7, to promote and stimulate independent learning. 
This fun and educational game captivates children aged 4 to 7 with its lovable characters, positive atmosphere, and various engaging activities adapted for younger children. Thanks to Adibou, learning to count and read has never been this much fun. 
In ADIBOU'S HOME, your child will develop many skills on their own:
LEARNING TO READ AND WRITE IN THE ENGLISH ROOM:
- expand vocabulary 
- understand a story and identify text type 
- understand phonics and syllables 
- understand letters, words, sentences 
LEARNING TO COUNT AND OBSERVE IN THE MATHEMATICS ROOM:
- learn figures and numbers 
- identify simple geometric shapes 
- learn to add and subtract 
- identify and structure their environment 
- understand logic and sequences 
- learn to tell the time 
DEVELOPING CREATIVITY AND IMAGINATION:
- listen to fun interactive songs and stories 
- customize flowers 
- create their own characters 
- make and decorate cakes 
- customize Adibou's garden 
AND MUCH MORE:
- enhance memory and motor skills through mini-games 
- structure, organize and manage thoughts 
- learn to cook and follow recipes 
- try gardening and growing fruits, vegetables, and flowers 
- interact in a safe and secure community 
Set off on a journey with THE NEW ADIBOU ADVENTURES:
- explore enchanting lands
- solve puzzles to boost memory, develop logic and reasoning skills
- complete creative challenges to excite their imagination
- play dynamic action games to enhance focus and observation skills
100% SECURE APP: 
- no advertising 
- anonymous data 
- control over time spent on app 
The leading European educational game of the 90s and 2000s is back with all new updated games and challenges that has captivated the hearts of over 10 million fans! 
Adibou is an Ubisoft© license.

* Different realistic trucks to drive

* Thrilling rescue missions, with fire trucks for more fun

bluejetty:00187922:ios.description:
The CEX.IO App provides the ultimate crypto experience, with a variety of services in the palm of your hand. Our app empowers you to trade, sell, and buy Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies instantly, anytime, and anywhere. Spend less than a minute to buy Ethereum and other digital assets using a debit/credit card, Apple Pay, bank transfers, and/or PayPal*. In addition, with the CEX.IO App, you have access to 300+ markets wherever you go.
Using the funding method that suits you best, you can instantly buy or sell the following assets via the CEX.IO App:
Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Polygon (MATIC), Litecoin (LTC), Ripple (XRP), Stellar (XLM), Cosmos (ATOM), Dogecoin (DOGE), Shiba Inu (SHIB), Cardano (ADA), USD Coin (USDC), Tether (USDT), Polkadot (DOT), Uniswap (UNI), Zilliqa (ZIL), SushiSwap (SUSHI), and Solana (SOL).
These are just a few of the 100+ supported digital assets! And we’re constantly expanding our listings.
The CEX.IO App opens access to the entire universe of crypto services. Apart from your own Bitcoin wallet, other attractive features include:
• Instant crypto purchases. Buy crypto in a few taps, using the funding method that best suits your needs.
• Instant Sell option. Convert your crypto into fiat, and immediately send funds to your payment card.
• Rapid card deposits and withdrawals. Deposit funds to your CEX.IO balance, or transfer fiat to your debit/credit card in minutes.
• Multichain support. Send Bitcoin and other digital assets using 40+ blockchain networks.
• Beginner-friendly Convert feature. No need to figure out trading strategies. Just swap crypto and fiat currencies in a few taps.
• Crypto savings accounts**. Accumulate daily crypto rewards in Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other digital assets, with no lock-up periods.
• Deep liquidity. Trade 300+ markets with narrow spreads, and minimal price slippage.
• Sub-accounts for trading. Improve risk management of your trading strategy and better organize your finances, taking advantage of up to five sub-accounts.
• Save your favorite markets. Select preferred currency pairs for quick access and decision-making.
• Monitor your portfolio performance. Track the slightest changes in your crypto wallet and trading balances.
• User-friendly interface. Purchase, sell, exchange, and store crypto, enjoying intuitive app navigation.
• Fast card-linking. Add your payment card to buy cryptocurrency in a matter of minutes.
• Detailed order and transaction history. Stay informed of your crypto exchange operations, with clear explanations of all fees and commissions.
• Passionate Support Team, which is eager to provide professional assistance throughout your crypto journey. 
With CEX.IO’s cryptocurrency exchange, you can take advantage of a wide array of currency pairs, deep liquidity, and an advanced order-matching mechanism. With this crypto app, we combined the best CEX.IO ecosystem features, and packed them into a straightforward interface. Our cryptocurrency trading platform empowers you to achieve fast execution of your trades, while our Savings** service provides you with the opportunity to earn crypto effortlessly.
Want to buy or sell crypto, in a matter of minutes? You can do it with the CEX.IO App. Want to build your own trading strategy, and track its performance? This app is the one for which you’ve been looking. Enjoy these and many other features our crypto exchange has to offer, by downloading the CEX.IO App
*Payment methods available depend on the user's country of residence.
**Availability of the CEX.IO Savings service depends on the user’s jurisdiction.
Disclaimer: Not investment or financial advice. Seek professional advice. Digital assets involve risk. Do your own research

bluejetty:00084783:ios.name: KTMconnect
bluejetty:00084783:ios.summary:
Unlocking the full potential for KTM riders, the KTMconnect app is a sophisticated yet highly accessible tool that offers wireless connectivity functionalities, taking riding experiences to the next level.
FOR THE STREET
Plan your journey
bluejetty:00084783:ios.description:
Unlocking the full potential for KTM riders, the KTMconnect app is a sophisticated yet highly accessible tool that offers wireless connectivity functionalities, taking riding experiences to the next level.
FOR THE STREET
Plan your journey and adventure further with confidence. Powered by Mapbox and operating offline, the NAVIGATION feature uses industry standard mapping to guide riders to their destination of choice. Either use the advanced search feature, browse a diverse range of POIs including gas stations, restaurants, and rest stops or select one of your pre-saved destinations to easily find your way to your favorite roads. Concise directions are delivered turn by turn to your KTM bike’s dashboard, so you can focus on what’s important – the ride! You got a GPX-file of an awesome trip of your friend? No problem, our GPX import supports all of these features. Furthermore, see real-time traffic information on the map, speed limits and much more!
MOBILITY SERVICE
For the supported street bikes, find now the details of your Mobility Service* in the KTMconnect app! When unforeseen challenges are placed in your way, you can rely on our professional partner network to be at your side. We offer a 24/7 hotline service, on-site repair or tow away, accommodation, replacement vehicle, onward journey and more. Create your service request from the KTMconnect app and follow as the service vehicle approaches you. 
*Available only in certain European countries with certain conditions.
FOR THE DIRT
Rev up your KTM SX-F and KTM XC-F with the cutting-edge Connectivity Unit Offroad. Unleash control like never before by syncing it with the KTMconnect app on your smartphone. Once you've got the app in your grasp, dominate every ride with absolute authority over power delivery, engine braking, traction control and quickshifter sensitivity. This isn't just an app – it's your command center.
Take charge of the engine's personality with customizable settings that let you tailor it to your every whim. The app doesn't just stop there; it's pre-loaded with suspension settings recommendations optimized for various racing terrains. Conquer any track with confidence, knowing your setup is finely tuned for peak performance.
But wait, there's more! The RIDER section on the KTMconnect app isn't just a spectator; it's your post-race analyst. Dive into comprehensive analytics, dissecting every line your motorcycle takes. Lap times are etched onto a virtual leaderboard, turning every ride into a personal competition. It's not just motocross; it's a battle for supremacy, climb on, rev up, and let the KTMconnect app redefine your motocross experience.
Terms of Use: https://www.ktm.com/legal-notices-and-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00024146:ios.description:
Welcome to Cut and Paint, one of the relaxing wood-cutting and coloring games! Unleash your inner artist and experience the enchanting world of woodworking with Cut and Paint, the ultimate coloring game that combines the art of wood carving with the joy of coloring! Transform simple wooden boards into breathtaking masterpieces using a unique three-step process: Sand, Carve, and Paint.
Before you start coloring, you need to prepare a wooden board. Begin your woodworking adventure by honing your carpentry skills. You need smoothen the wooden board's surface and prepare it for the next steps. Achieve precision as you create a flawless canvas for your artwork. Feel like a real carpenter!
Enter the realm of laser art as you etch intricate designs on the sanded wood. Feel the power of the laser as you follow the contours, turning your blank canvas into a artwork. Make a perfect cut! Unlock new design templates as you level up, allowing you to unleash your creativity and bring your imagination to life. 
With a wide range of spray paint cans at your disposal, select your preferred hues and carefully apply them using stencils. Watch as your wooden canvas transforms into a stunning and vivid piece of art.
Unlock an extensive library of laser art designs that cater to various themes, from nature and animals to abstract and geometric patterns.
Choose from a vast array of vibrant colors to paint your creations, with customizable spray intensity for intricate details.
Cut and Paint combines the satisfaction of carpentry with the intricacies of laser art and the vibrancy of spray painting!
Embark on a journey of artistic expression through the fusion of wood carving and coloring. Experience the joy of transforming simple wooden boards into magnificent works of art like real carpenter!

bluejetty:00023112:ios.description:
Are you tired of feeling like you're constantly battling against your own body? Do you wish there was a simple, easy-to-use tool that could help you take control of your health and prevent diabetes, fight weight gain, and control high glucose levels and blood pressure? Look no further than our innovative app.
Don't let diabetes, weight gain, or high blood pressure control your life any longer. Take charge of your health today by downloading our app and starting on the path towards a healthier, happier you. Our app is easy to use, intuitive, and designed with your needs in mind. So why wait? Try it out today and see the difference it can make in your life.
Introducing a revolutionary AI-powered recipe generator feature, a solution to your meal planning woes! With just a few taps, you can now access a vast of recipes tailored to your dietary preferences and favorite cuisines. Say goodbye to the hassle of browsing endless recipe books and websites, and let our app's recipe generator feature do all the hard work for you. 
Our AI-powered recipe generator is the solution to all your meal planning woes! With just a few taps, access a vast selection of mouth-watering recipes tailored to your dietary preferences, favorite cuisines, and available ingredients. Say goodbye to the hassle of browsing endless recipe books and websites and let our app's recipe generator do all the hard work for you. Whether you're vegan, gluten-free, or looking to try something new, our recipe generator will suggest a recipe to suit your needs. Get ready to be amazed by the endless possibilities of delicious and healthy meals at your fingertips! Say hello to stress-free meal planning with our app's AI-powered recipe generator!
But our app is much more than just a food guide. With its advanced tracking and monitoring features, you can easily keep tabs on your glucose levels, weight, blood pressure, and other important health metrics. Our app empowers you to make your own choices based on your unique needs and preferences.
* know good food and eat smart
* follow low-carb diets or keto diets
* control your weight, glucose and blood pressure
* prevent diseases like diabetes or heart diseases like hypertension
* fight weight gain, overweight and obesity
* have the Glycemic Load, Index and carbs data at hand
* backup or sync with other devices
The free features of the app are:
* Food tables of the Glycemic Index
* Favorite and recent food with search feature
* Weight tracking (also hip, waist, thigh, neck and fat) with statistics and beautiful charts
* Glucose and ketone bodies tracking with stats, great charts and HbA1c calculation
* Blood pressure diary with stats and pretty charts
* BMI calculator
* Insulin resistance risk calculator
You can use the free version of the app with ads or pay a small fee to access more exciting features listed below. All of these features are available in the free trial version.
* Glycemic Load list
* Carbohydrates content list
* Fiber content in foods and net carbs calculator
* Apple Health support which helps to sync measurements with electronic scales, glucometers and blood pressure monitors
* Meal content calculator
* Food diary to keep track of your food, glycemic load and carbs consumption
* Statistics with averages for daily, weekly, monthly and yearly periods
* Beautiful charts of the GL and carbs consumption over time
* Unlimited number of measurements
* Future additions to the food tracker, charting and stats
* Import/export all your data to backup or sync between devices
* Export to CSV for offline analysis and send via email (e.g. to your doctor)
* No more ads!
The app supports Apple Health which helps to sync measurements with electronic scales, glucometers and blood pressure monitor. Using the app with the Apple Health app on your device empowers you to better manage your health.
Privacy Policy: https://glycemicindex.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://glycemicindex.app/terms-of-service
