bluejetty:00186181:ios.name: Spelling Notebook Premium
bluejetty:00186181:ios.summary: Create a personalized list of words to practice. Test your spelling - hear each word spoken. Get a star for each correct word. Practice just the words you have yet to master. Retest your words at anytime. Students can practice their words i
bluejetty:00186181:ios.description:
Create a personalized list of words to practice. Test your spelling - hear each word spoken. Get a star for each correct word. Practice just the words you have yet to master. Retest your words at anytime. Students can practice their words independently.
Originally designed to be a replacement for a student's spelling notebook which lists words to be learnt for school each week. Unlike a paper notebook, SpellingNotebook can speak each of the words to enable testing and practice without seeing the written word. SpellingNotebook contains a full searchable spelling dictionary so that words can be added directly to the student's word list, minimizing entry errors. 
User Reviews 
* This app is awesome I have a spelling test coming up and I can spell every word correctly thanks to this app!!! (US) 
* Makes spelling practice fun (UK) 
* So fun!!!! This is a great app for kids and adults! (US) 
* Great App!!! Whole class uses it!! (Australia) 
Spelling Notebook features: 
* Students can practice independently 
* More than 100,000 words - add new words to the built in spelling dictionary when needed 
* Spelling Notebook has a built in voice that can say all words in its extensive dictionary and any new english words added 
* Optionally Record your own voice for the word you want to practice. You can record just the word, or even a whole phrase to help you recognize which word to spell. 
* Multiple English regions: UK, US, Canada, Australia and NZ 
* Earn a star for correct words 
* Keep multiple word lists 
* Edit word lists: add or delete words, add or delete an entire word list, rename your list
* Import words from one wordlist into another 
* Words are selected from an extensive dictionary - minimizing entry errors 
* Help available in app to guide and support 
* Word list Copy and Paste
* History of Word list tests and practice
* Email test results
* Unlimited words per list
* Select between UK, US and Australian voices
The built-in spelling dictionary is automatically selected by region. For countries outside US, Canada, Australia and NZ, the UK spelling dictionary is selected. 
Spelling Notebook Premium offers a premium Spelling Notebook experience with no ads on any device, unlimited words per wordlist and a selection of UK, US and Australian voices.
Follow us on Instagram: @spellingnotebook
Recommended Ages: All, Kids 
Categories: Education, Productivity, Apps for Kids

bluejetty:00030418:ios.description:
My City : Jail House is open and ready for you to visit. Ever wanted to know what a jail house looks like? This is your chance! Play as the prisons warden, take care of the bad guys and help them become good. Unlock doors, visit the yard, solve puzzles and make sure the sneaky bad guys do not escape! Fun and adventure is everywhere! Create your own adventures and stories everyday! 
* Huge location that includes the Jail and Prison area, Jail Yard, Dining Hall, Helipad and so much more
* Lots of interactive objects to discover, hidden locations and escape rooms.
* Discover the hidden keys used to unlock other content in the game.
* Try turning off the lights, see what happens!
* Play as warden, prisoner or police. Make sure to check out the police helicopter!
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 3-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 9-year old to enjoy!
Game features:
- This game has 8 new locations for kids to explore, role-play and layout their own stories.
- 20 Characters included in this game, feel free to take them to other games. The options are endless!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!

Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames

Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com

bluejetty:00042660:ios.summary:
When traveling in Japan, Suica is highly recommended.
With Suica, you can enjoy seamless travel on all major transportation networks throughout Japan and make quick payments while shopping.
Download the app on your iPhone and issue your Sui
bluejetty:00042660:ios.description:
When traveling in Japan, Suica is highly recommended.
With Suica, you can enjoy seamless travel on all major transportation networks throughout Japan and make quick payments while shopping.
Download the app on your iPhone and issue your Suica so you can travel without waiting in line for tickets!
■What’s New：March 2026
Now upgrade your journey with Suica Green Car Tickets purchased directly through Welcome Suica Mobile—offering extra comfort and a smoother ride to destinations like Narita Airport, Odawara, and Atami.
Green Cars on local trains are a paid service offering spacious seats and a relaxing atmosphere. With Welcome Suica Mobile, you can purchase the required tickets for riding Green Cars on local trains.
■What's Great About It
- The “Welcome Suica Mobile” app lets you instantly issue a Suica on your iPhone by setting a simple “secret keyword.” No membership registration is required.
- Unlike a regular Suica, this app also provides transfer and tourist information.
- Suica is a prepaid e-money card for trains, buses, and shopping anywhere in Japan. Once you’ve issued your Suica via the app, you’ll rarely need cash.
- For transportation, simply tap your iPhone or Apple Watch at the ticket gate—no ticket purchase is necessary. The same goes for shopping; just tap to pay.
- If your balance gets low, you can easily top it up via the app.
- Top-ups are done through the credit card registered to Apple Pay. You don’t need to register your credit card information within the app.
- Make reservations via JR-EAST Train Reservation directly within the app, allowing ticketless travel on JR East Shinkansen and limited express services to major destinations such as Narita Airport, Tokyo, Shinjuku, Yokohama, and Mt. Fuji.
- You can ride non-reserved seats on the Tohoku, Hokkaido, Akita, Yamagata, Joetsu, or Hokuriku Shinkansen without buying a paper ticket.*
*For details on where “Touch de Go! Shinkansen” is available, please check the JR East website.
■How It Works
- You can use Suica on trains, buses, and other transportation systems nationwide.
In addition to Suica, areas that accept PASMO, SAPICA, Kitaca, ICAS nimoca, icsca, RYUTO, TOICA, manaca, ICOCA, PiTaPa, SUGOCA, nimoca, HAYAKAKEN, OKICA, SAPICA and more are also supported.
- You can use it for payments at stores displaying the IC mark nationwide.
- Please set your secret keyword to get support if any issues occur.
- The support center provides assistance via email in English only.
- Compatibility: iPhone with iOS 17.2 or later, and Apple Watch Series 3 or later.
- Payment method: Apple Pay only.
- Fees: No deposit or issuance fee is required.
■Things to know
- The balance of Welcome Suica Mobile expires 180 days after issuance. 
Once it expires, you can issue a new Suica within the same app. Refunds are not available, so please use up any remaining balance at airports, stations, and other stores.
- You cannot use Suica when your device is powered off.
*If your device turns off while you’re inside the ticket gate, you will need to pay the fare in cash for the section you traveled.
- Please enable Express Mode for Suica.
*Enabling Express Mode for Suica lets you pass through automatic ticket gates without biometric authentication. 
Biometric authentication may still be required for shopping.

bluejetty:00070837:ios.name: CCRN Exam Prep 2026
bluejetty:00070837:ios.summary:
CCRN Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the AACN CCRN Adult, Pediatric or Neonatal exam with a high score on your first attempt.
CCRN Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to AA
bluejetty:00070837:ios.description:
CCRN Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the AACN CCRN Adult, Pediatric or Neonatal exam with a high score on your first attempt.
CCRN Exam Prep 2026 not only helps you gain insight into concepts related to AACN CCRN Adult, Pediatric or Neonatal 2026 exam preparation, but also helps you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first attempt by practicing thousands of exam-like questions.
### Pass the exam on the first attempt ###
In CCRN Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the range of official CCRN exam requirements. There are a total of three certification categories for you to choose from, including CCRN Adult, Pediatric & Neonatal, depending on the exam requirements. Each category contains all six officially required test subjects, each of which can be subdivided into more than a dozen areas according to the exam requirements. You have the flexibility to choose which subjects you need to practice, depending on your situation.
Specifically, these subjects include:
• Cardiovascular
• Respiratory
• Endocrine/Hematology/Gastrointestinal/Renal/Integumentary
• Musculoskeletal/Neurological/Psychosocial
• Multisystem
• Professional Caring & Ethical practice
### Key Features ###
- Over 2000 questions to practice, each including detailed answer explanations
- Specialized practice by content area with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the CCRN exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice on the CCRN Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the CCRN exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term chosen for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term, otherwise your account will be automatically charged for the renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://ccrn.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://ccrn.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
Please let us know if you have any questions or comments about your use by emailing us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.
DISCLAIMER:
CCRN® is a registered trademark of AACN. This application is not authorized, sponsored/supported or endorsed by AACN.

bluejetty:00072350:ios.name: Super Meat Boy Forever
bluejetty:00072350:ios.summary: Super Meat Boy Forever takes place a few years after the events of Super Meat Boy. Meat Boy and Bandage Girl have been living a happy life free of Dr. Fetus for several years and they now have a wonderful little baby named Nugget. Nugget is
bluejetty:00072350:ios.description:
Super Meat Boy Forever takes place a few years after the events of Super Meat Boy. Meat Boy and Bandage Girl have been living a happy life free of Dr. Fetus for several years and they now have a wonderful little baby named Nugget. Nugget is joy personified and she is everything to Meat Boy and Bandage Girl. One day while our heroes were on a picnic, Dr. Fetus snuck up on them, beat Meat Boy and Bandage Girl unconscious with a shovel and kidnapped Nugget! When our heroes came to and found that Nugget was missing, they knew who to go after. They cracked their knuckles and decided to never stop until they got Nugget back and taught Dr. Fetus a very important lesson. A lesson that can only be taught with punches and kicks.
The challenge of Super Meat Boy returns in Super Meat Boy Forever. Levels are brutal, death is inevitable, and players will get that sweet feeling of accomplishment after beating a level. Players will run, jump, punch and kick their way through familiar settings and totally new worlds.
What’s better than playing through Super Meat Boy Forever once? The answer is simple: Playing through Super Meat Boy Forever several times and having new levels to play each time. Levels are randomly generated and each time the game is completed the option to replay the game appears and generates a whole new experience by presenting different levels with their own unique secret locations. We’ve handcrafted literally thousands of levels for players to enjoy and conquer. You can replay Super Meat Boy Forever from start to finish several times before ever seeing a duplicate level. It is truly a remarkable feat of engineering and a monumental example of ignoring the limits of rational game design and production.
They don’t give Oscars to games, but they probably will after Super Meat Boy Forever becomes the best movie of 2020 and 2021! Our story takes Meat Boy and Bandage Girl through several worlds in search of their darling little Nugget with beautifully animated cutscenes and musical accompaniment that makes Citizen Kane look like a reaction video to an sled unboxing. Players will laugh, they will cry, and when all is said and done maybe they’ll emerge from the experience a little better than when they started. Ok so that last part probably won’t happen but marketing text is hard to write.
- Run, Jump, Punch and Slide your way through literally thousands of levels!
- Experience a story so that it will influence the cinematic landscape for decades to come.
- Fight Bosses, find secrets, unlock characters, live in the world we’ve created because the real world can kinda suck sometimes!
- The long awaited sequel to Super Meat Boy has finally arrived!

bluejetty:00144845:ios.name: Đấu Hồn Sư
bluejetty:00144845:ios.summary:
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số: 1859/QĐ-BTTTT do Bộ Thông Tin và Truyền Thông tử cấp ngày 25 tháng 10 năm 2024. https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/128314
Xưa kia tại xứ sở của các Linh Thần tồn tại một trường phái huyền
bluejetty:00144845:ios.description:
Quyết định phát hành trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số: 1859/QĐ-BTTTT do Bộ Thông Tin và Truyền Thông tử cấp ngày 25 tháng 10 năm 2024. https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/128314
Xưa kia tại xứ sở của các Linh Thần tồn tại một trường phái huyền bí được gọi là Đấu Hồn Sư. Theo truyền thuyết, sức mạnh của Đấu Hồn Sư được thể hiện ở triệu hồi và sử dụng các thực thể siêu nhiên. Trong thế giới của Đấu Hồn Sư, luôn tồn tại song hành những vị Thần có sứ mệnh bảo vệ sự yên bình đối đầu cùng thế lực tà ác với pháp lực huỷ thiên diệt địa sẵn sàng làm hại nhân gian. Trong vai một Đấu Hồn Sư tập sự nhưng vô tình lại triệu hồi được thượng cổ Hộ Thần vô cùng cường đại, bạn đã sẵn sàng để lên đường hàng yêu trừ ma, trả lại vẻ đẹp thanh bình cho thế giới này?
Đến với Đấu Hồn Sư, bạn sẽ được nhập vai vào thế giới ảo mộng, với trọng trách bảo vệ bình yên nơi Linh Thần trú ngụ.
ĐẶC SẮC GAME
- Thời Trang Độc Bản - Linh Sư Diệt Quỷ 
Mỗi trang phục trong Đấu Hồn Sư không chỉ là một biểu tượng của phong cách cá nhân của game thủ mà còn ẩn chứa những kỹ năng và sức mạnh đặc biệt, giúp vượt qua những trận chiến cam go.
- Hồ Ly Bất Tử - Truy Tìm Đấu Hồn Sư Mạnh Nhất 
Thường xuất hiện trong văn hóa dân gian Nhật Bản, Hồ Ly được miêu tả là loài sinh vật khôn ngoan, tinh ranh và sở hữu nhiều phép ma thuật bí hiểm. Liệu các Đấu Hồn Sư có đủ bản lĩnh và sức mạnh để chế ngự linh hồn Hồ Ly?
- Đồ Họa Chất Nhật Bản - Âm Dương Tái Hợp
Đấu Hồn Sư sở hữu đồ họa 3D đậm chất Nhật Bản. Khung cảnh đẹp như mơ cùng tạo hình nhân vật mới lạ sẽ mang đến trải nghiệm cực kỳ mới lạ. 
- 10 hoạt động PvP liên server - PK Cháy Máy
Trong vai Đấu Hồn Sư, game thủ sẽ trải nghiệm những tính năng PvP liên server đỉnh cao: Võ Đài Đỉnh Phong, Thần Khí Chiến Trường, ... Nơi không chỉ là khẳng định tài năng mà còn là chiến trường khốc liệt nơi sức mạnh và vinh quang được quyết định.
- Cày Cuốc Không Giới Hạn - Chuẩn Giao Dịch Tự Do
Trong Chợ Giao Dịch, Hồng Ngọc là loại tiền tệ duy nhất dùng để trao đổi hàng hóa. Đây là nơi để các Đấu Hồn Sư có thể dễ dàng sở hữu trang bị cực phẩm ngoại quan xứng tầm từ thời trang, vũ khí, tọa kỵ đến hệ thống pháp bảo, thần hành.

Hồ Ly Bất Tử - Truy Tìm Đấu Hồn Sư Mạnh Nhất

bluejetty:00131186:ios.description:
Don’t wait for your earned pay any longer. If your employer is offering PNC EarnedIt, powered 
by DailyPay, you can transfer a portion of your unpaid earnings to an eligible bank account, 
debit card, prepaid card, or pay card. Transfer fees apply. Enrollment required.
How PNC EarnedIt Works:
● Your available balance builds as you work throughout the week. 
● View your available balance and withdraw money in the app (fees apply when making a 
transfer). 
● Depending on your choice, you’ll receive your money in minutes (including weekends 
and holidays, 24/7/365) or on the next business day. 
● Receive your remaining pay on payday, for no additional cost 
Benefits & Features:
● Access your available balance when you need it. Transfer a portion of your earnings to 
an eligible bank account, debit card, prepaid card, or pay card.
● Get insights into your available balance. 
● Receive notifications of changes to your balance (Third party message and data rates 
may apply).
Safe & Secure: 
PNC EarnedIt’s infrastructure is maintained by an experienced security and engineering team 
and uses 256-bit level encryption.
Note: PNC EarnedIt powered by DailyPay is an employer-provided benefit. Ask your employer 
about PNC EarnedIt today!

bluejetty:00121835:ios.summary:
Bring Pixel Art to Life with Pixel Color!
Whether you are looking to relax or getting in touch with your inner artistic self. Pixel Color offers many categories and beautiful images to color. Each pixel art is carefully designed with the b
bluejetty:00121835:ios.description:
Bring Pixel Art to Life with Pixel Color!
Whether you are looking to relax or getting in touch with your inner artistic self. Pixel Color offers many categories and beautiful images to color. Each pixel art is carefully designed with the best color choices for the artwork. Just select the number in the color palette and color the corresponding box in the image to bring the pixel art to life. You will be able to see your own creation in a video and share with families and friends.
Pixel coloring is fun for both kids and adults. Simply select a number and color. All our pixel art images are family friendly. 
To keep images and updates coming, please support us by writing us a review! 
We hope you enjoy this app and if you have any suggestions or questions, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us at feedback@pixelcolorapp.com
Subscription Pricing and Options
This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Weekly Pixel Pro offers $3.99 weekly subscription after a free trial period for unlocking all content and features.
Monthly Pixel Pro offers $9.99 monthly subscription for unlocking all content and features.
Yearly Pixel Pro offers $49.99 Yearly subscription for unlocking all content and features.
Subscription Renewal
Subscription payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. 
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling Subscription
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039. When your current subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. After your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use images marked as Pixel Pro.
Terms of Service: https://www.pixelcolorapp.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.pixelcolorapp.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00157409:ios.description:
Small changes to your brows can transform your whole look.
BrowStudio helps you discover three brow styles selected for your facial features and try 78 designs directly on your own photo. Choose a style and adjust its color, position, size, angle, and opacity until it feels right for you.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Discover your top 3 brow styles
• See why each style suits you and get personalized brow tips
• Try on 78 eyebrow designs on your photo
• Edit both brows together or adjust each side separately
• Change color, opacity, position, size, and angle
• Compare your original brows with your edited look
• Save your finished design as an image
PERFECT FOR YOU IF YOU...
• Are unsure which eyebrow shape suits your face
• Want to compare straight, arched, and natural brows
• Want to preview a look before doing your makeup or visiting a brow salon
• Want to see how brow color and thickness change your expression
• Prefer to test styles directly on your own photo
PREMIUM
Premium includes all brow styles, detailed advice, custom colors, high-resolution watermark-free saves, multiple editing histories, re-editing, and an ad-free experience.
Ads are shown when Premium is not active. Some styles and features can be unlocked by watching video ads or using tickets.
◎DISCLAIMER
• Photos taken or used in this app are not stored on external servers and are not used for any purpose outside the app's features. However, photos may be stored on your device when required for features you choose to use, such as resuming an edit, saving editing history, or saving a completed image.
• Operation on devices or OS versions outside the recommended system requirements is not supported.
• Performance may be unstable depending on your device condition and usage, even on recommended devices.
◎APP SUPPORT
• Email: support@catos.jp
※IMPORTANT INFORMATION
• Privacy Policy: https://catosjp.github.io/Web/PrivacyPolicy/BrowStudioPrivacyPolicy
• Terms of Service: https://catosjp.github.io/Web/TermsOfService/BrowStudioTermsOfService

Carding is a revolutionary mobile app designed to make gift card trading simple, secure, and efficient. Whether you have unused gift cards from retail stores, restaurants, or online platforms, Carding allows you to sell them quickly and turn them into cash. 
Why Choose Carding? 
1. Blazing-Fast Transactions: Our advanced technology ensures that your gift cards are processed and sold in minutes, not days. 
2. Unmatched Security: We prioritize your safety with state-of-the-art encryption and fraud detection systems, so you can trade with peace of mind.

5. User-Friendly Interface: Our app is designed with simplicity in mind, making it easy for anyone to navigate and complete transactions effortlessly.

1. List Your Card: Enter your gift card details, including balance and type. 
2. Sell Instantly: Our system matches your card with buyers in real-time. 
3. Get Paid: Once sold, your earnings are credited to your account instantly. 
4. Withdraw: Transfer your funds to your bank account, e-wallet, or other payment methods.

-Individuals: Sell unused gift cards and earn cash quickly. 
- Shoppers: Trade unwanted cards for ones you’ll actually use. 
- Businesses: Liquidate excess gift card inventory efficiently.

Join the Carding Community Today! 
Download Carding now and experience the future of gift card trading. With our fast, secure, and reliable platform, you’ll never let an unused gift card go to waste again. Turn your cards into cash today – it’s never been easier!

bluejetty:00069023:ios.description:
Hands on algebra activities to give you a fresh perspective on math.
"I'm 48. I've wanted to learn Algebra my whole life. Tried all kinds of books, to no avail. Your app works for me. I'm so excited. A whole new world opens up." - Sally G
Algebra Touch is a supplemental learning aid that gives you the power to play with algebra directly... and we make it impossible to make mistakes.
Poke around freely. Did it react how you thought it would? No? Well then, time to update your internal model of understanding and try again. That's how people learn.
“Seriously awesome app. I am a professional math and physics instructor for middle schoolers thru college students and adults. Have used your app with a number of my students .... And it was like magic. The visual and kinesthetic approach to "moving math" is so powerful!”
* Custom manipulative for each algebra topic
* Randomly generated practice problems - as many as you could want!
* Challenge mode at the end of each module to really test your understanding
* Instructional videos for more in-depth explanations
* Create your own problems to tinker and push the limit
Algebra Touch is highly visual and interactive, so the best way to see what it's about is to try it.
"With this app, the author has successfully made algebra beautiful. I really wish this app existed when I was studying algebra 25 years ago." - geekswithjuniors.com
Over 1 million downloads worldwide! (including the old version)
Current material covers:
Simplification, Like Terms, Commutativity, Order of Operations, Factorization, Prime Numbers, Elimination, Isolation, Variables, One step Equations, Two step equations. Variables on both sides of the Equation, Distribution, Factoring Out, Exponent Product Rule, Exponent Quotient Rule, and Logarithms.
Questions? Comments? 
Email sean@regularberry.com for a real response.

bluejetty:00078294:ios.description:
Honor of Kings: The Ultimate 5v5 Hero Battle Game
Honor of Kings International Edition, developed by Tencent Timi Studio and published by Level Infinite, is the world's most popular mobile MOBA game. Dive into the classic MOBA excitement with 5V5 hero's gorge, fair matchups; numerous battle modes and a vast selection of heroes allow you to demonstrate your dominance with first blood, pentakills, and legendary feats, crushing all competition! Localized hero voiceovers, skins, and smooth server performance ensure quick matchmaking, teaming up with friends for ranking battles, and enjoying all the fun of PC MOBAs and action games as you ascend to the pinnacle of honor! The enemy is nearing the battlefield—players, rally your allies for team battles in Honor of Kings!
Moreover, Honor of Kings invites you to partake in top global eSports events! Cheer for your favorite teams, witness thrilling, fervent gameplay, and even become a player yourself, standing on the global stage as a mobile legend MOBA player! It's all in your hands! Here, you are not a playerunknow; enjoy the battleground that's rightfully yours.
**Game Features**
1. 5V5 Tower Pushing Team Battles!
Classic 5V5 MOBA maps, three lanes to advance, providing the purest combat experience. Hero strategy combinations, forming the strongest team, seamless cooperation, showcasing extreme skills! Abundant wild monsters, a wide range of hero choices, battle after battle, fire freely, enjoying all the classic MOBA fun!
2. Legendary Heroes, Unique Skills, Dominate the Battlefield
Experience the power of heroes from myth and legend! Unleash their unique skills and experience completely different gameplay fun. Master the special skills of each hero, become a legend on the battlefield! Challenge your operations and strategies in the peak showdown of skills, experience unparalleled gaming fun. Choose your favorite heroes, unleash their power, fight alongside your teammates, conquer opponents, and create legends!
3. Ready to Team Up with Friends Anytime! Experience Ultimate Competitive Gameplay in 15 Minutes!
A MOBA game tailored for mobile, enjoy competitive gaming in just 15 minutes. Use your intellect in battle, combine strategy with skill, fight to the death, and become the MVP of the match! Team up with friends anytime, coordinate with rational hero selections, use your synergy with friends to sweep the battlefield with skill combinations, and become the heroes who dominate the battlefield!
4. Team-Based Fair Competition! Fun and Fair, It's All About Skill!
Dominate the field with skill, pursuing glory with your team. No hero cultivation, no stamina system, bringing back the original joy of gaming! A fair competitive environment without additional pay-to-win aspects. Superior skill and strategy are your only means to victory and championship honor.
Enter the mobile arena where legends are born, and valor is tested with every challenge you face.
5. Local Servers, Local Voiceovers, Local Game Content, Smooth gaming, immersive experience!
Local servers ensure smooth gaming experiences for you; localized hero voiceovers immerse you in every exciting battle; localized heroes and skins allow you to use your familiar heroes to achieve victory. At the same time, Honor of Kings prepares excellent AI for you. When you or your teammates disconnect, the AI will temporarily control the character to assist you in continuing the battle, ensuring you don't lose the victory due to outnumbered battles.

bluejetty:00062771:ios.summary:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
Kids Learning games provide the most wonderfully bubbleful educational expe
bluejetty:00062771:ios.description:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
Kids Learning games provide the most wonderfully bubbleful educational experience for kids! 
Teaching names and recognition of LETTERS, NUMBERS, SHAPES, COLORS, TOYS, ANIMALS, FRUITS, VEGETABLES and more. 
================================ 
* 10 Educational Learning Categories 
* 220 Interactive First Words Flash Cards 
* 3 Engaging Kids Learning Games 
================================ 
Baby Bubble School is a colorful, wonderfully bubbleful educational experience for curious young minds. Teaching names and recognition of LETTERS, NUMBERS, SHAPES, COLORS, TOYS, ANIMALS, FRUITS, VEGETABLES and more, Bubble School makes learning awesome for all TODDLERS and PRESCHOOLERS. The application was developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app in cooperation with educational experts to ensure the application is suitable for this very special age category. 
***** 10 Educational Learning Categories***** 
- Uppercase Letters (FREE)
- Lowercase Letters 
- Numbers 
- Shapes 
- Colors 
- Toys 
- Farm Animals 
- Zoo Animals 
- Fruits 
- Vegetables 
Baby Bubble School offers the following THREE ENGAGING GAME MODES in which you can play all of the aforementioned learning categories: 
EXPLORE 
Let’s Pop: Children will love this free exploratory learning mode! Full of bubbles with objects whose name is pronounced once the child pops the bubble, Let’s Pop is a fun little game where children can explore on their own pace. 
LEARN 
Let’s Learn: In Let’s Learn, children systematically learn the names of objects by browsing through them in either alphabetical or random order. 
PLAY 
Let’s Play: In this mode, children test their skills by tapping on bubbles filled with objects whose name is called. 
APP FEATURES: 
* 10 Educational learning categories 
* 220 Interactive first words flash cards 
* 3 Engaging game modes 
* Appealing, child-friendly interface with adorable animated animal characters 
* Possibility to choose uppercase / lowercase / or capitalized words 
* Hints option for Let’s Play mode to help parents tailor difficulty for their child 
* Option to turn on / off sounds and music 
* All pronunciation done by professional voice-over actors 
Baby Bubble pop is fun and the app’s interface is simple enough even for the youngest learners -- as simple as popping a bubble! With appealing design and broad educational content, this bubbleful app is sure to provide an experience your children will love.

bluejetty:00161994:ios.description:
Keep track of your plants and grow your best garden with Gardenize!   
– Plant database with over 45 000 plants 
– Organize and create an overview of everything you have planted and where.   
– Get personalized plant care notes 
– Identify plants and add them directly to your digital garden  
– Get a historic overview of everything that has happened in your garden.   
– Set reminders, make notes and create to-do lists, visible in your calendar  
– Learn and be inspired by other gardeners and experts   
Download Gardenize now to let your digital gardening journal make it easier to overview, organize, understand, and develop your garden. Beginner, enthusiast or professional, let Gardenize be your Garden sidekick.   
FEATURES:   
PLANT DATABASE & CARE NOTES:   
Add plants from our database with over 45,000 species or by using the PlantID feature, and receive care advice along with other helpful information. Get personalized plant care tips tailored to your specific plants and garden location. 
SMART GARDEN PLANNING:   
With the smart calendar view, you get an overview of your to-do’s and you can easily plan your gardening. Set single or recurring reminders customized to your plant's needs and get notified when it’s time for watering, fertilizing, trimming, repotting, etc. Draw on images with the drawing tool to remember where you planted your bulbs or where and what to prune in the fall. Never forget a single plant again!   
ORGANIZE PLANTS & AREAS:   
Build your own unlimited garden library. For each plant, add your own photos, notes and caring instructions and connect it to one or many of your garden areas/cultivation sites. Organize your garden into an unlimited number of outdoor or indoor garden areas. Flowerbeds, borders, or raised beds, you can name them as you wish.   
NOTES & LISTS:   
The Event function is flexible and can be used for notes of all your gardening activities and events. Create your own "activity types" and link to plants and areas. Add photos & notes. Follow the progress of your efforts, monitor, and compare the results of your experiments on everything from growing development and crop rotation to nutrients. Create a Wishlist or a to-do list.   
SMART FILTERING:   
Use the filtering function to easily see where your plants are placed in your garden, what was done, and planted where in your garden. Stay aware of when you seeded your carrots or get a complete list of all your tomato varieties!   
INSPIRATION   
Use the inspiration feed to get gardening inspiration and all the answers you are looking for. Search & save posts you like, so you easily find them again. Get inspired by fellow gardeners and check out their gardens!   
GARDEN COMMUNITY   
Connect with garden friends, take a look inside their gardens and invite others to look into yours. You can also search for public parks and gardens to visit. Connect and share knowledge via the chat function.   
MULTIPLE PHOTOS   
Saving many images of a plant or an area is an excellent way to keep track of and remember how it has looked over time.   
DATA EXPORT 
Neat freak or Excel nerd? By exporting and downloading your data to a spreadsheet you can print lists of your plants to share with others and a good way to have a backup and summarize costs.   
Gardenize is free to download and use with the basic functions. Subscribe to Gardenize Plus to enable all features. It comes with a free 14-day trial and you can subscribe and unsubscribe whenever you want to. The content you add during your Gardenize Plus period will still be available for you if terminating your subscription. 
Gardenize is available in 8 languages!
Questions, suggestions or improvements? Contact us: customerservice@gardenize.com   
https://www.gardenize.com/terms_and_conditions_en/   
https://www.gardenize.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00038801:ios.name: Video Chat - Mira
bluejetty:00038801:ios.summary: Mira is a video chat platform where artificial intelligence turns communication into an exciting adventure. Create unique AI avatars, dive into thrilling video chats, and make friends from all over the world. Enjoy easy and safe communicati
bluejetty:00038801:ios.description:
Mira is a video chat platform where artificial intelligence turns communication into an exciting adventure. Create unique AI avatars, dive into thrilling video chats, and make friends from all over the world. Enjoy easy and safe communication, with gaming elements and an RPG system to bring unforgettable emotions! Discover new horizons of communication with Mira!
A unique fusion of common yet functional video chat and advanced artificial intelligence models, Mira was designed to take the communication experience of its users to the next level. It features the ultimate application for those who would like to enjoy making new acquaintances and chatting with people while exploring a wide array of image generation capabilities.
MIRA’S KEY FEATURES
▷ Create and Customize
We believe that every person is exceptional and authentic. So are the characters that Mira users can create using state-of-the-art artificial intelligence capabilities. Just describe in words what your desired avatar should look like, choose the style and type of your character, and the magic of AI will do the rest.
▷ Choose Your Interlocutor
There is a unique individual behind each and every AI character in Mira. Keep that in mind when choosing your chatting partner by avatar. Who’s this anime girl or that cyberpunk guy in real life? It’s up to you to find out. Anyway, this might well be the beginning of another amazing story with incredible experience.
▷ Keep in Touch
Mira is happy to offer its users familiar yet sound and polished features for communication. Handy and secure live video chat, coupled with a text messenger and contact list. Communicate by video with your AI character to reflect your mood, send and receive messages to connect with people miles away from you. Everything that you've gotten used to, multiplied by efficiency and flexibility.
▷ Chat Using Your Avatar
Whether you wish to add more excitement, or just don’t want to rush it, use your avatar for as long as you wish. Your AI-generated character will be there for you until you decide to take the next step.
▷ Masks Off!
Ready to show yourself and chat without any avatar? You may take off your AI mask at any time. If your partner does the same, you both will see each other unmasked. A perfect opportunity to better feel the vibe of your match.
▷ Make Chatting a Game
Mira adds a playful twist to chatting with fun game elements and an RPG-style leveling system. Make friends, complete tasks, earn points, and level up — chatting has never been this engaging!
▷ Your Safety Comes First
Mira effectively implements a two-layer protection system for its users. In addition to 24/7 moderation, it features the built-in SafeView mode, which allows you to connect only with safe users and filters out inappropriate content. Try one of the safest video chats available!
▷ Get More of Mira!
Enjoy the company of the person you chat with and get to know each other better. Start as many chats as you wish, make acquaintances, learn more about people and yourself, improve your communication skills and have more fun with Mira!
----
Privacy Policy: https://mira.chat/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://mira.chat/terms.html

bluejetty:00013736:ios.description:
Want to write? Start thinking like a writer! Writerly will show you how.
Writerly is for everyone interested in creative writing. From first steps to advanced topics, Writerly is loaded with advice, exercises, ideas and prompts to help you develop as a writer, whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro.
Our new AI Toolkit unleashes the power of Apple Intelligence to bring you tools to spark your creativity, brainstorm your ideas, help you research books and novels, and create characters and writing exercises - it's like having an always-available creative writing friend!
Writerly includes a huge amount of unique content that has been extensively tested and trialled by professional authors and creative writing students. So have fun, get inspired and get writing!

- Available for your Mac, iPhone and iPad!

- AI Toolkit (for research, exercises, brainstorming and more)

- Warm-up exercises
- Meet your characters (like speed dating with your characters!)
- Ways into Character (in-depth character development tools, techniques and exercises)
- A Year of Prompts (a writing prompt for every day of the year)
- How to work with sensory detail
- Core character development exercises
- Built-in timer for exercises
- Widgets (daily prompts and character generation right on the home screen)
- Progress tracker

foodora - the easiest online food ordering app with the biggest selection of restaurants in Finland. Try it now if you haven’t already!

foodora app in a nutshell:
*Easy and fast way to order food online with your smartphone in Finland.
*The largest selection of restaurants, including but not limited to, Hesburger, Burger King, Lie Mi, Hanko Sushi, Fafas.
*A vast variety of cuisines - We have dumplings, smoothies, sushi, Asian food, kebab, soups, you name it!

With the restaurant ratings you can find the best restaurants in your area. Ordering food delivered to your home has never been this easy! With the foodora app you can order food in almost all cities in Finland such as Tampere, Helsinki, Turku, Espoo, Jyväskylä, Kerava, Oulu or Vantaa. Everything under one app - foodora!

bluejetty:00154669:ios.description:

bluejetty:00026073:ios.description:
GED® Test Prep 2026 is an application that has been carefully designed and developed by industry test experts. It has over 1,400 high quality test questions with answer explanations, multiple test modes and a scientific analysis system to help you practice efficiently anytime, anywhere, giving you a better chance of passing the GED® test on your first try!
GED® Test Prep 2026 now supports General Educational Development test preparation. Our test experts will update and revise it according to the latest test syllabus provided by The American Council on Education.
GED® Test Prep 2026 provides you with everything you need to pass the test with confidence. Our experts have carefully studied previous exam content and the latest exam requirements, and have expertly categorized all subjects on the exam so you can practice more specifically for your situation.
Specifically, we provide you with the following resources:
* 6 efficient test modes;
* Subject classification based on the exam syllabus;
* Over 1,400 high-quality questions with answer explanations;
* Performance tracking and analysis system;
* Good user interface design and smooth functionality.
Preparing for the GED® exam can be difficult, but with the help of GED® Test Prep 2026, we are confident that we can help you achieve your goals if you are determined to pass the certification exam and are willing to put in the effort and perseverance to do so!
Don't get confused or frustrated with preparing for the GED® test anymore, effective change takes time and effort, follow in the footsteps of GED® Test Prep 2026 and enjoy this fun experience that will keep you motivated! 
Let's get started right now!
***
Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to gain access to all features, courses and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted from your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged according to the rate and term of the subscription plan you choose. Subscribers' accounts will be charged an automatic renewal fee 24 hours before the end of the current term.
You can manage your subscription after purchase by turning off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Use: http://www.supertest.vip/Terms-of-Service.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.supertest.vip/Privacy-Policy.html
If you have any questions or suggestions regarding use, please feel free to contact us via email at contact@supertest.vip.
LEGAL NOTICE:
We are NOT affiliated with any testing agency, certificate, test name or any trademark. All Trademarks are the property of respected trademark owners.
DISCLAIMER :
All the features we provide are for your practice or study before the exam only. Your success on these questions or quizzes does NOT necessarily mean that you will pass the certification or that you will perform well on the exam.
GED® is a registered trademark of the American Council on Education and may not be used without permission. The GED® and GED Testing Service® brands are administered by GED Testing Service LLC under license.

bluejetty:00015816:ios.description:
Select the desired rail and connect it. 
Just tap to lay rails.
Create a railway with elevated rails, forking rails, etc., as you want.
Create a railway for your favorite train or bullet train and exercise your imagination and creativity. 
Great fun to run a train on a railway you created, and a great sense of accomplishment!
Add train stations and tunnels to customize it. Then run trains on it! 
Instructions
Tap the screen to add the desired rail. 
Tap the arrow in the direction you want to lay the rail. Very easy to lay rails. 
Tap on a background part to add buildings and trees wherever you want. 
After building the railway, tap on the Put Train button and select a train!
You can add and delete trains and change the running direction. 
After you are done, tap the Start Train button to start running the train.
When the train approaches a fork, use the following Fork button to switch the train's direction.
Camera Mode
Press "+" to zoom in. 
Press "-" to zoom out.
Press the arrow to change the camera angle. 
Train tracking: Press ON to track a train.

bluejetty:00165044:ios.name: AGF app
bluejetty:00165044:ios.summary: O app AGF foi criado para ajudar você a tomar as melhores decisões de investimento, selecionando as ações mais adequadas para gerar renda passiva. Com ele, você tem acesso a um controle detalhado e acompanhamento preciso dos dividendos da s
bluejetty:00165044:ios.description:
O app AGF foi criado para ajudar você a tomar as melhores decisões de investimento, selecionando as ações mais adequadas para gerar renda passiva. Com ele, você tem acesso a um controle detalhado e acompanhamento preciso dos dividendos da sua carteira.
Baseado na metodologia do megainvestidor Luiz Barsi Filho, o aplicativo AGF é direcionado a pessoas físicas que desejam aprimorar a gestão de seus dividendos.
Confira as principais funcionalidades do app do AGF:
1. Importação de Carteira:
- Importação via B3: Permite importar e sincronizar automaticamente os dados de investimentos registrados na B3.
- Importação Manual: Através de notas de corretagem ou por planilha.
2. Mapa de Dividendo Inteligente (MDI):
- MDI: Ferramenta que mostra quando as principais empresas pagadoras de dividendos historicamente anunciam suas distribuições. O MDI pode ser acessado diretamente pela aba de Investimentos e permite ordenar as empresas por Dividend Yield, proximidade do MDI, ou as mais investidas pelos usuários da plataforma.
3. Ranking de Empresas:
- Visualização do Ranking: O ranking oferece opções de filtros avançados, como dividendos, setores específicos, e outras métricas financeiras.
4. Yield on Cost (YoC):
- Cálculo do YoC: Mostra a rentabilidade dos ativos e da carteira ao longo dos últimos 12 meses, excluindo o mês atual.
5. Tipos de Preço Teto:
- Preço Teto Médio: Calcula o preço máximo a ser pago por uma ação para obter um dividendo de 6% ao ano com base nos pagamentos médios dos últimos seis anos.
- Preço Teto Projetivo: Utiliza projeções de analistas para o ano fiscal corrente para determinar o preço teto.
- Preço de Consenso: Baseia-se nas estimativas de analistas de mercado para definir o preço máximo recomendado para compra de uma ação.
6. Comunidade:
- Interações na Comunidade: Um espaço para compartilhar ideias, insights, negociações, e resolver dúvidas. A comunidade está organizada em diferentes categorias como “Para você”, “Geral”, “Insights”, “Negociações”, e “Dúvidas”.
7. Conteúdo Educacional:
- Treinamentos AGF: Cursos e vídeos de diversos níveis de conhecimento sobre a Bolsa de Valores.
- Lives: Acesso a transmissões ao vivo e gravadas da Família AGF, realizadas semanalmente para assinantes.
8. Configurações de Perfil e Segurança:
- Notificações e Segurança: Personalização de alertas e notificações da plataforma e ativação de autenticação de dois fatores para proteger informações da conta.
Você pode testar tudo isso gratuitamente sem a necessidade de cadastrar um cartão.
====
O AGF:
- Somamos 2,5 bilhões de reais em dividendos que nossos membros receberam;
- 13 bilhões de reais em carteiras de ações consolidadas;
- Mais de 300 mil investidores que já se beneficiaram do nosso app;
- Somos uma instituição com parceria com a Columbia Business School;
- Já formamos mais de 30 mil alunos com nossos cursos.
====
Ficou alguma dúvida?
Nossa equipe de suporte e vendas está disponível de segunda a sexta, das 9:00 às 18:00 horas para responder às suas perguntas.
E-mail: suporte@acoesgarantem.com.br
Whatsapp: (11) 91343-7080
====

News has never been more local than in the palm of your hand. The WBRL mobile app brings you all the top stories from our daily broadcasts, as well as stories developing in real time.
Experience the brand new WRBL News 3 app.
The WRBL.com app is On Your Side with the latest breaking news for Georgia and Alabama; including local news from Columbus, Auburn, Opelika, Eufaula, Americus, LaGrange, and your hometown, too.
Get the forecast and track storms on our First Alert weather radar.
Keep up with sports from Auburn, UGA, Alabama, the SEC, and your favorite high school team.
Plus, see exclusive aerial video from the Ranger 3 Video Drone.
All the info you need and everything you love about WRBL News 3 On Your Side is right at your fingertips.
FEATURES:
• Watch video of your trusted reporters on the scene, and read revealing articles on what's going on in your community.
• Plan your day and week with detailed weather conditions, live alerts of severe conditions, and an interactive radar map.
• Optional alerts on breaking news keep you in the know.
• On the go? Save stories for later to access at your convenience.

bluejetty:00030197:ios.name: Soul Knight Prequel
bluejetty:00030197:ios.summary: Soul Knight Prequel is a pixel-art action RPG featuring loot farming. Slash monsters to upgrade your power, or party up for treasure against the odds. Our newest ARPG continues to feature Soul Knight's familiar posse of chibi characters, wh
bluejetty:00030197:ios.description:
Soul Knight Prequel is a pixel-art action RPG featuring loot farming. Slash monsters to upgrade your power, or party up for treasure against the odds. Our newest ARPG continues to feature Soul Knight's familiar posse of chibi characters, while satiating the fans' hunger for more lore and quests!
The game’s story begins prior to the events of Soul Knight. Help the magical land’s heroes form a knighthood, embark on an epic quest, vanquish foes with every combination of weapons and spells, and ultimately save Mystraea from impending doom.
[The Pixel Dark ARPG: A Masterclass in Mayhem]
Drop into Mystraea - a realm where spellcraft and steel collide - for an adrenaline-spiking action RPG experience. Carve through hordes, farm legendary loot, theorycraft the ultimate loadout, and pop open chests like piñatas. It’s an absolute dopamine rush, and every single run hits the spot.
[Class Warfare: Curate Your Combat Silhouette]
Thief, Archer, Warrior... pick your poison. Whether you want to brawl in the trenches, snipe from the shadows, sling arcane artillery, or tank a freight train, we've got you covered. Hit Level 12 to unlock Prestige Classes, offering a massive, interconnected web of skills and Specializations. Or, roll a Heroic Class to bypass the evolutionary grind and scale straight to god-tier power from day one!
[The Theorycrafter’s Sandbox: A Symphony of Synergy]
Dive into a ridiculous reservoir of gear. Stack Fatebounds and experiment with endless affix permutations that never get old - turning every drop into a calculated winning. Monsters don't just die; they explode into showers of pure build-crafting potential. The deeper the grind, the harder you scale, and the more obsessed with the math you'll become.
[Squad Dynamics: Multiply the Chaos, Divide and Conquer]
Rope in your crew to push maps, raid dungeons, and completely dismantle boss mechanics together. Solo play delivers that pristine, immersive RPG isolation, but squads turn the server into an all-out, unstoppable steamroller. Double the firepower, double the absolute havoc!
[Seasons in Flux: New Epochs, Zero FOMO]
With shifting seasonal epochs, limited-time phenomena, and fresh progression goals, the world reinvents itself every time you log in. The meta evolves, and your power ceiling rises, but the grind stays respectful of your time. You’re always in the endgame, never trapped in the FOMO.
[Blood, Sweat, and Botanicals: The Art of the Downtime]
It’s not all high-octane dungeon crawling! Retreat to Chillstead Village to curate your drip, harvest your crops, and let the adrenaline settle. Slay like a demon, chill like a local - that’s the true rhythm of Soul Knight Prequel.
Follow Us

- Tiktok: @soulknightprequel
- Twitter: @ChillyRoom
- Instagram: @chillyroominc

bluejetty:00036237:ios.description:
Reach your goals faster with BWS+ all-in-one fitness coach.
Frustrated with cookie-cutter workout plans and confusing nutrition advice? BWS+ is your intelligent coach and complete fitness companion for achieving the body you've always wanted. The app integrates insights from leading fitness scientists, coaches, and dietitians, offering personalized advice based on your unique body and goals. It evolves with you, adapting your workouts and nutrition based on real-time feedback, encapsulating decades of experience into a dynamic coach that tailors itself to your needs.
The latest science, personalized to you
- Hyper-Personalized Workouts: Built with Science's advanced algorithm creates a workout plan specifically for your body, goals, and schedule. Whether you're hitting the gym or training at home, we've got you covered.
- Progressive Overload Guidance: Never plateau again. BWS+ tells you exactly how to adjust your weights and reps each session for continuous gains.
- Real-Time Diet Adjustments: As your body changes, so do your nutritional needs. Our app adapts your meal plan weekly, ensuring you're always on track.
All-in-One Fitness and Nutrition Solution
- 250+ In-Depth Exercise Tutorials: Master proper form with our detailed video guides, packed with science-based insights.
- AI-Powered Meal Scanner: Say goodbye to tedious calorie counting. Simply snap a photo of your meal, and our AI does the rest, accurately tracking your nutrition in seconds.
- Daily Knowledge Boosters: Unlock 200+ bite-sized lessons to build your fitness IQ and make informed decisions about your health.
One App is All You Need
- AI Fitness & Nutrition Assistant: Get personalized answers to your fitness and nutrition questions, as if you're talking directly to Jeremy Ethier.
- Muscle Group Prioritizer: Focus on specific muscles that need extra attention for balanced development.
- Recomp Detector: Track simultaneous fat loss and muscle gain with our advanced body composition analysis.
- Step Tracking and Daily Activity Goals: Seamlessly integrate with Apple Health and Google Fit to optimize your overall activity levels.
We've combined cutting-edge technology with years of scientific research to create an app that delivers real, lasting transformations. No more guesswork, no more wasted time in the gym. BWS+ provides the structure and guidance you need to finally achieve the body you deserve.
Download now and take the first step towards the best version of yourself!
This app requires an active BuiltWithScience+ membership or an in-app subscription purchased through the App Store to access its features and content. Subscription details and terms are available within the app.

Link 2048 Puzzle game, with Minimalistic & Modern designed Blocks and Number in the Game, which lets you think out of the box with all creativity that you have and sharpen your mind with numbers. If you hate numbers or math, or you are thinking games with numbers are not fun, come and try this game and you will change your mind!

You get to enjoy playing this new top rank puzzle game for free while also improving your brain power, concentration, working details all at the same time without any stress.

- Slide the same blocks and with numbers in any of the eight directions (up, down, left, right or diagonally) to merge them.
- Link the blocks to higher numbers when you merge multiple same numbers together that sums up to the next numbers.
- Link it all and merge all the numbers to get the highest score possible to be the one on top!

- Minimalist & Modern game design.
- Simple but satisfying controls.
- Easy gameplay but hard to master.
- Don't worry losing the data, Automatic Data Save.

bluejetty:00044183:ios.name: Backyard Baseball '97
bluejetty:00044183:ios.summary: Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997! Build your roster from the iconic cast of 30 characters stacked with charming personalities and witty banter, and get the edge on the competition with power-ups, fireball pitches, s
bluejetty:00044183:ios.description:
Rediscover the joy of the original Backyard Baseball 1997! Build your roster from the iconic cast of 30 characters stacked with charming personalities and witty banter, and get the edge on the competition with power-ups, fireball pitches, super strength, and Pablo Sanchez!
Play pick-up games, practice batting, and compete in single games or a whole season with simple, intuitive controls that anyone can master!
Game Modes:
Random Pick-up: A quick way to jump right in! The computer chooses a random team for you and itself, and the game starts immediately.
Single Game: You take turns with the computer to choose players from a random pool of characters.
Season: You create a team and manage it through a 14 game series. The opposing teams are computer generated. At the end of the season the best two teams advance to the BBL playoffs (best of 3). The winner advances to the championship series which consists of the Super Entire Nation Tournament (best of 3) and then the Ultra Grand Championship of the Universe Series (best of 5)!
Batting Practice: Choose a batter and face Mr. Clanky for some batting practice. This is where you’ll learn just when to click to make your chosen batter hit that ball!
T-ball - Select T-ball mode for more accessible game play. Simply click to hit, run, and field!
BACKYARD BASEBALL RULES
The rules for Backyard Baseball are a hybrid of Pro and Little League rules:
No leading off
No Injuries
Bunting is allowed
Tagging up is allowed
Stealing is allowed
At our core, we are fans first–not just of video games but of the Backyard Sports franchise. Fans have asked for accessible and legal ways to play their original Backyard titles for years, and we are excited to deliver. Without having access to the source code, there are hard limitations on the experience we can create. Backyard Baseball '97 runs buttery smooth for iOS devices, looks better than ever, and creates a new installation for digital preservation within the Backyard Sports catalog that allows the next generation of fans to fall in love with the title that started it all.

bluejetty:00151721:ios.name: Crazy Taxi Driver Game
bluejetty:00151721:ios.summary: Pick up riders, turn on autopilot and focus on whatever madness is happening in the back seat. Every ride becomes a mini sandbox experience where you can chat with passengers, poke them, tease them calm them down, or simply sit back and wat
bluejetty:00151721:ios.description:
Pick up riders, turn on autopilot and focus on whatever madness is happening in the back seat. Every ride becomes a mini sandbox experience where you can chat with passengers, poke them, tease them calm them down, or simply sit back and watch pure chaos unfold.
Earn cash from every trip and use your money to unlock fun items in the store. Clean your taxi, upgrade your tools and prepare for random events that make every ride feel fresh and unpredictable.
Passengers are powered by a full physics-based ragdoll system with funny reactions. They dance, fight, mess around, annoy you on purpose, interact with the car or surprise you with weird and hilarious behavior. Some riders come with unusual challenges from strange requests to unexpectedly gross or funny tasks.
Sometimes passengers are friendly. Sometimes they’re complete disasters. How you deal with them is totally up to you.
This is not a serious driving simulator. It’s a silly, chaotic, cartoon-style taxi game.

Free. Secure. Anywhere. Mobile Banking from York State Bank lets you easily view and manage your money right in the palm of your hand anytime, anywhere! Best of all, it’s free.
Mobile Banking is available to all registered Online Banking customers; just download the app and enroll or log in with your Online Banking user name and password for a secure Mobile Banking experience.
FEATURES
- Quickly access your account with Touch ID®
- View account balances and transaction history
- Pay your bills and credit cards
- View scheduled and recent payments
- Transfer money between your York State Bank accounts
- Transfer money to other customers at York State Bank
- Set up and receive account related alerts
- Deposit checks – Snap a photo of your checks and deposit them remotely
- Track and view images of your processed checks
- Use your phone’s GPS to find a branch or ATM near you
- Contact a customer service representative
SECURITY
At York State Bank your security is always our top priority
- Account information is never stored on your phone
- Data transmissions are encrypted with the same secure technology as Online Banking
HOW TO GET STARTED
- Mobile Banking is free from York State Bank (but your mobile carrier’s message and data rates may apply)
- Download the app and log in with your Online Banking username and password
View our Security Statement at: https://www.yorkstatebank.com/comp/popups/security-statement.fhtml
RESTRICTIONS
- Deposits are subject to verification and are not available for immediate withdrawal
- See the terms in the app for limits/availability and other restrictions

bluejetty:00171753:ios.name: Hexa Sort
bluejetty:00171753:ios.summary: Hexa Sort offers a delightful mix of stacking and sorting puzzle challenges, strategic matching, and satisfying tile merging experience. Challenge your mind with stimulating brain teaser games that involve clever puzzle solving and logical
bluejetty:00171753:ios.description:
Hexa Sort offers a delightful mix of stacking and sorting puzzle challenges, strategic matching, and satisfying tile merging experience. Challenge your mind with stimulating brain teaser games that involve clever puzzle solving and logical maneuvers, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a mental workout. 
Hexa Sort introduces a unique twist to the classic sorting puzzle concept, inviting players to explore the art of shuffling, connecting, matching and organizing hexagon tile stacks. With the goal of achieving color matches, players can dive into the excitement of challenging puzzles and enjoy the calming effects of tile stacking brainteasers for adults. Each level presents challenges to meet collection goals, providing a perfect balance of excitement and stress relief for those who prefer relaxing casual games. 
The game's aesthetics boast a visually pleasing palette with gradients, creating a serene and zen environment for players to enjoy. Dive into the world of color puzzle games, color sorting, block stacking and free therapy through the game's minimalistic design. The inclusion of 3D graphics adds an extra layer of immersion, allowing players to view the puzzle board from various angles while engaging in the satisfying processes of stacking, matching and merging tiles. 
Hexa Sort is more than just a game; it's a captivating and relaxing free puzzle game experience, full of brain teasers, tile puzzles and colorful challenges that demand creative thinking. As players progress through levels, they'll find the gameplay to be both addicting and calming, striking the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. Put your puzzle solving skills to the test with tasks involving sorting, stacking, and merging hexagon tiles. 
Unlock new levels to keep your brain sharp, reveling in the therapeutic experience of captivating color matching puzzle games. The game caters to enthusiasts of color fill 3D and challenges based on hexagon tile structures. Invite friends to join the excitement, compete for high scores, and share the joy of engaging in fun puzzle games. Hexa Sort challenges players to become a masterful color matcher, skillfully pairing and organizing tiles. 
FEATURES: 
- Easy-to-play & relaxing gameplay 
- Tons of challenging color match puzzles and brain teasers for adults and children 
- Smooth 3D gameplay graphics 
- Vibrant colors & gradients 
- Power-ups & boosters to help solve puzzles 
- Satisfying ASMR gameplay sound effects 
Embark on a captivating journey of color matching, tile sorting, block stacking and tile merging with Hexa Sort. Whether you're a fan of block games, crave stress relief, or enjoy colorful brain teasers, this game promises a harmonious fusion of entertainment and mental stimulation. bluejetty:00122516:ios.description:
A digital wallet that does more than store. 
With Beem you can pay, request, transfer and split money – plus earn rewards and keep your loyalty and gift cards – all in one place. It’s easy, secure and free to download. 
---------------- 
One wallet. Many possibilities. 
Say goodbye to the bulky, chuck in your bag retro wallet, and say hello to a shiny, new, all-in-one app that does more than store cards. 
Pay people. Not accounts. 
We facilitate payments, but we’re not a bank. Beem syncs up to your contacts, so you flick it over, divvy it up or call it in with anyone in your network. No bank details needed. 
Split the bill. Not friendships. 
Track and split expenses between mates without any chasing or awkward convos. You can even create multiple groups for friends, family or workmates. Just enter the amount, we calculate who-owes-what, and everyone settles up. Quick, easy, and all in the app. 
Get cashback. When you spend. 
Unlock more value with online and in-store offers via Beem Rewards. Shop in-person with your linked cards or online via the app and watch your savings grow. 
BPAY® on Beem. Easy as. 
Master your bills in moments. With BPAY built-in, you know where your money is going and when it’s going to land. 
Maximise loyalty. Store in one place. 
Time to declutter all the plastic, punch cards and apps. Beem digitalises all your loyalty cards together in one place. 
Less risk. More reward. 
Do you know what present everyone really loves? Choice. Buy and send a personalised gift card from your wallet to theirs.

bluejetty:00061949:ios.name: Anatomyka
bluejetty:00061949:ios.summary:
Anatomyka is not just another 3D atlas. It's a precision-crafted, high-resolution model of the human body, designed for medical students, educators, and healthcare professionals.
All content is organized into anatomical systems and hierarc
bluejetty:00061949:ios.description:
Anatomyka is not just another 3D atlas. It's a precision-crafted, high-resolution model of the human body, designed for medical students, educators, and healthcare professionals.
All content is organized into anatomical systems and hierarchies, so you always know where you are and what you are looking at. Explore the blood supply, innervation, and interrelationships of organs directly in the 3D model. You can color-code everything for better overview and memorability. Only in 3D space will you see how they really connect.
**INTRODUCING PRO EDU LICENSE!
Create your own ePosters and share via link – perfect for teaching and collaboration.
*WHY ANATOMYKA IS UNIQUE
• 13,500+ anatomical structures – One of the most detailed 3D models in the world
• Stunning visual quality – High-poly modeling, multiple styles, color-coded organs
• Interactive ePosters – Save any screen with labels, share via link, browse hundreds of official ePosters
• World-first textbook integration – Own Memorix? Scan QR codes or enter chapter codes to jump from 2D book illustration to exact 3D model instantly. No other app offers this. No book? No problem – all ePosters work fully on their own
• Clear anatomical hierarchy – All organs organized by systems with hide/show layers, regions, and related structures (vascular supply, innervation, syntopy)
**KEY FEATURES
EXPLORE EVERY SYSTEM
Skeletal, muscular, joints, digestive, respiratory, urinary, reproductive, nervous, endocrine, arteries, veins, and general anatomy
RELATED ORGANS
For any organ, instantly see blood supply, innervation, and syntopy (how organs sit next to each other)
CUSTOMIZE YOUR VIEW
Colorize structures, hide or isolate, fade layers, rotate, zoom. Switch between Classic, Dark, or Cartoon style
LABELS & NOTES
Create your own labels and pin them to structures. Add notes. Perfect for learning and teaching
ePOSTER GALLERY
Hundreds of ready-made ePosters organized by anatomical systems. Use them for quick revision or presentations
MULTILINGUAL
Available in 8+ languages: English, Latin, Spanish, Italian, Polish, Czech, Slovak, Russian, and more
SHARING (PRO EDU)
Create custom ePosters and share them via link. The link includes a preview image and opens directly in the Anatomyka app. Perfect for educators sharing with students or colleagues. Sharing Anatomyka-Memorix ePosters is available for all users.
**FOR EDUCATORS: ATLAS PRO EDU
Create and publish your own custom ePosters. Share interactive lessons via a simple link on social media. Ideal for classroom teaching, online courses, or patient education
**TRY FOR FREE
Free access: Skeletal system with 4,500+ landmarks, general anatomy, body regions.
3-day free trial unlocks all anatomical systems and ePosters.
We're constantly working on Anatomyka – new features, systems, and organs are coming very soon.
**CONTACT & LEGAL
Built with passion for the medical community. Your feedback shapes the future.
email: info@anatomyka.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.anatomyka.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.anatomyka.com/terms-of-service/
If you choose to purchase a subscription, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the iTunes Store after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

Hours and Minutes Calculator, ( Hours Calculator )
With this time clever calculator you can perform the addition and subtraction operations between hours and minutes, it also allows you to multiply and divide those hours and minutes with i
bluejetty:00090667:ios.description:
Hours and Minutes Calculator, ( Hours Calculator )
With this time clever calculator you can perform the addition and subtraction operations between hours and minutes, it also allows you to multiply and divide those hours and minutes with integer numbers, for example:
1 hour and 36 minutes x 3 = 4 hours 48 minutes
2 hours and 15 minutes + 30 minutes * 2 = 5 hours 30 minutes
33 minutes / 2 + 1 hour and 56 minutes = 2 hours 12 minutes
Supports operations up to 99.999 hrs
You have 6 memory banks to save the result of hours and minutes of an operation, so you can use it later.
We have also added a history of operations so you never get lost and you can check the latest operations
I show case examples where this simple hour calculator is very practical:
* Time and attendance: How much working time? enter the time of departure and subtract the time of entry.
* Parking time control: Calculates the number of hours a vehicle has been in the parking lot.
* Hours tracker / hour tracker: to calculate hour minute of a task, your freetime, in time, to calculate if you did hour of extra.
* Calculate the duration of an event (duration calculator or hourstracker)
* To convert from standard time to military time, simply add 12 to the hour. So, if it's 5:30 p.m. standard time, you can add 12 to get the resulting 1730 in military time. To convert from military time to standard time, just subtract 12 from the hour, calculate hours.
* Time on any task, minutes in that period.
* Calculate the time until a specific point in time.
or simply use it as an hour calculator as time app.
This tool is widely used by people who work in places where they have to make calculations of hours, and with a simple and standard calculator it is not useful. As for example in human resources departments, where they often need to calculate the working hours / work hours of an employee, sometimes with several entries and exits in the same day, for example if an employee starts work at 08:15 and ends his working day at 17:08, it is not so easy to make these calculations, to know the worktime, if you do not have this tool used as a clever calc app.
The time, a minute, an hour is not a problem, this time app CalcTime is specially adapted to combine them in mathematical time operations.
Terms of Use → https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00019280:ios.description:
Bros vs Foes!
At every turn, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles have thwarted Kraang Prime’s plans to terraform the Earth into Dimension X. What’s an evil overlord to do? Hatch a nefarious new scheme, to create an army of Ultra Mutants! Everywhere, the Kraang have kidnapped mutants - including the Ninja Turtles - for their DNA!
With his brothers pulled through a Kraang Dimension X portal, Leonardo must recruit the Ninja Turtles’ allies and foes alike before it’s too late. 
Hang on to your shells!
ORIGINAL NINJAS: Explore the Turtles universe with an All-New Original story. Battle your way through 7 chapters and over 70 stages to take on the baddest of bosses – Shredder, Kraang and more!
RESPECT THE SHELL: For a limited-time, play and experience an all-new chapter based on this summer’s blockbuster, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows! When their recon mission goes awry, the Turtles must take on the Foot Clan and favourite bad boys Bebop and Rocksteady! Fight to win and collect these exclusive characters!
TURTLE POWER: Help Leonardo as he takes on the Kraang army to save his brothers and fellow mutants. Play alongside Leonardo in a 5-on- 5 battle with your favorite TMNT characters.
MUTANT MAYHEM: Collect and level up over 30 TMNT characters! Train them to learn their super sweet moves and build your Turtle-rrific team! Don’t forget to pack your freezer for Ice Cream Kitty!
SHRED ALERT: For the very first time, fight the Kraang as a Ninja Turtle friend… or FOE! Collect and play as Tiger Claw, Rocksteady, Bebop, and more. Create strategic teams and take on the Kraang!
FOOD FIGHT: Collect daily prizes and card packs to enhance your team!
WE RUN THIS TOWN: Fight against the Kraang in the Ninja Turtles’ favorite locations from the TV show, including Dimension X, the sewers and the classic New York City rooftops!
Gentlemen, let’s save the world!

Bros vs Foes!

At every turn, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles have thwarted Kraang Prime’s plans to terraform the Earth into Dimension X. What’s an evil overlord to do? Hatch a nefarious new scheme, to create an army of Ultra Mutants! Everywhere, the Kraang have kidnapped mutants - including the Ninja Turtles - for their DNA!

With his brothers pulled through a Kraang Dimension X portal, Leonardo must recruit the Ninja Turtles’ allies and foes alike before it’s too late. 

Hang on to your shells!

ORIGINAL NINJAS: Explore the Turtles universe with an All-New Original story. Battle your way through 7 chapters and over 70 stages to take on the baddest of bosses – Shredder, Kraang and more!

TURTLE POWER: Help Leonardo as he takes on the Kraang army to save his brothers and fellow mutants. Play alongside Leonardo in a 5-on- 5 battle with your favorite TMNT characters.
MUTANT MAYHEM: Collect and level up over 30 TMNT characters! Train them to learn their super sweet moves and build your Turtle-rrific team! Don’t forget to pack your freezer for Ice Cream Kitty!
SHRED ALERT: For the very first time, fight the Kraang as a Ninja Turtle friend… or FOE! Collect and play as Tiger Claw, Rocksteady, Bebop, and more.  Create strategic teams and take on the Kraang!
FOOD FIGHT:  Collect daily prizes and card packs to enhance your team!
WE RUN THIS TOWN:  Fight against the Kraang in the Ninja Turtles’ favorite locations from the TV show, including Dimension X, the sewers and the classic New York City rooftops!

Gentlemen, let’s save the world!
