High school is ending and the world is ending with it.
A Space for the Unbound is a slice-of-life adventure game with beautiful pixel art set in the late 90s rural Indonesia that tells a story about overcoming anxiety, depression, and the relationship between a boy and a girl with supernatural powers.
Follow two high school sweethearts, Atma and Raya, on a journey of self-discovery at the end of their high school years. When a mysteriously supernatural power is suddenly unleashed threatening their existence, they must explore and investigate their town to uncover hidden secrets, face the end of the world, and perhaps learn more about each other.
Set in a small town inspired by 90s era rural Indonesia, A Space for the Unbound presents an endearing story-driven experience with a vibrant environment waiting to be explored.
Key Features:
- Throwback to the 90s! Let us take you to Indonesia in the late 90s.
- Explore rural Indonesia and enjoy its relaxing atmosphere with a hint of supernatural events.
- Chat and interact with other townfolks and listen to their personal stories.
- Dive into people's minds Inception-style.
- Listen to beautiful music composed by Masdito "Ittou" Bachtiar

bluejetty:00041422:ios.description:
Unleash Your Parking Skills!
Park Match is a captivating puzzle game that challenges your spatial reasoning and strategic thinking. 
As a parking attendant extraordinaire, your mission is to guide vehicles into their designated parking spots, one level at a time.
How to Play:
Strategic Swaps: Swipe to swap adjacent vehicles and create matches of three or more identical cars.
Clear the Level: Eliminate all cars from the parking lot to advance to the next level.
Power-Ups and Boosts: Utilize special power-ups like bombs and rockets to clear multiple cars at once and overcome challenging obstacles.
Time Challenges: Race against the clock in timed levels to earn bonus rewards and prove your parking skills.
Key Features:
Endless Fun: Hundreds of levels, each with unique challenges and puzzles.
Addictive Gameplay: Easy to learn, hard to master, with increasing difficulty as you progress.
Beautiful Graphics: Immerse yourself in vibrant, colorful graphics and animations.
Relaxing Soundscapes: Enjoy soothing music and sound effects that enhance the gaming experience.
Offline Play: Play anytime, anywhere, without an internet connection.
Are you ready to become a parking master? Download Park Match today and start your parking adventure!

Introducing the new and improved AIA Vitality app! With more ways to Know Your Health, Improve Your Health, and Get Rewarded, our new app makes it easier to engage with the AIA Vitality program and earn rewards.
What is AIA Vitality?
AIA
bluejetty:00156204:ios.description:
Introducing the new and improved AIA Vitality app! With more ways to Know Your Health, Improve Your Health, and Get Rewarded, our new app makes it easier to engage with the AIA Vitality program and earn rewards.
What is AIA Vitality?
AIA Vitality is a personalised, science-backed health and wellbeing program that supports you to make healthier lifestyle choices every day.
Using the principles of behavioural science, AIA Vitality incentivises you to take small steps towards improving your wellbeing and leading a healthier, longer, better life.
For each healthy decision you make, you will be awarded with points that add up to your AIA Vitality status, giving you access to great rewards and benefits.
So, the healthier your choices, the more points you'll earn, the higher your status, the greater your rewards.
Engaging with the program
Use this new app to engage with AIA Vitality by syncing your fitness devices and apps, tracking your progress, and enjoying the many rewards and benefits the program has to offer. You can also link Apple Health and upload activity data to earn AIA Vitality Points. AIA Vitality uses data from the Apple Health app with your permission. You can choose to allow Steps, Workouts, Heart Rate, Mindful Minutes or Sleep data to be shared to earn AIA Vitality Points. 
Thank you for being a part of AIA Vitality
We will continuously update this app to include new features, so be sure to check back regularly for updates.
We're always here to help
If you have any problems or want to make suggestions to improve the app, please contact us at queries@aiavitality.com.au.

bluejetty:00160664:ios.summary: Welcome to an epic adventure in a CYOF (Choose Your Own Fantasy), DnD-inspired (Dungeons and Dragons) RPG (Role-Playing Game) on your mobile device! In this immersive game, you play as a half-elf, navigating through a classic RPG world fill
bluejetty:00160664:ios.description:
Welcome to an epic adventure in a CYOF (Choose Your Own Fantasy), DnD-inspired (Dungeons and Dragons) RPG (Role-Playing Game) on your mobile device! In this immersive game, you play as a half-elf, navigating through a classic RPG world filled with danger, mystery, and excitement.
One of the standout features of the game is the power of your choices. Every decision you make has a real impact on the story, shaping its direction and outcomes. Your choices matter, and the consequences of your actions ripple through the game, creating a dynamic and ever-changing narrative.
As you progress, you have the opportunity to shape your character's playstyle. Whether you rely on brute force, charming charisma, or stealthy tactics, you can customize your character to suit your preferred approach. Your character truly becomes your own, and your decisions in how you develop them have a direct influence on how you overcome challenges and interact with the world.
This game is a Fan Hobby project, created with passion and dedication to deliver an authentic RPG experience. There's not a big commercial enterprise behind it, but rather a labor of love that aims to bring joy to fellow RPG enthusiasts.
Explore the world and uncover interesting items and powerful weapons that can aid you on your quest. From enchanted artifacts to legendary blades, your discoveries can enhance your abilities and help you overcome formidable foes.
With over 1000 unique scenes, the game offers a vast and rich world to explore. From treacherous dungeons to lush forests, bustling cities to ancient ruins, you'll embark on a thrilling quest filled with challenging encounters, intriguing quests, and memorable characters. Along the way, you'll face tough moral dilemmas that will test your courage, wisdom, and judgment.
The game offers customizable text size and font options, allowing you to personalize your reading experience to match your preferences. No more straining your eyes or struggling with small text!
To get a taste of the adventure, the first chapter is available for free, allowing you to experience the game before deciding to unlock the full version with a one-time purchase. No ads or in-app purchases, just a complete and unforgettable RPG experience!
Are you ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure in this CYOF, DnD-inspired RPG? Your destiny awaits as you shape the story, find intriguing items and weapons, and uncover the secrets of the world. Download now and join us on this Fan Hobby project!
Music credits:
Adventure (remaster) by Alexander Nakarada (CreatorChords)
The Great Battle by Alexander Nakarada (CreatorChords)
Sunguard by Alexander Nakarada (CreatorChords)
https://creatorchords.com
Music promoted by https://www.free-stock-music.com
Creative Commons / Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Darren Curtis
https://www.darrencurtismusic.com

With over 1000 unique scenes, the game offers a vast and rich world to explore. From treacherous dungeons to lush forests, bustling cities to ancient ruins, you'll embark on a thrilling quest filled with challenging encounters, intriguing quests, and memorable characters. Along the way, you'll face tough moral dilemmas that will test your courage, wisdom, and judgment.


The game offers customizable text size and font options, allowing you to personalize your reading experience to match your preferences. No more straining your eyes or struggling with small text!


To get a taste of the adventure, the first chapter is available for free, allowing you to experience the game before deciding to unlock the full version with a one-time purchase. No ads or in-app purchases, just a complete and unforgettable RPG experience!


Are you ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure in this CYOF, DnD-inspired RPG? Your destiny awaits as you shape the story, find intriguing items and weapons, and uncover the secrets of the world. Download now and join us on this Fan Hobby project!

bluejetty:00083880:android.description:

Embark on an epic journey where you'll play as a warrior wielding ancient powers, exploring the vast world alongside your faithful companions, holding apeace and order.

☆ Strategic Combat, a Blend of Wisdom and Courage
Battle is not just a test of courage but also of wisdom. You need to come up with clever tactics based on different battles and enemy features. Combine your abilities and equipment carefully, utilize strategies to gain the upper hand in battle, and show your combat intelligence.
☆ Idle Auto-Battle, Carefree Growth
Even amidst the busy life, your heroes will continue to grow. With the idle system, you can still earn EXP and resources offline, making your heroes stronger. When you return to the game, you'll find yourself ready to face new challenges.
☆ Explore the World, Discover Unknown Secrets
This world is full of unknowns and wonders. You'll be exploring mysterious ruins and traversing vast continents. Each adventure may bring new discoveries and surprises. Uncover the secrets hidden behind this world and become a true hero.

bluejetty:00062292:ios.summary:

Children are very curious and always wondering where things come from or how they are made. With “How Are Things Made?” they will have a fun and edu
bluejetty:00062292:ios.description:
Play and discover where chocolate comes from, how a shirt is produced or how bread is made.
Children are very curious and always wondering where things come from or how they are made. With “How Are Things Made?” they will have a fun and educational way to satisfy their curiosity.
“How Are Things Made?” is a very entertaining didactic application, which gives children the opportunity to explore how everyday objects and foods are made and manufactured through games, animations and short explanations.
Discover how chocolate, T-shirts, and bread are made, how a skateboard is developed and how a book is created.
In addition, it includes a large number of educational games and animations. Everything moves and everything is interactive: characters, machines, trucks, factories...
CHARACTERISTICS 
• Learn basic information about objects and typical food.
• Discover the curiosities about the origin and manufacturing of chocolate, bread, skateboard, T-shirts and books.
• Dozens of educational games: clean the impurities from the cotton to make thread, screw the wheels on a skateboard, mix the ingredients to make bread, grind the grains to make flour, lift the bags into the truck, pass the rollers to print the book…
• Entirely narrated. Perfect for children who cannot read yet and for children who are starting to read.
• Content for children age 5 and over. Games for the whole family. Hours of fun.
• No ads.
WHY "HOW ARE THINGS MADE?" ?
Because it is a user-friendly, educational game that excites children with educational games, interactive animations and beautiful illustrations to better understand where everyday objects and food come from. Download it now to:
• Discover where things come from in a fun way.
• Learn about everyday objects. What is their origin? How are they manufactured?
• Know the raw materials from which our food is obtained, such as wheat, salt, and cocoa.
• Play fun and educational games.
• Enjoy educational entertainment.
Children love to play and explore. With this application, they will also find answers to some of their questions and learn about daily life through games.
ABOUT LEARNY LAND
At Learny Land, we love to play, and we believe that games must form part of the educational and growth stage of all children; because to play is to discover, explore, learn and have fun. Our educational games help children learn about the world around them and are designed with love. They are easy to use, beautiful and safe. Because boys and girls have always played to have fun and learn, the games we make - like the toys that last a lifetime - can be seen, played and heard.
At Learny Land we take advantage of the most innovative technologies and the most modern devices to take the experience of learning and playing a step further. We create toys that could not have existed when we were young.
Read more about us at www.learnyland.com.
Privacy Policy
We take Privacy very seriously. We do not collect or share personal information about your children or allow any type of third party ads. To learn more, please read our privacy policy at www.learnyland.com.
Contact us
We'd love to know your opinion and your suggestions. Please, write to support@learnyland.com.
Terms of Use: http://learnyland.com/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00093360:ios.description:
A IZA é uma seguradora digital diferente de tudo o que você conhece. Nascemos com a missão de ajudar quem está no corre todos os dias e, através do nosso seguro, levamos proteção em caso de acidentes a todos os brasileiros de forma rápida, fácil e sem burocracia. 
Com o Seguro IZA, profissionais autônomos e também as empresas que contam com essa mão de obra no seu dia a dia têm à disposição um seguro personalizável, que atende as necessidades do seu trabalho.
Entre as coberturas oferecidas pela IZA estão: 
 Atendimento médico, hospitalar e odontológico 
 Diárias por afastamento temporário do trabalho
 Invalidez total ou parcial
 Morte acidental
 Auxílio funeral
E o melhor: o valor pode ser usado entre as coberturas contratadas. 
Através do aplicativo IZA, o segurado tem na palma da mão todas as informações que precisa e pode consultar o status do seguro, contratar novas coberturas, verificar pagamentos, falar com nosso time de especialistas caso aconteça um acidente, enviar documentação, entre outros serviços. 
A IZA conta, ainda, com tecnologia de ponta para oferecer a melhor experiência aos clientes. Faça agora mesmo uma cotação de seguro e tenha, em segundos, a melhor proteção contra acidentes pessoais. 
DESTAQUES DA IZA
Lançada em março de 2021 após aprovação como seguradora digital no ambiente regulatório Sandbox, promovido pela Superintendência de Seguros Privados (Susep), a startup é referência no mercado e oferece em sua carteira um produto com coberturas em caso de acidentes pessoais. 
Todo o processo, desde a contratação até o pagamento das indenizações, ocorre em ambiente 100% digital, transparente e seguro.
A IZA foi eleita a Melhor Seguradora para Profissionais Autônomos, segundo a Revista Apólice, e está na renomada Lista das 100+ Insurtalks.
São mais de 250 mil segurados em todo o país e mais de 200 empresas parceiras da IZA, oferecendo aos seus prestadores de serviço a melhor proteção.
POR QUE A IZA É PARA VOCÊ?
É para todos: independente da profissão ou região
É rápido e fácil: cotação em segundos
É moderno: 100% digital
Melhor custo-benefício: preço que cabe no bolso
Personalizável: as proteções ideais para você, de acordo com o seu perfil.
Atendimento humanizado: time a postos pelo APP ou Central de Atendimento
Sem papelada: o segurado resolve tudo pelo APP ou Central de Atendimento

bluejetty:00061788:ios.summary: TurboScan turns your iPhone into a full-featured and powerful scanner for documents, receipts, books, photos, whiteboards, and more. You can quickly and accurately scan your multipage documents in high quality PDFs or JPEGs, name, organize
bluejetty:00061788:ios.description:
TurboScan turns your iPhone into a full-featured and powerful scanner for documents, receipts, books, photos, whiteboards, and more. You can quickly and accurately scan your multipage documents in high quality PDFs or JPEGs, name, organize and send them anywhere. 
• Featured in The NY Times, CNN Money and The Telegraph.
• “Absolutely the best... I've tried other scanner apps and this one is the only way to go. Never going back to the other apps… TurboScan sets the standard for scanning apps.” - User review.
• “…Would recommend this flawless and incredibly useful and perfectly executed app” - User review.
TurboScan uses advanced and fast algorithms to accurately detect document edges, straighten them (correct perspective), eliminate shadows and set a perfect contrast for black on white text. Color and photo modes are also available.
TurboScan boasts a powerful yet easy to use interface. Our handy "Email to myself" feature lets you quickly send documents with one tap.
TurboScan also offers SureScan, our proprietary scanning mode for sharper scans (especially useful in low-light conditions.) SureScan automatically takes three pictures of the same document, giving you a guaranteed perfect result every time.
We do not collect any data from TurboScan and all scanning happens on your iPhone. The confidentiality of your data is never compromised. 
TURBOSCAN FEATURES: 
• Automatic document detection and capture with perspective correction
• Features SureScan for the sharpest scans
• Document naming, folder organization and smart search
• “Email to myself” feature for quick, regular emails
• Add and reorder pages at any time
• Arrange multiple receipts or cards on a single PDF page for printing, easy viewing, etc.
• Send faxes using our Turbo Fax app
• Easily email & message documents or separate pages as PDF & JPEG
• Save documents or pages to Photos
• Face/Touch ID & passcode lock for increased security
• Upload, auto-upload or backup documents to iCloud Drive
• Open PDFs or JPEGs in Google Drive and other PDF cloud apps
• Combine scans via Merge or copy & paste separate pages
• Conveniently AirDrop documents to your Mac and other devices 
• Print documents via AirPrint
• Ultra-fast scanning (under 3 seconds per page) 
• Features VoiceOver for visually impaired users
• We do not collect any user data in TurboScan
TIPS ON SCANNING 
• Make sure your document is flat. 
• Use flash in low light conditions, but avoid glare with glossy documents.
We support Ukraine.
We're constantly improving TurboScan, and we value our customers' opinions and feedback. Please email us at support@turboscanapp.com with any questions or suggestions. Thank you!

bluejetty:00156922:ios.description:
Get ready for the Pennsylvania CDL (Commercial Driver's License) test with the ultimate study app. Designed specifically for aspiring truck and bus drivers, this app covers all the essential information and test questions you need to know to pass your CDL exam.
With our CDL practice tests, you can test your knowledge of the regulations and prepare for the DMV test with confidence. Our study guide covers all the topics included in the CDL knowledge test, including road signs, traffic laws, and safety practices. Our CDL test questions will help you measure your progress and identify areas where you need more practice. This app includes questions based on official Pennsylvania state DMV manual published by PA DMV.
Our app also includes information on the CDL endorsement tests and provides training on the skills and procedures you need to know for the CDL skills test. The CDL license section will give you a clear understanding of the certification process and what to expect at the DMV.
With our user-friendly interface and comprehensive content, this app is the perfect study companion for anyone preparing for the Pennsylvania CDL test. Download it today and start preparing for your dream career as a truck or bus driver.
Following is a brief overview of the facilities provided by the app.
- Practice tests design specially for you.
- Practice tests for various endorsements like Bus Endorsement, Passenger Endorsement, Double Endorsement, Tank Endorsement, HazMat Endorsement, Triple Endorsement etc.
- Bookmark questions you want to look at a later stage.
- Keep your progress for each practice test and view history. 
- Scope of improvements suggested based on your performance. 
- Practice test for Commercial Motor Vehicle (CDL) driver’s license test.
- Exceptionally large set of practice questions which covers every aspects of the test.
- Very intuitive and clutter free User Interface.
Why Choose Pennsylvania CDL Permit Practice Test ?
- We have prepared this app with heart and keeping in mind the questions asked in Pennsylvania CDL permit test.
- It makes preparation for the CDL test easy and quick.
- It also allows you to shorten your study and you can use it as your study guide.
- There are chances to get better score by doing practice with the questions and answers provided in this app.

bluejetty:00148611:ios.name: Curiosity: Knowledge is Power
bluejetty:00148611:ios.summary: In today's fast-paced world, accessibility to information has transformed radically. Movies have shifted from cinemas to the comfort of our homes via streaming platforms, and social media has replaced traditional magazines and newspapers wi
bluejetty:00148611:ios.description:
In today's fast-paced world, accessibility to information has transformed radically. Movies have shifted from cinemas to the comfort of our homes via streaming platforms, and social media has replaced traditional magazines and newspapers with instant, snappy content. But what about books? Enter "Curiosity: Microlearning Books" - an innovative app designed to make book-like knowledge more accessible than ever before.
Imagine combining the depth of books with the dynamic, engaging format of TikTok. That's Curiosity for you! It's not just an app; it's a revolution in the way we consume knowledge. Gone are the days of ordering expensive books, waiting for their delivery, and letting them gather dust on the shelf with scores of other unread books. Curiosity liberates you from these constraints, offering a wealth of knowledge at your fingertips.
Main Features:
Instant Knowledge, Anytime, Anywhere: Curiosity generates book-level knowledge in easily digestible snippets. Want to learn about quantum physics, Renaissance art, or modern psychology? Curiosity delivers it instantly in a format that takes no more than 2 minutes to consume.
Multimedia Learning Experience: Understanding that books can be daunting with their text-heavy content, Curiosity infuses learning with audio and visual aids. This multimodal approach caters to all learning styles, making the process more engaging and effective.
Personalized Learning Journeys: Your interests today might not be the same tomorrow. Curiosity understands this and adapts to your evolving curiosity. With its personalized content generation, you're always one tap away from learning something new and exciting.

bluejetty:00038027:ios.description:
Nova Poshta is a logistics company that quickly and reliably delivers documents, parcels, and cargo anywhere within Ukraine and abroad.
Download the Nova Poshta mobile app and manage your parcels delivery on your smartphone. 
ALL YOUR PACKAGES ARE AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Convenient parcel sorting on the home screen, statuses, and filters make it easy to find your parcels quickly.
SIMPLE PACKAGES TRACKING AND MANAGEMENT
All the details of your parcel movement are on your smartphone. Quickly and easily check the status of your parcels and order additional services: "Forwarding" and "Other recipient" if your plans have changed and it is inconvenient to receive them at the selected branch or post office, "Return", etc.
COURIER DELIVERY TO AN ADDRESS IN UKRAINE
Now you always know when to expect a courier. The mobile app displays the date and time of their arrival. You can also track their movement on the map, receive an alert 15 minutes before arrival, and chat and call the courier to clarify delivery information.
A large and heavy parcels? Order "Door-to-Door" delivery or "Send From Door" delivery in the app. If your plans change, you can change the date and time of the courier's arrival in one click.
EVEN EASIER TO CREATE A SHIPMENT
Create and track parcels in Ukraine and abroad in the mobile app. Easily track and manage your parcels online when it's on the move.
PAYMENTS AND MONEY TRANSFERS
Create shipments with money transfers in the mobile app and get money in a convenient way - to a bank card or in cash - at any Nova Poshta branch. Pay for parcels in a few taps.
MAP AND NAVIGATION
Easily and conveniently find the right branch or post office on the map in the mobile app.
NP SHOPPING
Shopping with Nova Poshta: delivery to Ukraine from online stores from around the world. Choose your favourite online stores and products, make purchases, pay conveniently, and receive your order at the nearest post office. Buying and delivering your favourite products is now even more affordable.

bluejetty:00082554:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00082554:ios.description:
Welcome to Abalon, a legendary tactical roguelike and deck building RPG!
CARDS. DICE. TACTICS.
Embark on epic roguelike adventures to explore a tabletop inspired world and discover its secrets. Abalon combines turn based tactical combat with deck building strategy. Defeat monstrous hordes and powerful bosses to reap the rewards of treasures, allies, and spells. Roll the dice and become a dungeon crawling legend!
COMMAND LIKE A GOD
Command from a top-down perspective that gives you ultimate control over battlefield tactics. Your characters look up to you (literally) as their god to indicate they are ready to receive your orders. Commands are intuitive: Drag cards to cast spells. Drag warriors to enemies to attack. Drag healers to injured allies to heal. Play fast and fluid with 3-5 minute battles and without having to wait for animations. You can even undo failed attacks to try different approaches. Endless possibilities are at your fingertips!
OUTWIT YOUR OPPONENTS
Defeat overwhelming odds by mastering tactical positions, backstabbing, feinting counterattacks, knocking enemies into allies to trigger combos, leveraging traps for bonus damage and exploiting spell synergies to manipulate the battlefield in your favor. Abalon is deceptively simple to learn with an unrivaled depth of mechanics that are challenging to master. Position matters. Facing matters. Terrain matters.
BUILD THE PERFECT DECK
Choose compelling characters like squirrel hurling druids, menacing liche kings, psychic lizard wizards and steampunk time traveling rats. Abalon has over 500 cards including 225 hand-crafted characters with distinct strengths and weaknesses. Select your favorite summoner, build your team and construct a deck of 20 cards. Abalon differs from other role-playing games by removing grindy leveling systems in favor of fixed character stats and abilities and interchangeable gear-based upgrades. Use everyone you have and experiment to create unique strategies.
UNLEASH CREATIVE COMBOS
Combine your units and spells to create game-breaking synergies: Hurl a squirrel at your opponent and command your critter to bite them in the butt. Cast Animal Growth to mutate it into a super hulk squirrel. Then use Breed to multiply it into an army of hulk squirrels and decimate your opponent in the most satisfying way! Discover something new each time you play.
EXPLORE. ROLL DICE. MAKE FRIENDS.
Explore an ever-changing fantasy world filled with colorful woodlands, frozen peaks, barren deserts, and perilous dungeons. Abalon is rich in lore, both gritty and humorous, and each biome offers its own characters to find and mysteries to unravel. Collect and roll D20 dice to determine the outcome of fate encounters and make friends with charming bears and birthday goblins.
EXPAND YOUR COLLECTION
Play for free and grow your collection with paid expansions. Abalon is a premium CCG and RPG that respects your time and money. There are no ads, randomized booster packs, cards to dust, or grinding to level up. Each expansion contains a curated set of content so you know what you are paying for upfront. Like a board game hobby, Abalon’s expansions enhance your existing content. We aim to support the game’s development for the next 10 years and beyond with additional cards, challenge modifiers, game modes and more for infinite replayability.
PLAY ON ANY DEVICE ANYTIME ANYWHERE
Abalon offers a true cross-platform experience with support for phones, tablets, computers, TVs, portrait and landscape orientations and offline play.
ABOUT D20STUDIOS
We’re a passionate indie game team who aim to inspire creativity, critical thinking and positive community in people around the world. We value player-driven development, quality products and excellent customer service, and we’d love to hear how we can make your Abalon experience exceptional.
Discord: https://discord.gg/d20studios
Email: contact@d20studios.com

bluejetty:00034382:ios.description:
Welcome to Healville Hospital, The most fun hospital simulation game ever!
In the game, you need to build various modern hospitals to help the residents of the town improve their health. Each town has its own unique diseases, and you need to build and upgrade various facilities to discover and treat these illnesses. Once you earn enough money, you can expand your business and build more advanced hospitals.
Game Features:
-Build Hospitals
Start building each hospital from scratch and enjoy the fun of construction. Simply walk to the task point to start building; it's very simple! Besides diagnostic and treatment facilities, hospitals also feature various beautiful decorations and facilities to meet patients' needs, such as snack and drink vending machines.
-Hire and Manage Staff
You need to hire doctors, nurses, cleaners, and other staff to run the hospital. Upgrade your hospital staff to enhance their abilities, and don't forget to wake up the employees who are slacking off or falling asleep!
-Discover Diseases
Each town has unique diseases, and you need to upgrade and build various facilities to discover these diseases. If you fail to discover these illnesses in time, patients will leave disappointed, and the hospital's rating will drop.
-Treat Diseases
Construct pharmacies, injection rooms, wards, physiotherapy rooms, electrotherapy rooms, psychotherapy rooms, and more to treat various interesting and peculiar diseases.
-Continuous Expansion
Keep building new hospitals and expanding your business to become a hospital tycoon!

bluejetty:00127418:ios.description:
To find the precode:
- Switch on the car radio and hold button 1 and 6 (in some cases it is necessary to remove the car radio)
- The precode is composed of 1 letter and 3 digits. For example: G842, H786, I814
Enter the code in your car radio?
With Buttons
· Press the "1" button several times for the 1st digit to be displayed
· Press the "2" button repeatedly for the 2nd digit to be displayed
· Press the "3" button repeatedly for the 3rd digit to be displayed
· Press the "4" button repeatedly for the 4th digit to display "
· Press and hold the "6" (or "5") button to save code (10 seconds)
With Stalk Control
· Turn the dial to enter the numbers.
   Press the bottom button to move.
· Hold down the button to save the code.
With Remote Control
· Press the [¬] button to turn the dial to enter the numbers.
· Press and hold the [¬] button to save code

WHAT'S INSIDE "PAW PATROL ACADEMY"
• Fun and interactive missions with your child's favorite "PAW Patrol" characters 
• Learning games for preschoolers to help kids practice topics like ABCs, spelling, counting, numbers, shapes and more
• Kids can explore topics like emotions, self-care and life skills with Heroes in Training classes
• Preschoolers can wind down with calming coloring activities or get moving to the music with dance parties
THE MOST EXCITING WAY TO EXPERIENCE "PAW PATROL" 
• Join the pups in Adventure Bay to explore the TV show kids love
• Kids become the heroes of their own adventure stories and play with Chase, Rubble, Marshall, Zuma, Skye, Rocky and Ryder
• With tons of engaging and kid-friendly activities, preschoolers learn new skills through play 
FUN LEARNING OPPORTUNITIES 
• Cognitive: Problem-solving, task completion and focus
• Social: Communication, conflict resolution and community values
• Emotional: Resilience, self-expression and confidence
• Creative: Coloring, music and songs
• Physical: Fine motor skills, dancing and movement
KIDS CAN PATROL ON THEIR OWN
• Highly immersive adventures and self-guided activities provide frustration-free play for toddlers
• Ad-free and easy for young kids to explore independently
ABOUT SAGO MINI
Sago Mini is an award-winning company devoted to play. We make apps, games and toys for preschoolers worldwide. Toys that seed imagination and grow wonder. We bring thoughtful design to life. For kids. For parents. For giggles.

bluejetty:00198220:android.description:

Using state-of-the-art language processing technology, VoiceAnswer can understand and respond to your queries in natural language, making communication with machines more intuitive and efficient than ever before.

VoiceAnswer has been trained on a massive amount of text data, including books, articles, and websites, so its responses are accurate, relevant, and helpful.

"What's the best way to prepare for a job interview?"
“Can you tell me a fun fact about koalas?"
“What are some good exercises I can do at home without any equipment?"
"What's the best way to learn a new language?"
"How do I make my own website?"
“Can you tell me a recipe with these ingredients (list whatever you have available)?”

bluejetty:00017096:ios.description:
Need some help making sure your child is staying on the nice side of the list this holiday season? Or do you want to prank your little brother or sister into thinking they've been naughty this year?
Naughty or Nice allows you to do just that! With Naughty or Nice you can be sure that everyone will want to make the nice list this holiday season. Use Naughty or Nice as a motivator to ensure your child is behaving for Santa year round. 
Baffle your friends and family by never getting a naughty result on yourself! 
Simply select the outcome before having someone scan their finger and watch as they are amazed by the results. Tap the countdown label at the top to select a different outcome, or continue to let them try again and again with the same results. 
Naughty or Nice Features
- Positive reinforcement to behave from Santa
- Use year round to keep your child on the nice list 
- Prank your friends with ease 
- Countdown to Christmas 
- Widgets with a live countdown to Christmas for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, in your own font and colors
- Over 20 different holiday stickers for iMessage
How to use holiday stickers for iMessage
To place a sticker over a message or picture, long press on a sticker, and then drag and drop it where you want it. You can also rotate and resize stickers before dropping them by pulling apart with two fingers.
This app is intended for entertainment purposes only and does not provide true finger scanning functionality

bluejetty:00161574:ios.name: Times Tables, Math Game: Artie
bluejetty:00161574:ios.summary: Artie is a 3D times tables and math practice game for kids aged 6 to 10 (grades 1 to 4). Children practice multiplication tables, division, addition, subtraction, number series and Roman numerals by playing with Artie, an animated 3D charac
bluejetty:00161574:ios.description:
Artie is a 3D times tables and math practice game for kids aged 6 to 10 (grades 1 to 4). Children practice multiplication tables, division, addition, subtraction, number series and Roman numerals by playing with Artie, an animated 3D character. No ads, no account, and three practice packs are free forever.
HOW IT WORKS
Artie hops into a bright 3D scene, says hello and gets to work. Rows of answers drift toward him and your child taps the right one before they arrive. A wrong tap costs one of three lives, a level is seven questions and about a minute, and missed questions sneak back until they stick. Bronze, silver and gold badges reward accuracy, speed and streaks. Between questions Artie fidgets, yawns, scratches his head and counts to himself, so kids feel they are helping a friend rather than doing drills.
WHAT YOUR CHILD PRACTICES
• Multiplication: times tables from 1 to 12, one table at a time or mixed, plus all tables up to 10 × 10 or 12 × 12. Optionally include the lower tables already learned so they stay fresh.
• Division: the same tables in reverse, and mixed multiplication and division.
• Addition: sums up to 10, from 10 to 20, up to 20, 30, 50, 100 and 200.
• Subtraction: the same ranges, and mixed addition and subtraction.
• Number series: skip counting by 2s to 12s, even and odd numbers, and series that cross into negative numbers.
• Roman numerals: read them and write them, from I to X up to years like MMXXVI.
Dozens of packs in total. Pick the one that matches this week's homework.
WHY IT WORKS
Artie is built on retrieval practice: short, frequent sessions in which kids recall math facts from memory under gentle time pressure. That is how multiplication tables and number bonds become automatic. The descending boxes create focus without stress, the three lives make accuracy matter, and the badges turn "please practice your times tables" into something kids ask to do.
3D OR AUGMENTED REALITY
Play in the 3D scene, or switch on the optional AR mode to place Artie and the answer boxes on your living room floor or kitchen table. AR uses the camera and works on both iPhone and iPad. The 3D mode needs no camera.
SAFE FOR KIDS
• No ads and no in-game chat.
• No account or sign-up. Install and play.
• Plays offline, on a plane or in the car.
• Parental gate on every external link.
• Music and sound effects can be muted.
30 LANGUAGES
Artie is localized into 30 languages, including Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Ukrainian, Turkish, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese and Vietnamese. Right-to-left layouts are complete, and Arabic speakers can practice with Eastern Arabic numerals (١٢٣), so children see math in the numerals they use at school.
FREE PACKS AND PREMIUM
Free to start, with three packs of your choice free forever. Artie Premium unlocks every pack for good with a single one-time payment, no subscription needed. A yearly plan is also available, and Family Sharing is supported.
MADE BY A DAD, TESTED BY HIS KIDS
Artie started as a weekend project: a father and solo developer built a small AR math game to help his three children, then 5, 7 and 8, learn their times tables. They tested every build, chose how Artie looks and moves, and their math genuinely improved. Four years and dozens of updates later, Artie is still a family-made app, and the kids are still the QA team.
GOOD FOR
Parents who want screen time that counts, teachers looking for a times tables game for the classroom or homework, homeschoolers covering arithmetic, and any kid who needs a confidence boost with math facts and mental math. Works on iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later.
Privacy Policy: https://artie.kominak.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://artie.kominak.com/terms

bluejetty:00083162:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00083162:ios.description:
SHARPEN YOUR DETECTIVE SKILLS in these thrilling murder mystery games “Criminal Archives: Blade of Deceit”! As a newly appointed police consultant, dive into a complex criminal case, finding hidden objects and solving intricate puzzles!
UNVEIL THE MURKY SECRETS lurking in the soap-scented shadows of danger-filled streets, enhancing your crime investigation prowess. With every clue, narrow your list of suspects, navigating through unexpected twists and deep mysteries as you solve one of the most vicious crimes in your career!
You have proven to be capable of cracking even the most vicious of crimes, so you get appointed as an official police consultant. Please, postpone the celebration… For now, the body of a judge has been found on the riverbank. As we all know, such a figure makes many enemies among the villains. Anyone could have killed him. However, after examining the crime scene and the body of the deceased, the pool of suspects narrows down dramatically. The clean-shaven chin of Judge Alexander Therpen is complemented by a fine cut in the jugular vein. And then your prime suspect turns belly up as well… but even that stumble won’t stop you, right?
MASTER DETECTIVE GAMEPLAY: Dive deep into a gripping criminal case, hone your investigation skills, and solve challenging puzzles and brain teasers to uncover secrets in a world where danger is always close at hand!
INTRIGUING STORYLINE WITH DEEP MYSTERIES: Assume the role of a detective known for cracking the toughest cases. Explore the mysterious murder and systematically eliminate suspects with each new piece of evidence you uncover in this complex narrative full of twists and turns!
ENGAGING PUZZLES AND ACHIEVEMENTS: Immerse yourself in a series of detailed puzzles and macabre mini-games. Earn achievements that showcase your ability to solve complex criminal puzzles and advance through increasingly challenging scenarios in the hidden object games!
COLLECTIBLE ITEMS AND EXTRA CONTENT: Keep your eyes peeled for unique collectibles and additional content that enhance your gameplay experience. Make pivotal decisions that influence the outcomes and unravel the fates of characters lurking in the shadows of crime!
PROVE YOUR WORTH as you navigate the challenging twists of an intricate murder case on the murky riverbank. The hunt begins now!
-----

Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

"Farm for toddlers" is made for small children. They love to tap the animals, flowers the sun and all the other things, they can interact with.
They are rewarded with cute graphics and funny sounds. 
The Farm scene is free of charge. Try it out, before deciding to unlock the full game through in-app purchase.
Four different scenes, Farm, Road, Bubble pop and Countryside.
Farm:
Tap the animals and the surroundings to interact with them, and to hear their sounds.
There are lots of hidden secrets, can you find them all ?
Road:
Hear the sounds from the road, and the river rushing.
Bubble pop: 
bubbles fly up in the sky, while the child needs to tap and pop them before they fall down again. 
Very addictive, while training the childs eye to hand coordination skills. 
Countryside:
Tap the animals and watch them run, and hear their sounds. Can you find the hidden animals ?

bluejetty:00190100:android.summary:
Do you want to know if someone is connected to your wifi network without your permission?
Simple tool to see all the devices connected to our network.
Using this app, in seconds you know how many and which device is connected to your rout
bluejetty:00190100:android.description:
Do you want to know if someone is connected to your wifi network without your permission?
Simple tool to see all the devices connected to our network.
Using this app, in seconds you know how many and which device is connected to your router with information like IP address, MAC ID and vendor info.
Search for your Router default username and Password in an offline database by your Router Brand or Model, in case of you haven’t change it before.
** Block WiFi - WiFi Inspector app useful Features : 
• Show history of all discovered networks easily
• Default Router Admin IP is 192.168.1.0, 192.168.0.1 or 192.168.1.1 etc
• Router Password List - Default Router Username and Password List - 192.168.1.1
• Display full profile such as device name, manufacturer, IP address and Mac address of device
• You can see default router passwords, username & router model name list.
• Detects your WI-FI Router Gateway by different mechanisms to support the variety of Routers gateways all over the world.

bluejetty:00149207:ios.description:
Motivated Moms is a chore calendar system - a pre-planned daily checklist of chores that will allow you to have a clean, organized home and still have time for yourself.
The Motivated Moms system is designed to help you complete chores and tasks throughout the year so you don’t spend your entire day doing housework. Larger jobs are broken into smaller tasks.
Motivated Moms is all about reducing stress, not adding to it, in order to make home management easier. If you don’t get a chore done, don’t worry about it - it will come around again.
The membership includes:
• Access to the Download Library
• Access to this app
• A private Facebook group for members where we share tips and community
The Download Library is a collection of over 18 versions of the plan in the form of downloadable, printable PDF files. The most popular download in the system is the Clean My House Planner. Also included are several resources such as a meal planning sheet.
Motivated Moms Mobile is the editable, digital version of the system which allows you to edit the tasks including the ability to:
• Change the task name, frequency, due date
• Assign tasks to members of your household
• Check off tasks as you complete them
• Sort the list by room, person, or A-Z
• Sync between your household devices so edits and checked tasks show on all devices
• Add unlimited custom tasks
The system also has a Bible reading plan included but it is optional. There are printables in the Download Library with and without it. In the app, you have the option to turn this setting off so you won’t see them in your list.
You can subscribe to Motivated Moms Mobile in-app and get all these features for under $1.99 per month. Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes will automatically be charged at the same price for renewal, as stated above, within 24-hours prior to the end of the current billing period. You can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
Terms of Use: https://motivatedmoms.com/membership-terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00030901:ios.summary: Can you escape Villa Lakeside is a free 3D escape room game set in a mansion standing by a quiet lake. Gather the clues, find hidden items, solve mystery puzzles, and escape. With Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers, even beginners can play wit
bluejetty:00030901:ios.description:
Can you escape Villa Lakeside is a free 3D escape room game set in a mansion standing by a quiet lake. Gather the clues, find hidden items, solve mystery puzzles, and escape. With Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers, even beginners can play with confidence.
Gentle ripples on the calm water, trees dampened by morning dew.
Numerous mysteries await in the mansion standing by the lakeside.
Can you gather the clues and escape from here?
Enjoy a leisurely time wrapped in the serene atmosphere of the quiet lakeside. Explore the mansion, search for the clues hidden inside, and find your way out.
■ An escape room game anyone can clear
The difficulty is set for beginners to intermediate players. Hint 1, Hint 2, and the answers are provided, so even if you've never played an escape room game before, you can play casually and clear it all the way to the end. Look closely, think it through, and enjoy the moment when everything clicks.
If you love mystery games, puzzle adventure games, or hidden object games, you'll feel right at home. Tap every place that catches your eye, collect items and hints, and use them to get the keys and open the way out.
■ Observation and a flash of inspiration
Tap any place you're curious about—you may find an item or a hint. Make full use of everything you find to get the keys. In this point-and-click escape game, sharp observation and a sudden flash of inspiration are what lead you out. Piece the clues together like a detective, one by one.
■ Keep the clues you want to see again
Found a clue you'll need later? You can save it and look back at it whenever you like, so you don't have to remember every detail or go back and search again. It's a small help that makes solving the mysteries of the mansion more comfortable.
■ Hints and answers when you need them
Stuck on a puzzle? Check Hint 1 first, and if you still need help, Hint 2. The answer is there too, so you never have to give up halfway. Use as much help as you like and enjoy the mystery at your own pace.
■ A quiet time by the lake
Calm water, a forest wet with morning dew, and a mansion standing quietly by the shore. Between puzzles, take a breath and enjoy the peaceful air of the lakeside. This escape game is made for a slow, relaxing moment.
■ Play anytime
Your progress is saved automatically, so you can play a little during a short break and pick up where you left off later. Or settle in on the weekend and aim to escape all at once.
■ Features
・Difficulty for beginners to intermediate players
・Hint 1, Hint 2, and answers
・Save clues to review later
・Autosave
・Free to play
■ How to Play
・Tap the place you are interested in
・You will get items and hints
・Make full use of them to get the key
・Observation and a flash of inspiration are important
■ Recommended for
・Beginners trying an escape room game for the first time
・Fans of room escape games, mystery games, and brain games
・Players who enjoy point-and-click adventures and finding hidden items
・Anyone looking for a relaxing puzzle game to play in short breaks
・Nature lovers who enjoy lakes, forests, and quiet scenery
■ More escape games from ArtDigic
ArtDigic creates 3D escape games set in beautiful villas, seaside houses, and resorts around the world. If you enjoy Villa Lakeside, look for our other escape room games and continue your journey from one mystery to the next.
Can you escape from the mansion by the quiet lake?
Enjoy your leisurely time.

bluejetty:00086193:ios.summary: It is a mobile app for health and activity of the eyesight. Eyes + Vision help you with myopia, hyperopia, amblyopia, cyclospasm (accommodation spasm), "lazy eye" syndrome, strabismus, "dry eye" syndrome, ocular strain etc. Also it helps to
bluejetty:00086193:ios.description:
It is a mobile app for health and activity of the eyesight. Eyes + Vision help you with myopia, hyperopia, amblyopia, cyclospasm (accommodation spasm), "lazy eye" syndrome, strabismus, "dry eye" syndrome, ocular strain etc. Also it helps to improve: well-being, vitality, precision, concentration, performance and stress relief.
Improve your eyesight with app features:
• 10 ready balanced variative workouts for eye training for everyday needs, for prevention and assistance in the treatment of ocular diseases.
• "My workouts" mode to create your personal vision trainings with any exercises and settings according to the medical recommendations for eyesight treatment or your choice.
• Access to 160+ exercises for eyesight with the ability to disable any exercise that doesn't suit you. All ocular exercises are animated and there are additional hints: graphics, voice, text and video.
• A widest range of visual exercises: to improve blood circulation, to relax ocular muscles, to relieve fatigue and tension, and enjoyable relaxation exercises!
• Convenient setting of training notifications.
• A choice of 15 nice comfortable graphical themes of interface. And, of course, large fonts and images for your convenience!
List of ready workouts:
• "Amblyopia" is a eyesight training for correcting a Lazy eye (for example, with strabismus). Use it as agreed with your oculist!
• "Dry eye" is a ocular training for everyday needs. Run it if you strain your vision for a long time (for example, when you are working at a computer) or if you have "dry eye" syndrome.
• "Accommodation" is a training which helps to prevent myopia and hyperopia, to cope with the cyclospasm (accommodation spasm), relax the ciliary muscles and relieve eye strain. Use it as agreed with your oculist!
• "Common Quick", "Common Medium" and "Common Full" are vision trainings for everyday needs. Use them to prevent eyesight decline. It is recommended to make a "Common Quick" workout every 2 hours during the working day. You may make "Common Medium" or "Common Full" workouts 1 time per day if it is desirable.
• "Myopia" relieves the spasm of accommodation, reduces the tension of the ciliary muscles and the lens of the eye, helps with the deterioration of the distance eyesight and eliminates pseudomyopia.
• "Hyperopia" trains the ciliary ocular muscles for prevention of presbyopia growth and helps against farsightedness and blurred near vision.
• "Sharp eyesight" is an vision training for everyday needs. This is a short workout to improve accuracy and concentration (for sports, work, driving, etc.)
• "Anti-stress" is an ocular training for everyday needs. Run it during a busy day to calm your eyes, relax or relieve stress.
If your oculist has advised you on certain vision exercises, you can use the "My workouts" mode to create your personal vision training or selectively run the eye exercises you need from the List of exercises.
Attention: self-treatment can be dangerous, so it is important to consult an ophthalmologist for the right diagnosis and recommendations for eye exercises adapted to your individual needs and vision condition. You can disable or skip any exercise during train by tap on the "Next" icon.
If you find an error, please write to our support email: funlika@gmail.com, so that we can fix it. We are very grateful to our users who help us to fix errors and bugs. We wish you health and vision clarity!

bluejetty:00035863:ios.name: Hearing Number
bluejetty:00035863:ios.summary: How’s your hearing? Learn your Hearing Numbers—the softest sound you can hear in each ear—with an app created by the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. Then use your Hearing Numbers to protect your hearing and hear better. Tra
bluejetty:00035863:ios.description:
How’s your hearing? Learn your Hearing Numbers—the softest sound you can hear in each ear—with an app created by the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. Then use your Hearing Numbers to protect your hearing and hear better. Track your hearing to know how it changes over time and encourage others to know their hearing. Take charge of your hearing wellness! 
Hearing Numbers can be as low as -10 or as high as 100 decibels, or dB. The higher your Hearing Numbers are, the louder sounds will need to be for you to hear them, and the harder it will be to hear and communicate in noisy places. 
Requires headphones, a quiet space, and about 5 minutes to complete.
No advertising, in-app purchases, or product recommendations.
The app tests the noise level around you, measures your hearing levels at four frequencies in each ear, and provides your Hearing Numbers. 
Share the Hearing Number app and encourage your friends and family to learn their Hearing Numbers. 
Re-check your Hearing Numbers from time to time and review previous results to track how your hearing changes over time.
Learn more about the Hearing Number and how to use it at app.HearingNumber.org.
This app is created by the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, seeking to empower people to know their hearing—millions at a time.
Disclaimer
This hearing wellness app does not constitute medical advice or diagnosis. You should consult with a health care provider for questions related to your hearing or if you are experiencing any of the following: ear pain or ringing, dizziness, ear drainage or a sense of something in your ear, sudden or fluctuating hearing loss, injury or deformity to your ear, or worse hearing in one ear (i.e., your right and left Hearing Numbers are different by more than 10 dB).

Welcome to Crowns. Crowns is a puzzle game, expertly crafted to blend the timeless appeal of logic puzzles with innovative strategic elements. Designed to stand out in the gaming landscape, Crowns challenges players to master a sophisticated grid-based puzzle, where the goal is to strategically place crowns while adhering to specific rules. Each row, column, and color region must contain exactly one crown, and crowns cannot be placed in adjacent cells.
Features:
Intellectually Stimulating Gameplay: Engage in a unique mix of logic and strategy that will keep your mind sharp and entertained for hours.
Visually Appealing Design: Enjoy a beautifully designed game with playful fonts and vibrant colors that enhance the gaming experience.
Varied Difficulty Levels: Tackle over 1500 meticulously crafted levels, including easy, medium, hard, expert, legendary and more each offering a distinct challenge.
Progressive Unlocking: Begin with the first level in each difficulty category and unlock new levels as you conquer each challenge.
Simple, Intuitive Controls: Place and remove crowns with ease using straightforward tap controls, making the game accessible for all ages.
Track Your Progress: Your progress is automatically saved, allowing you to resume your game anytime.
Download Crowns now and dive into a world of logical challenges and strategic thinking. Whether you’re looking for a quick puzzle to solve or a complex challenge to immerse yourself in, Crowns offers something for everyone. Compete against your peers, climb the leaderboard, and prove your prowess. Can you complete all 60 levels and become the ultimate Crown Master? Find out today!

Progressive Unlocking: Start with the first level in each difficulty category and unlock new levels as you complete each challenge.
Intuitive Controls: Easily place and remove crowns with simple tap controls, making the game accessible to players of all ages.

Make Your IG Profile Unforgettable with Story Highlight - Cover Maker
Your IG profile is your digital first impression—make it count with Story Highlight - Cover Maker. Whether you're a content creator, entrepreneur, influencer, or just so
bluejetty:00023412:ios.description:
Make Your IG Profile Unforgettable with Story Highlight - Cover Maker
Your IG profile is your digital first impression—make it count with Story Highlight - Cover Maker. Whether you're a content creator, entrepreneur, influencer, or just someone who loves a polished feed, this app is your shortcut to a standout profile. With just a few taps, you can create beautiful, custom highlight covers that reflect your unique style and give your profile a consistent, on-brand look.
Why Story Highlights Matter More Than Ever
IG Stories are one of the most powerful tools for sharing content, but they disappear in 24 hours. That’s where Story Highlights come in—they let you pin your best moments, promotions, and memories permanently to your profile. And with the right covers, you don’t just organize your content—you elevate it. Story Highlight - Cover Maker gives you everything you need to design clean, aesthetic highlight icons that draw your audience in and keep your brand story flowing.
Customize Without Limits
Forget cookie-cutter designs. With over 1,000 unique highlight covers to choose from, Story Highlight - Cover Maker lets you get creative without needing any design experience. Whether you’re into soft neutrals, bold graphics, or minimal icons, there’s something here to match every mood, niche, and brand identity.
Themes That Match Your Vibe
From elegant and minimal to fun and artistic, choose from dozens of professionally designed categories:
Boho-style story covers for that laid-back, artsy vibe.
Bold, colorful themes that pop on any profile.
Sleek black-and-white icon covers for a modern look.
Chalkboard and hand-drawn frames for creative flair.
Metallic gold, rose gold, and marble textures for a luxe feel.
Soft watercolor tones for a clean, delicate aesthetic.
Vintage, glam, modern, cute—you name it, it’s here.
Features Designed with Creators in Mind
No watermark on your designs
High-resolution images optimized for IG
Organized by style and theme for quick browsing
Easy download and upload to your IG highlights
Covers can be used across social platforms—not just IG
Get Started in Just a Few Steps
Open IG and go to your profile.
Tap and hold on the highlight cover you want to edit.
Select “Edit Highlight,” then tap “Edit Cover.”
Upload your new cover from your gallery (downloaded from the app).
Preview and save—it’s that easy.
No logins. No subscriptions. Just download, create, and upgrade your profile instantly.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/storyhighlightios/privacy/
Terms: https://zipoapps.com/storyhighlightios/terms/

bluejetty:00126543:ios.description:
Say goodbye to doubts, and say hello to India’s top doctors on Practo. Take complete care of yourself and your family from the comfort of your home - consult doctors online, book doctor appointments, order medicines online, and book diagnostic tests. 
Practo, India’s fastest growing telemedicine app, has over 1 lakh+ doctors and 70,000 clinics and hospitals covered under its network. It is a one-stop solution for all your healthcare and medical needs where you can:
Access instant video consultation across 25+ specialties
Book hassle-free online doctor appointments
Order medicines and get them delivered to your doorstep
Get End-to-end care for Elective Surgeries
Book lab tests and get free home sample collection
Buy family health plans for unlimited online medical consultations
Read expert-written articles and tips
Online doctor consultations from the comfort of your home
Connect with doctors online and address all health concerns over a private and 100% secured video call/audio call/ chat. Post your online doctor consultation, get a digital prescription and order medicines, or book lab tests immediately.
Get started with just four simple steps: 
 1. Enter your symptoms
 2. Select a specialist and pay online
 3. Wait 2 minutes to connect with one of the online docs 
 4. Consult via video/audio call/ chat and get online doctor advice
Find and book appointments with doctors near you
Tired of searching for the right doctor to go to? Worry no more! Choose from 1 lakh+ docs and specialists. Book appointments for General Physicians, Dermatologists, Gynaecologists, Pediatricians, Psychiatrists, Urologists, Orthopedists, and more specialities.
Every doctor registered on Practo Pro (our doctors’ app) undergoes a strict onboarding and verification process. 
Get up to 40% off on medicines and health products
Order medicines online and get them delivered to your doorstep. Find more than 50k medicines, health, and wellness products on Practo’s online medicine store. Save big with discounts and offers on medicines, surgical, and other products. 
End-to-end care for elective surgeries
Expert surgical care for 50+ ailments like Hernia, Piles and Anal Fissure. Get access to experienced surgeons, advanced medical technology, personal care assistants, financial help and post-surgical support.
Practo PLUS - Unlimited online consultations across all specialities
Buy affordable health plans (1 month and 6 months) and get access to unlimited online consultations for the entire family, with doctors available 24/7.
Awards and Recognitions
Contributor to the field of Indian ophthalmology by Karnataka Ophthalmic Society (KOS), iBeach Film Festival, Goa, 2019
News Corp VCCircle consumer internet company of the year award, 2017
Download this telemedicine app right away, & join our healthy community!
We’d love to hear from you. Drop us a line at support@practo.com
You can find us on www.practo.com, https://www.facebook.com/practo/ and 
https://www.twitter.com/Practo
Book doctor appointments for diabetes, cancer, weight loss, hair fall, Ear, ENT problems & more. Get online medical consultations for 25+ specialities including Psychology, Physiotherapy, Gynaecology, Dermatology, Gastroenterology, Dentistry, Orthopaedics, Ayurveda, & Homeopathy.
Disclaimer for Care AI: 
This app provides general health information and is intended for informational purposes only. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Do not disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read in this app.

bluejetty:00146309:ios.name: Arc Timeline - Trips & Places
bluejetty:00146309:ios.summary:
Automatically keep track of the places you visit, how you got there, and what you did while you were there. With a learning engine that gets smarter and more accurate the more you use it. 
FEATURES
- The highest accuracy cycling detection
bluejetty:00146309:ios.description:
Automatically keep track of the places you visit, how you got there, and what you did while you were there. With a learning engine that gets smarter and more accurate the more you use it. 
FEATURES
- The highest accuracy cycling detection available!
- Automatic running and cycling recording - no start button required!
- Automatic recording of places you visit, with analytics and statistics that evolve over time
- Automatic detection and recording of walking, running, cycling, driving, train, tram, bus, airplane, motorcycle, boat, skiing, snowboarding, wheelchair, and many more
- A learning engine that makes it possible to achieve increasingly accurate and detailed recordings of visits and trips, personalised specifically for you
- A searchable memory of your life's travels, searchable by places names, locations, activities, and more
- Export individual trips, or entire days, weeks, months, or years to standard GPX format files, for analysis and visualisation in hundreds of third party services and apps
AND MORE
- Collates place statistics, average visit durations, average calories burned, heart rate, and more
- Compare individual visit statistics to your averages
- Collates workout sessions, sleep times, and weather reports for each timeline item
- Altitude graphs for visualising mountain hikes, airplane flights, etc
- Daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly activity summaries, showing duration, distance, calories burned, and much more, for every activity type
- Automated daily and monthly exports in GPX format or full detail JSON files
- Save walking, running, and cycling workouts to Apple Health
- Moves app data importer
HEALTH DATA
Collection of Health data such as calories burned and heart rate requires an Apple Watch or other Apple Health connected device.
BATTERY USE
Arc is only awake and using GPS when you are active and moving. For the rest of the day Arc stays in a low power sleep mode, with GPS turned off, to conserve battery. 
On a typical day of two to three hours of travel a single full battery charge should last from morning to evening without requiring extra recharging during the day. However longer trips (for example a long hike or cross country drive) may consume more than expected battery, due to Arc needing to be awake and recording, with GPS activated, for the duration of the trip. 
For longer trips, I recommend plugging your phone into a car charger or battery pack, to avoid unpleasant battery surprises.
SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PURCHASES
A free trial, active subscription, or Lifetime purchase is required to use the app.
## Subscription Details
Your subscription will be charged to your iTunes account. At the end of the term your subscription will automatically renew in your iTunes account. You can turn off automatic renewal in your iTunes account settings at any time, but you must do so at least 24 hours before the end of the current term.
## Legal

bluejetty:00150578:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00150578:ios.description:
Infinite Mind - Brain Training Built on 30 Years of Science. Read Faster. Think Sharper. Just 7 minutes a day.
Infinite Mind combines speed reading, vision training, and mental processing into one powerful daily workout. While most brain training apps focus on one skill, Infinite Mind trains three.
Each session combines three clinically grounded disciplines that work together to strengthen your brain multiple ways: speed reading, vision therapy, and rapid mental processing. Most apps do one of these. Infinite Mind does all three, and the science behind it has been validated at major research universities, including Caltech - Pasadena, the University of Utah, and Brigham Young University.
What You Train
Speed Reading and Comprehension
Train your eyes and brain to process text faster without losing understanding. Most users see meaningful improvement in reading speed within the first few weeks. Progress is tracked in real time so you always know where you stand.
Vision Therapy
Strengthen the visual processing systems your brain relies on every time you read, drive, or follow a conversation. Vision therapy is a clinical discipline and one of the things that makes Infinite Mind different from every other brain training app on the market.
Rapid Mental Processing
Challenge your brain's ability to receive, process, and respond to information quickly. These exercises build the kind of mental speed that shows up in everyday life: sharper conversations, faster recall, and better focus under pressure.
What the Research Shows
Infinite Mind's training methods have been studied in independent academic research. This includes fMRI studies at the University of Utah measuring real changes in brain activity, reading speed research at Brigham Young University, and an independent academic impact evaluation conducted by Dr. Steven Shaha. The results show measurable improvements in cognitive performance across age groups.
What 2 Million Users Say
Over 2 million people worldwide use Infinite Mind. Rated 4.9 stars on the App Store. The results speak for themselves, and the research explains why they happen.
What's Inside
40+ science-backed brain games and exercises
Personalized goals with real-time progress tracking
Daily 7-minute sessions designed to fit any schedule
Reading speed assessments with accuracy reports
Vision therapy and eye-tracking exercises
Audio and visual cognitive training tools
Daily reminders to keep your streak alive
Who It's For
Infinite Mind started as a student performance tool. Since 2000, when it launched as eyeQ, it has helped students read faster, comprehend more, and process information at a higher level. Over time, the same training that sharpened young minds turned out be equally important for older ones.
In the last few years, millions of baby boomers have discovered Infinite Mind at exactly the right time. Research is clear that cognitive function declines as adults move out of their working years and into retirement. Memory, processing speed, and mental sharpness face real pressure during this transition. Dementia and Alzheimer's disease are affecting this generation at rates that are impossible to ignore.
Infinite Mind does not claim to be a medical treatment. What it does is give your brain a daily workout using the same methods that have worked for students, professionals, and now seniors.
Whether you’re 55 or older and want to stay sharp, a student aiming to improve how you perform every day, or a parent looking to give your kids, and yourself, the best in mental exercise, this app was made for you. The science works at every age. The only requirement is seven minutes a day.
Start your first 7-minute session today.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00074308:ios.description:
The meterUP app, powered by ParkMobile, gives you a smarter way to park in Philadelphia. Easily pay for on-street and off-street parking right from your mobile device. You can use the meterUP app in over 500 other cities across the country, including Boston, San Francisco, Washington, D.C., Atlanta, Chicago, Miami, New Orleans, Dallas, St. Louis, Minneapolis, Pittsburgh, and more.
Why Use meterUP?
• Skip the meter and easily pay for parking from your mobile device
• Extend your parking duration remotely from the app
• Get alerts so you know when your parking session is going to expire
• Use ParkMobile in over 3000 locations coast-to-coast including venues, airports, and universities
•. Find areas of the city where there is available parking and avoid areas where there’s no parking
How to Set Up Your Account
• Download the meterUP app and create an account with your email address and password
• Enter your license plate number and the state where your vehicle is registered
• Add your method of payment and start using the meterUP app
How It Works
On-Street and Off-Street Parking:
• Enter the zone number on the posted signs around the meter
• Select the amount of time you want to park and confirm your information
• Touch the “Start Parking” button to begin your parking session
• Extend time in the app if you are running late
App Features
• Customizable notifications delivered via email, text, and/or app
• Save your favorite parking locations for next time
• Store up to five cars in your account
• “Find my car” feature directs you back to the location where you parked
• Multiple payment methods available
•. Parking Availability feature shows streets with open parking spots in your area
About ParkMobile
ParkMobile, LLC is the leading provider ParkMobile, LLC is the leading provider of parking payment solutions in the United States, helping over 40 million people easily find, reserve, and pay for parking from their mobile devices.
Looking for Help?
At ParkMobile, we’re serious about customer service. We process nearly 500,000 parking transactions every day and we know that every now and then, something might go wrong. If you have an issue, we will do everything we can to make it right. Our customer service is 24/7/365. If you need help, here’s how to get in touch with us:
Web: https://ParkMobile.io/
Online Help Center: https://support.ParkMobile.io/hc/en-us/requests/new
Video Tutorials: https://ParkMobile.io/tips-demos/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ParkMobile
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ParkMobile/

bluejetty:00121577:ios.description:
Solve logic grid puzzles similar to Einstein's famous zebra puzzle "Who has the fish?" on your iPad, iPhone, Apple TV and Mac!
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Features:
6 riddles (Logicals):
• 2x easy (4 values per category)
• 2x medium (5 values per category)
• 2x hard (5 values per category)
• additional levelpacks available via in app purchase
36 riddles (Logicals Pro):
• 15x easy (4 values per category)
• 6x medium (5 values per category)
• 15x hard (5 values per category)
• additional levelpacks available via in app purchase
3x3 Layouts:
• light
• coffee
• dark
each in the variants
• full/empty
• plus/minus
• check/cross
2 languages:
• german
• english
easy solving of riddles by tapping: 
• tap once for "does not match"
• tap twice for "matches"
landscape & portrait mode available!
additional features:
• timer and Game Center support
• current state can be checked at any time
• solving table as assistance for a better overview (iPad only)
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
completely free of ads!
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
compatible devices:
• iPhone 6s or newer
• iPad
• iPad Pro
• Apple TV 4
• iMac, MacBook, Mac Mini
(requires iOS 13.0 / tvOS 13.0 / macOS 14.2 or higher)
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

bluejetty:00066393:ios.name: Tinder Dating App: Date & Chat
bluejetty:00066393:ios.summary:
Tinder is the place to meet someone new and see where a spark might lead. With millions of people nearby and around the world, Tinder makes dating fun and helps you find someone who matches your vibe, interests, and intentions.
HOW IT WORK
bluejetty:00066393:ios.description:
Tinder is the place to meet someone new and see where a spark might lead. With millions of people nearby and around the world, Tinder makes dating fun and helps you find someone who matches your vibe, interests, and intentions.
HOW IT WORKS
Meeting new people on Tinder feels easy and natural. Every match is a chance to meet someone interesting and enjoy the kind of dating experience that feels fun, relaxed, and right for you. Conversations unfold at your pace and help you figure out who you genuinely connect with.
* Explore profiles that fit what you're looking for
* Match with people nearby or around the world
* Answer prompts that help you share more of your personality
* Add photos and interests to show your style and what you care about
* Go on a Double Date and bring a friend along for the fun
* Let a friend know when you're meeting someone so you feel confident going out
* Chat with tools designed to help you feel safe and in control
Dating here is about exploring possibilities, connecting with people who catch your attention, and sparking conversations that grow.
A PLACE TO BE YOURSELF
Tinder is where your personality can shine—your humor, your interests, your quirks, your style. When you share the things that make you who you are, it becomes easier to meet people who genuinely appreciate your vibe.
We bring together people who are open to meeting someone interesting and trying something new. It’s a place where a simple match can turn into a great chat, a fun first date, or something unexpectedly meaningful.
SAFETY YOU CAN TRUST
Your comfort matters to us. We include multiple ways to verify profiles, added safety tools, and features that help you stay in control of how and when you meet new people.
Learn more:
https://www.gotinder.com/privacy
https://www.gotinder.com/terms
UPGRADE YOUR EXPERIENCE
Choose a plan to access more ways to explore, match, and express yourself—only if and when it feels right.
TRY TINDER FOR FREE
Send Likes, match, and chat at your own pace. See what's out there and spark something new.
---------------
If you choose to purchase Tinder Plus®, Tinder Gold™, or Tinder Platinum™ payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase Tinder Plus®, Tinder Gold™, or Tinder Platinum™, you can simply continue using Tinder for free.
All photos are of models and used for illustrative purposes only.
Privacy: https://www.gotinder.com/privacy
Terms: https://www.gotinder.com/terms
Visit: https://www.tinderlove.com/
