bluejetty:00086345:android.name: OPay
bluejetty:00086345:android.summary:
OPay is Nigeria's trusted financial services platform, offering secure, fast, reliable, and affordable solutions for all payment needs. With OPay, you can:
 • Send and receive money instantly with seamless transfers and a 100% success rate.
bluejetty:00086345:android.description:
OPay is Nigeria's trusted financial services platform, offering secure, fast, reliable, and affordable solutions for all payment needs. With OPay, you can:
 • Send and receive money instantly with seamless transfers and a 100% success rate.
 • Pay bills and top-up airtime & data with exclusive bonuses.
 • Grow your savings easily with daily interest on your balance.
 • Enjoy hassle-free debit cards at zero charges.
 • Access flexible loans with low interest rates.
Unlock convenience, savings, and rewards—all in one app. Invite friends and earn instant cashback for each referral. Open your OPay account today and experience financial freedom.
HASSLE-FREE AND INSTANT TRANSFERS
● Say goodbye to transaction failures & network issues. Enjoy super-fast and successful transactions.
● Send money using a phone number or bank account to others, including non-OPay users.
● Powered by all Nigerian banks: Access Bank, Zenith Bank, GT Bank, UBA Bank, Ecobank Nigeria, First Bank of Nigeria etc., ensuring a seamless and secure banking experience for all our users.
● Keep track of every transfer. Easily find transaction details in your "Transaction History."
BEST AIRTIME/DATA DEALS & EASY BILL PAYMENTS
● Get top airtime and data offers on MTN, Airtel, Glo, and 9Mobile.
● Pay electricity, TV, water bills, internet services and more with ease.
● Earn up to 6% cashback on airtime and data purchases.
OPay DEBIT CARD
● Secure & Reliable: Chip & PIN technology with industry-leading multi-level risk prevention.
● Convenience: Apply via the OPay app with nationwide delivery options or visit any OPay agent store.
● Wide Acceptance: Accepted across POS/ATM/WEB in Nigeria and international merchants like Microsoft, Netflix, AliExpress, Uber, Spotify and Emirates.
● User-Friendly Management: Change PINs, set limits, block/unblock cards, and access card details in-app.
● Virtual Card Option: For secure online payments, get a virtual card instantly via the app.
GROW AND SAVE MORE MONEY (Powered by OPay Microfinance Bank)
● OWealth: Earn daily interest, with free deposits and withdrawals anytime.
● Spend & Save: Save a percentage of your spending and earn daily returns.
● Fixed Savings: Lock idle funds for at least 7 days to earn higher returns.
● Target Saving: Save towards specific goals with daily, weekly, or monthly plans.
● SafeBox: Start a strict savings plan with limited withdrawals and monthly interest.
SECURE AND PRIVATE
● Advanced features like biometric login, card locking, and encryption for all transactions.
● Block your account or card via USSD (955*131# or 955*132#).
● NightGuard security feature: Extra facial verification feature to authorise transactions during the chosen night time hours.
● Large Transaction Shield feature: Extra facial verification feature for transactions above your pre-set limit.
● Real-time notifications for account activity.
● Private Mode to hide your balance.
● Licensed by the CBN and insured by the NDIC.
OPay is licensed by Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN, https://www.cbn.gov.ng/PaymentsSystem/PSPs.html), and insured by Nigeria Deposit Insurance Corporation (NDIC, https://ndic.gov.ng/list-of-insured-institutions/list-of-mobile-money-operators/).
CONTACT US
Our support team is available 24/7 for all your complaints.
OPay Headquarters: Alexander House, Plot 9, Dr. Nurudeen Olowopopo Avenue, Alausa, Lagos
Helplines: 0700 8888328 or 020 18888 328
Website: www.opayweb.com
Whatsapp: +234 9165998936
Facebook: @OPay
Twitter: @OPay_NG
Instagram: @opay.ng
TikTok: @opaynigeria
YouTube: @opaynigeria

Welcome to Word Cross, the ultimate game for fans of word search, crossword puzzles, and hidden words! Whether you’re a beginner or an expert, you’ll love solving these challenging and fun word puzzles.
Word Cross offers a variety of puzzles for everyone:
1. Daily Crossword Puzzles: Start your day with a new daily crossword! Solve clues to fill in the grid and expand your vocabulary. Our free crossword puzzles are designed to entertain and challenge your mind every day.
2. Word Search Games: Dive into classic word search puzzles! Find hidden words horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. With various themes like Christmas hidden words, Halloween word search, and more, there’s always a new challenge waiting.
3. Vocabulary Games: Test your word skills with vocabulary crossword puzzles and expand your knowledge. Whether it’s a quick 5-letter word find or a tricky crossword puzzle clue, you’ll learn new words while having fun.
4. Word Connect Game: Link letters to form words in our addictive word connect game. Perfect for word lovers looking for a brain workout!

Christmas Hidden Words: Find festive words in our holiday-themed puzzles.
Halloween Word Search: Spooky fun with hidden words!
Agriculture Word Search: Explore farm-related terms.
Autumn Word Search: Discover words related to the fall season.
6. Easy Puzzles for All Ages: Our easy word puzzles and crossword puzzles for seniors are designed with larger fonts and simpler words, making them accessible and enjoyable for everyone.
7. Create Your Own Puzzles: Use our word search generator to create personalized puzzles. Choose your words, and share your creations with friends and family!
Why Choose Word Cross?
Free Crossword Puzzles: Play hundreds of free crossword puzzles and word search games, updated daily.
Word Hunt: Discover hidden words in various puzzles, from easy to difficult levels.
Crossword Puzzle Clues: Solve unique clues in our challenging crosswords.
Word Find Games: Find missing letters and complete words in our exciting word find games.
Word Search for Seniors: Specially designed puzzles with larger fonts and simplified clues.
Free Word Search Games: Enjoy free access to a huge variety of word search games without any restrictions.
With Word Cross, you can play offline, anytime, anywhere. It’s the perfect game for quick breaks or long sessions of wordplay. Whether you're looking to relax with an easy crossword game or challenge yourself with a tough word hunt, you’ll find it all here.
Our game is perfect for word enthusiasts of all ages. With puzzles like 6-letter word find, find 7-letter word, and find hidden words, you’ll never run out of exciting challenges.
Highlights:
Word Search Puzzles: Discover new words in every puzzle.
Free Crossword Puzzles: Enjoy daily updates with fresh content.
Word Connect Game: Form words by connecting letters.
Crossword Puzzles for Seniors: Larger text for easy reading.
Vocabulary Crossword Puzzles: Improve your word knowledge.
Seasonal Themes: Special puzzles for Christmas, Halloween, and more.
Word Hunt & Word Seek Puzzles: Find all the hidden words!
Download Word Cross today and start your word adventure! Whether you’re searching for an exciting word connect game, a tricky crossword puzzle, or a relaxing word search, Word Cross has it all. Join our community of word lovers and become a master of words!

bluejetty:00016506:ios.description:
Koi-Koi (Japanese: こいこい) is a popular card game in Japan played with Hanafuda cards which is one of ways to play Hanafuda(Japanese playing cards) with two players.
The goal of the game is to make the combination of severalcards earlier than your opponent. The phrase "koi-koi" means "come on" in Japanese which is said when the player wants to continue the hand.
The object of the game is to form special card combinations called "yaku" from cards accumulated in a point pile. Players can gain cards in their point piles by matching cards in their hands, or drawn from the draw pile, with cards on the table. Once a yaku has been made, a player can stop to cash in points, or keep going (referred to as "koi-koi", hence the name of the game) to form additional yaku for more points. The point values assigned to individual cards have no effect on the score, but they are helpful to judge their value in forming yaku.

bluejetty:00147111:ios.summary:
AI-NATIVE EMAIL FOR BUSINESS
"The AI revolution is coming for your email" – Business Insider
"This app is like ChatGPT for your email, and it changed my life" – Digital Trends
"The Google Inbox successor I’ve been waiting for" – The Verge
bluejetty:00147111:ios.description:
AI-NATIVE EMAIL FOR BUSINESS
"The AI revolution is coming for your email" – Business Insider
"This app is like ChatGPT for your email, and it changed my life" – Digital Trends
"The Google Inbox successor I’ve been waiting for" – The Verge
YOUR AI EMAIL ASSISTANT 
Supercharge your productivity with advanced AI & real-time team collaboration. Write emails, improve drafts, schedule meetings, analyze threads, translate text, and more using Shortwave’s powerful AI Assistant.
ORGANIZE YOUR INBOX WITH AI
With 1-tap, Shortwave’s AI Assistant can identify urgent emails, group threads into todos, and sweep away the remaining clutter so you can get to inbox zero with zero effort.
SHARE & DISCUSS EMAILS WITH YOUR TEAM
Get the right people involved and bring everyone up to speed fast with private team comments and live thread sharing. Assign emails to teammates to delegate next steps.
WRITE EMAILS WITH AI
Write personalized emails with AI in seconds, or use instant AI replies to get full drafts in just one tap. Shortwave learns your unique writing style and even facts about you from the emails you send.
IMPROVE AND PROOFREAD DRAFTS
Complete your drafts, adjust length and tone, translate into other languages, and more with a built-in AI editor.
SEARCH AND FIND ANSWERS 
Use AI-powered search to find emails fast, or to analyze your entire team's emails & attachments for the answers you need
SCHEDULE MEETINGS WITH AI
Spend less time juggling calendars with AI-powered scheduling features. Create events, send AI-generated scheduling emails, accept calendar events with one click, and more.
GET ORGANIZED WITH SPLITS AND BUNDLES
Focus your time & attention by dividing your inbox into tabs for important emails, specific senders, labels & even custom queries. Use bundles for fast triage of promotions, newsletters, updates, and other automated emails.
TURN EMAILS INTO TODOS
Transform your overflowing inbox into an organized list of action items. Group, rename, prioritize, and add notes, right in your inbox.
SET DELIVERY SCHEDULES
Avoid interruptions by deferring when emails arrive in your inbox, so you only receive emails when you want them.
VIEW READ STATUSES
See when people read your emails to get the context you need to prioritize your time and write effective follow-ups. Close more deals and collaborate better with your team.
SCREEN UNWANTED SENDERS
Guard your inbox from noise with one-click block and unsubscribe.
FINE-TUNE PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
Granular push controls let you minimize distractions with personalized alerts for specific senders and types of emails. 
CUSTOMIZE EVERYTHING
Customize AI prompts and automate your team’s work with AI Snippets & AI Automations. Adjust tons of details in settings, and make Shortwave yours with custom colors and beautiful light & dark modes.
MANAGE MULTIPLE ACCOUNTS
Organize all of your Gmail accounts from one app and seamlessly switch between them in a single swipe.
SYNCS WITH GMAIL
Migrate seamlessly to Shortwave from your existing Gmail or Google Workspace account with all of your labels, filters, and other settings imported.
If you have questions or want to learn more about Shortwave and best practices, you can find resources here: https://www.shortwave.com/docs/

bluejetty:00022295:ios.description:
DSLR Camera for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and iMessage the complete app for Photo and Video with Manual Controls, Advanced Editor and 200+ Professional Filters.
You can shoot and record with the full advantage of the camera on your device, for spectacular shots and videos even at night.
• Constantly updated since 2014 to ensure better performance
- Most downloaded app in 30 World Stores 
- Selected like "App of the Day" in many world stores
Made with love in Sicily
The app is designed to be used by beginners and experts. 
3 modes:
Auto Mode - for automatically perfect photos and videos 
Manual Mode - modifies: Shutter Times, ISO Sensitivity, Manual Focus, Manual WB
P Mode - to shoot and record, choose perfect exposure quickly and easily 
Then only one with AI to predict the best filters for your photo
• Perfect shots and videos
DSLR Camera offers you the ability to capture and film your subjects, automatically with the ability of controlling manual function to control shooting time and ISO.
The controls are designed to be simple and complete
• Hand Timer
Use your hand to tell your iPhone how many seconds to wait before taking a shot
• RAW 
Shot beautiful photographs in RAW format for a Professional quality
• Predictive Filters 
A powerful feature that automatically select the filters most appropriate for your photos
• AR Portrait
Take unique portraits using the LiDAR sensor and AR.
Easily place stickers and graphics between the subject and the background, adjust the blur and enjoy the new photo taking experience.
• Bokeh
Take shots by adjusting the intensity of the blur and the depth at which the effect is applied. 
• Widgets
Use exclusive widgets that automatically select and improve every shots
• AR Assistant
Use the augmented reality to study and choose the best point of view for your photo or video.
Use the tutorial to learn various photographic techniques
• Siri Shortcuts
Control the app with the voice
You can say "Hey Siri filter last shot" and Siri will automatically use a predictive filters to correct your photo
• Advanced Focus 
Choose the focus to highlight the subject using Focus Macro to capture even minute details, Focus "Infinity" to perfectly define subjects that are far away. 
• AFC - No more blurry photos 
Hold down a point of the frame to track the subject you chose and DSLR Camera app will focus on what you have chosen. 
• Face Tracking - Selfie and Perfect Portraits 
Faces in your photos will always be at the right brightness
• Selfie Comparison
Thanks to ML the app evaluate face quality in a picture to help you in selecting the best shot
• Music Filters
This exclusive feature creates and recommends filters based on the music you are listening to and the mood of the moment. 
• Dual Filter
The Dual Filter feature allows you to correct and post-produce the subject and background separately.
• Advanced Editor 
Edit easily all your photos thanks to the integrated editor.  Photo Editor is fast and complete, allowing you to make your shot even better. You can adjust: Exposure, Contrast, Lights, Shadows, Color Temperature, Saturation, Vividness, Structure, Sharpness, Photo Noise, and Vignette. Complete with all the Tools to resize, crop, and adjust your photos. 
• 200+ Filters
200+ exclusive Photo Filters to make your photo unique
• Cinematic Videos
Select recording quality and take videos in 4k, lock exposure, for a cinematic result 
• MultiCam
You will be able to take photos and record videos using two cameras simultaneously, to obtain unique and innovative results
• iMessage App
• Apple Watch Remote
DSLR Camera also offers: 3 Shots mode, Predictive Filters, AFC, RAW (DNG), Manual Controls, Photo Editor, 200+ Photo Filters, 3D Touch Support, 4k Video, Manual Focus, Night Mode, Auto WB, Jump Shot, Timer, Photos Effect, Tone Curves, Advanced Blur, Advanced Correction Tools, Text, Splash, Resize, Crop, Dual Camera Zoom, Digital Zoom, Selfie Flash.
Easy, Complete and Powerful!

bluejetty:00042364:ios.description:
Sick of long waits, high deductibles, and expensive medical bills? Break up with the system and go doctor-direct with Sesame.
Our telehealth marketplace makes it easy to find exceptional online doctors across 45+ specialties and hundreds of services like prescription refills, telehealth visits, weight loss and more — all at upfront cash prices and easily bookable within 2 hours (even on weekends and holidays). Because we stripped away all the fees and middlemen who complicate healthcare, you’ll save up to 50% on the same doctors who treat you through insurance plans. We call it, “Half-Price Healthcare.”
Download the free Sesame telehealth app to join video appointments, chat with your online doctor, manage prescriptions, care for the entire family, and book your next visit.
SERVICES
-Weight loss: GLP-1 medications, nutrition & exercise guidance, & other weight loss services.
-Mental health: Individual and couple’s therapy, counseling, and treatment for stress, insomnia, depression, anxiety, performance anxiety, PTSD, & other mental health conditions.
-Doctor appointments: Urgent care (UTIs, pink eye, ear infections, fevers, COVID-19, sinus infections, nausea, vomiting, insect bites & more), chronic care (diabetes, asthma, allergies, cholesterol, heart disease & more).
-Telehealth care: Online visits for skin care (acne, eczema, rashes, rosacea & more), women’s health (UTIs, period cramps, yeast infections, birth control, bacterial vaginosis & more), men’s health (hair loss, ED, premature ejaculation & more), sexual health (STI/STD consults, vaginal dryness, erectile dysfunction), pediatric care (treatment for children’s ear infections, cold, flu, rashes & more) & hundreds of others.
ONLINE PRESCRIPTIONS
-Antibiotics
-Birth control
-Diabetes medications (metformin, insulin & more)
-High blood pressure medications (metoprolol, amlodipine, lisinopril & more)
-High cholesterol medications (atorvastatin, rosuvastatin, fluvastatin & more)
-Mental health medications (sertraline, escitalopram, fluoxetine & more) 
-PrEP (Truvada, Descovy & more)
-Skin medications (retinol, tretinoin, adapalene & more)
-Weight loss medications (GLP-1 medications like tirzepatide, semaglutide & more)
-…& thousands of others
BOOKING CARE ON SESAME
Once you’ve created your free Sesame account, simply browse online doctors and select an upfront price and appointment time that work for you. You can join your video call from the Sesame app or a web browser on your mobile device, desktop, or tablet. After your appointment, use the app to:
-Chat with online doctors for personalized care and support
-Track prescriptions and save on medications with our prescription discount card
-Schedule follow-up care in seconds
-Manage visit summaries, doctor notes, and lab results for the whole family
& more
PATIENT TESTIMONIALS
“I can confidently say this is exactly how healthcare should work. Same-day appointment, transparent costs, inexpensive prescriptions right to my home - you guys have it figured out!”
“Sesame has been a lifesaver for our family - we have a significantly high deductible HSA plan and I've had nothing but great experiences with Sesame. Thank you for bringing healthcare back to what it should be - affordable & accessible along with quality care.”
“I love this service. I was able to get an appointment within an hour!”
AWARDS:
-Best for Doctor Choice (2023, 2024), Forbes
-Best Overall Care (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024), Healthline
-Most Affordable Telehealth (2023), CNET
ABOUT SESAME
Sesame is building a radically new healthcare system for Americans who are uninsured or those with high-deductible plans. Our marketplace replaces historically inefficient, expensive healthcare with a direct connection—either virtually or in-person—between patients and doctors. This direct connection enables Sesame to offer doctor visits, labs, and prescription drugs at half the price.

bluejetty:00086911:ios.description:
OneKey to All Finance 
Self Custody. Open Source. Fully Onchain. Trade crypto, stocks, and more from your OneKey Wallet.
Self Custody · Open Source Wallet 
Backed by Coinbase Ventures & YZi Labs (formerly Binance Labs) 
One app to trade crypto, US stocks, gold, oil, and forex on onchain markets
Start with an email. No seed phrase. No hardware required. 
Create your keyless wallet in seconds and step into Web3 — fully self-custodial, always under your control.
Built-in Security & Transparency 
- Keyless wallet — no seed phrase to manage 
- Self-custody. You own your assets; we never hold your keys 
- Keys are generated on your device and never leave it 
- App passcode and biometrics for everyday protection 
- SignGuard detects phishing, malicious approvals, and risky addresses before you sign 
- Clear signing shows exactly what you are approving
Optional Hardware Signer for Extra Protection 
- Add a OneKey, Ledger, or Trezor hardware wallet anytime for stronger security 
- Offline signing and secure communication 
- Use the app on its own, or pair with hardware when needed
One Wallet for Everything 
- 60+ blockchains and 30,000+ tokens supported 
- Including BTC, ETH, SOL, USDT, USDC, XRP, TON, and more 
- Manage assets across mobile and desktop 
- Custom networks, batch import, and real-time balance preview
Trade Everything, Onchain Wall Street 
- Crypto, US stocks, gold, oil, and forex — all in one app 
- Perpetual futures with up to 40x leverage, no KYC, traded straight from your wallet 
- Non-custodial. Your funds stay under your control
Gas Sponsor 
- On Ethereum and Arbitrum, gas can be sponsored by OneKey 
- Covers transfers, swaps, and perps deposits 
- Expanding to more scenarios
Swap at Better Rates 
- Aggregates cross-chain and DEX liquidity 
- Optimized for low slippage and efficient execution
Earn with Confidence 
- Yield opportunities through trusted DeFi protocols 
- Stay self-custodial, in full control of your funds 
- Real-time monitoring and risk alerts
Explore Web3 Safely 
- Built-in browser for dApps 
- Auto-disconnect to reduce risk 
- Verified dApps featured on the home page
Smart Risk Protection 
- Hidden approval detection before signing 
- Clear transaction details and warnings 
- Passphrase support for hidden wallets
Buy, Send & Receive 
- Compare quotes across providers 
- Network and risk checks before every transaction 
- Simple, secure transfers

bluejetty:00077812:ios.description:
TUNDER – The point of sale app for all merchants
The Tunder cash register app transforms your iPhone or iPad into a simple and efficient cash register, making it easy to manage your business.
- Manage your sales, products, payments, and reports effortlessly – anytime, anywhere 
- Perfect for both physical stores and mobile businesses
---
SET UP YOUR POS SYSTEM IN MINUTES 
- Create your products, taxes, categories, and discounts in just a few taps 
- Add multiple payment methods: cash, card, checks, and more 
- Print receipts or send digital receipts via email, SMS, or WhatsApp 
- Offer digital menus using a QR code – ideal for restaurants and bars
- Manage your stock with ease: track available quantities, set alert thresholds, and prevent sales when an item is out of stock.
---
COLLABORATION, SYNC, AND SECURITY 
- Create multiple shops with a single account and manage them from one place 
- Real-time sync across multiple smartphones and tablets 
- Demo mode available from the first download to train staff without affecting real data 
- Offline mode: keep selling even without internet access 
- Create open tickets to save orders and get paid later. Perfect for restaurants, bars, or pickup orders 
- Secure access with a PIN code
---
PRINTING AND HARDWARE COMPATIBILITY 
- Works with Bluetooth and WiFi printers (EPSON, Star Micronics) 
- Print receipts, kitchen tickets, and order slips 
- Connect multiple printers for different uses: sales, kitchen, bar, prep 
- Automatically open the cash drawer after each sale
---
ANALYZE YOUR SALES AT A GLANCE 
Track your performance in real time with a clear and intuitive dashboard
- View revenue and sales by time period 
- Monitor average basket value 
- Identify peak hours to optimize staff and opening times 
- Discover your best-selling products and most used payment methods 
- Export sales data for deeper analysis
---
EXPORT YOUR DATA IN ONE CLICK 
- Export sales by product, category, or payment method 
- Track VAT and discounts to better manage your taxes 
- Generate detailed reports for your accountant 
- Export data in Excel or CSV format 
- Share files via Gmail, WhatsApp, Outlook, Dropbox, or any other app
---
DEDICATED SUPPORT 
Need help? Contact our support team directly from the app or by email.
---
The best alternative to iZettle, Square, SumUp, L’Addition, Tiller, Popina, Cashpad, Loyverse, and RoverCash. 
Whether you're a baker, restaurant owner, food truck manager, or itinerant merchant, Tunder is here to support you.
Terms and Conditions of Sale and Use: https://tunder.co/cgv-cgu
Privacy Policy: https://tunder.co/politique-de-confidentialite

Sobi: Sobriety Tracker
Sobi is a companion for your sobriety journey. Whether you're taking your first steps or maintaining long-term progress, Sobi helps you stay grounded, motivated, and supported along the way. 
Designed with care and based on behavioral science, Sobi goes beyond simply counting days. It offers daily tools, insights, and gentle encouragement to help you build a healthier, more mindful life. 
Our mission is to make sobriety feel less lonely, more doable, and even a little joyful. We believe recovery is a deeply personal journey, and everyone deserves support that’s compassionate, accessible, and rooted in real science. With Sobi, you're never alone.
Features:
- Personalized sobriety tracker and progress milestones
- Journaling and mood reflection
- Breathing exercises for moments of stress or craving
- Supportive chat with your companion
- Quick access help button for challenging moments
- Earnable badges and XP system to celebrate progress
- Insights and tips rooted in science and best practices
- Track savings and benefits of your sobriety journey
Whether you're aiming for one day, one month, or one year — Sobi is here to walk with you, every step of the way.
Download Sobi today and take your next step forward.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
A Sobi subscription is required to use and enjoy full access to features and content. If you choose a Sobi subscription, payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. From iTunes Account settings you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your trial ends, the remaining free trial period will be forfeited when your purchase is confirmed.
DISCLAIMER:
Sobi is not a replacement for therapy or medical advice. It’s a supportive companion built to help you stay mindful, motivated, and connected to your goals. Seek a doctor's advice in addition to using this app for medical decisions.
Terms of Service: https://www.trysobi.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00109613:android.summary:

Race at lightning speed as Sonic the Hedgehog! Run through loop-de-loops as yo
bluejetty:00109613:android.description:
The classic Sonic arcade game that started it all is now optimized for mobile devices! If you love classic SEGA games, you’ll love playing Sonic the Hedgehog! 
Race at lightning speed as Sonic the Hedgehog! Run through loop-de-loops as you collect rings. Rediscover the thrill of racing through all seven of classic Sonic the Hedgehog game zones! Help Sonic and his friends defeat the evil Mr. Eggman!
Sonic the Hedgehog joins the SEGA Forever classic arcade games collection, a treasure trove of free SEGA console classic games brought to life on mobile for the first time!
FEATURES
- Sonic is Now Optimized for Mobile. Sonic The Hedgehog now plays in widescreen at a smooth 60FPS offering unrivaled performance and the game’s legendary soundtrack has been fully re-mastered.
- Gotta Go Fast! Challenge yourself with the all-new Time Attack game mode.
- New Playable Characters! Play as Sonic’s friends Tails and Knuckles for the first time. Use their unique abilities to fly, climb, and glide around levels offering exciting new ways to explore.
- Classic Arcade Games. If you love classic games from the 90’s, you’ll have a blast playing Sonic the Hedgehog. The classic SEGA game, remastered for mobile devices brings you the best classic gameplay and optimizes the arcade experience!
- Video Game Controller Support. Sonic The Hedgehog on Android offers exclusive support for the Power A Moga, Nyko, XBOX, and all HID controllers.
Play the original Sonic the Hedgehog arcade game from SEGA! The fun classic arcade game that started it all is back for your mobile device! Run, jump and race through fun courses and levels. Unlock Sonic’s friends, including Tails and Knuckles!
SONIC THE HEDGEHOG VIDEO GAME TRIVIA
- Sonic Jam contained the first release of Sonic The Hedgehog that gave Sonic his spin dash move, which returns again in this mobile game remake!
- Sonic The Hedgehog was released in video game arcades on SEGA's Mega-Tech and Mega Play systems.
- While "Eggman" is Dr. Robotnik's nickname in the West, “Eggman” is his actual name in Japan.
- - - - 
Privacy Policy: https://privacy.sega.com/en/soa-pp
Terms of Use: https://www.sega.com/EULA
Sonic The Hedgehog Classic is ad-supported and no in-app purchases are required to progress; ad-free play is available with an in-app purchase.

You don’t have to choose between a busy life and a clean home. NeatNo
bluejetty:00144881:ios.description:
NeatNook - the must-have app if you want to keep your homes clean and organized! Get a manageable, realistic cleaning and maintenance schedule that suits your lifestyle.
You don’t have to choose between a busy life and a clean home. NeatNook helps you find the right balance, giving you an easy way to keep your living space neat without any hassle.
———————
WHAT YOU GET WITH NEATNOOK
* 300+ Built-in Tasks and Checklists 
Bid farewell to guesswork with over 300 built-in tasks and checklists. Whether it's spring cleaning, routine maintenance, or any other home-related task, we've got it covered.
* Flexible Scheduling 
Create daily, weekly, and seasonal cleaning routines. Easily reschedule tasks if you miss them, so you can catch up without feeling overwhelmed.
* Notes and Attachments 
Add task-specific notes or instructions for family members. Attach user manuals for quick reference.
* Multi-User Support 
Team up with your family and roommates to tackle tasks together.
* Multiple Spaces Support 
Manage tasks for multiple properties, such as rental flats or other locations.
* Progress and Motivation 
Visualize your progress and gain insights into your home maintenance journey. Stay motivated with empowering achievements.
* Widget 
Stay on track with your home tasks through the Home Screen widget.
* Privacy-Focused 
No sign-up required, ensuring privacy and simplicity. With iCloud integration, enjoy effortless synchronization and automatic data backup across all your devices, with secure storage of your personal data.
———————
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS 
NeatNook premium features are available as a $1.99 auto-renewable monthly subscription, a $9.99 auto-renewable yearly subscription, and a $14.99 one-time purchase, or the equivalent price in your local currency based on Apple’s price matrix. 
Your Apple Account will be charged at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can go to your Apple Account Settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. To restore previous purchases, use the "Restore Purchases" button located at the bottom of the Premium Features popup.
If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the application, please contact us at hello@neatnook.app
Privacy Policy https://neatnook.app/privacy
Term of Use https://neatnook.app/terms

bluejetty:00043285:ios.description:

Проверяйте подключённые услуги, баланс и остатки трафика — на одном экране.

Пользуйтесь удобными фильтрами, сравнивайте товар и выбирайте нужное.
Огромный каталог: от смартфонов до самокатов.
Покупайте устройства прямо внутри приложения!
Контент
Играйте в игры прямо в приложении — без лишних установок.
Открывайте доступ к образовательным ресурсам для учёбы и саморазвития.
Оформляйте подписки на видео и музыку.

bluejetty:00135121:ios.name: Braille Academy: Play & Learn
bluejetty:00135121:ios.summary:
Features:
- 13 chapters, namely Letters, Numbers, Basic Punctuations, Special Symbols, Alphabetic Wordsigns, Strong Contractions, Strong Wordsigns, Strong Groupsigns, Lower Groupsigns, Lower Wordsigns, Initial Letter Contractions, Final Let
bluejetty:00135121:ios.description:
Features:
- 13 chapters, namely Letters, Numbers, Basic Punctuations, Special Symbols, Alphabetic Wordsigns, Strong Contractions, Strong Wordsigns, Strong Groupsigns, Lower Groupsigns, Lower Wordsigns, Initial Letter Contractions, Final Letter Groupsigns and Shortform Words.
- Teaches strategically Braille of all 26 letters of the English alphabet, numbers 0 - 9, 12 most frequently used punctuation marks, 8 most frequently used special symbols, 23 alphabetic word signs, 38 contractions, 12 wordsigns, 34 groupsigns and 75 short-form words.
- 59 levels and 29 challenges in total teach, train and test more than 90% of the entire Unified English Braille knowledge.
- Various themes to choose from including the Contrast theme (more contrast and bolder text) for visually impaired.
- Absolutely no disturbing ads.
- On the Explore page, you can click and see the Braille representations of all the 26 letters, numbers 0 - 9, 12 punctuation marks and 8 special symbols.
- After passing all the levels and challenges in one chapter, you can get a certificate on the Certificate page.
- On the Settings page, you can switch on and off button sound, key sound, button vibration, key vibration vibration on error and keyboard layout.
- More learning and training materials will be added in the future updates.
- Works completely offline.
Please note, this app is not specially designed for people with severe visual impairment, but with feedback and suggestions from them, we are certainly working in that direction (improving talkback/voiceover experiences).
-----------------------
What’s Braille?
Braille is a system of touch reading and writing for visually impaired people, in which raised dots represent the letters of the alphabet, numbers, punctuation marks, special symbols and so on. It is named after its creator, Louis Braille, a Frenchman who lost his sight in his childhood and later developed a code for the French alphabet. These characters have rectangular blocks called cells which have tiny bumps called raised dots. The number and arrangement of these dots distinguish one character from another.
-----------------------
What’s Braille Academy?
Braille Academy is developed to help those who are curious about and interested in learning the Braille system. The two key teaching concepts are gradual introduction and focused repetition. The learning material is categorized into chapters and then levels to ensure efficient learning and training. If you are not particularly interested in Braille but in training and improving your memory in general, Braille Academy is also a useful tool.
-----------------------
Levels and challenges?
In short, a level focuses on introducing new characters with a small amount of repetition while a challenge trains what you’ve learnt already. In a level, you can click the INFO BUTTON (on the left) to read some TIPS and the hint button (on the right) to see the correct answer. The hints are infinite and always free. In a challenge, you can’t use the hint button anymore and you must make less than 3 mistakes to pass it.
In conclusion, I wish you a lot of success and a lot of fun in learning Braille!
Privacy Policy: https://dong.digital/braille/privacy
Terms of Use: https://dong.digital/braille/tos

bluejetty:00126685:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00126685:ios.description:
** More than ten people stop smoking every hour with Smoke Free **
This is the app that science built. Over 40 different, evidence-based, techniques will help you get - and stay - smoke free. See and celebrate how long you’ve been quit, how your health is improving how much money you're saving, how many cigarettes you've not smoked, how much life you've regained, and more. 
Get tips on dealing with cravings, use the map to see where they congregate, add notes to see what patterns can be identified and use the graph to see how they're decreasing. Save up for treats to buy yourself with the money saved from not smoking, remind yourself why it is so important that you stay strong and get a free certificate when you’re successful. 
All of which is free to use and free of ads. 
If you need extra help go Pro. Our stop smoking plan gives you short daily ‘Missions’ and is proven to double your chances of quitting. Our AI Quit Coach provides a whole host of tools and a powerful sense of accountability, and is proven to further increase your chances of success. Pro gives you more help with cravings, more badges and more customization options too. 
But if you really want to make this time THE time then Blitz your Quit with a proven stop smoking plan tailored to your needs by an expert advisor; four booster check-ins to get you through the first month; 24/7 access to advisors outside these times; endless support from other quitters in our chat; plus all the Pro features too. 
This is the most comprehensive stop smoking program ever put into an app. 
Subscription details 
If you choose to subscribe you get access to the Pro features of the app (but not Blitz your Quit, which is a separate feature). Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at the confirmation of purchase and subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions in the iPhone Settings app. Turn off auto-renew by going to your Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription. To find out more about the terms of use, our refund policy and our privacy policy please visit: 
https://smokefreeapp.com/terms-and-conditions/ 
https://smokefreeapp.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00092606:ios.description:
CINQ by Coinstar makes it easy to turn cash or coins into funds you can spend, hold, or move as you please. 
Whether you’re swiping your Debit Card at checkout, using tap-to-pay on your phone, or getting paid through direct deposit, CINQ by Coinstar puts freedom, transparency, and control into your hands. 
And with 24/7 customer support from real humans – our team is always here to make sure your money moves when you say so.
Reloadable Debit Card
Meet your new cash-to-digital reloadable prepaid debit card, from the global leader in coin transformation. Fees Apply.*
With the CINQ by Coinstar™ Debit Card, you can:
• Spend anywhere MasterCard® is accepted — in-store, online, or abroad.
• Convert coins & cash — Conveniently transfer coins and cash to your card at 10,000+ participating Coinstar® kiosks across the country, in stores you already shop at. 
• Load your way — Add funds in-app with ACH transfers from your bank or set up free direct deposit and transfer all or a portion of your paycheck on payday.3
• Get paid early – Set up direct deposit to automatically add paychecks to your Debit Card and get paid up to 2 days before your scheduled payday.1
• Access your money with ease — see your balance update after you load cash or coins and track every transaction in the app.
• Tap, dip, swipe, or go digital — use your free physical card or add your virtual card to Apple Pay®.
• No surprises, more control – No monthly fees, no purchase transaction fees, no direct deposit fees, no in-network ATM fees.2
Fast, Simple Setup
Getting started is easy — just enter a few pieces of information, and you’re ready to go in minutes. There’s no credit check required, and you’ll get access to your virtual debit card as soon as you finish identity verification.
Talk to a real person. Anytime.
Questions or issues? CINQ by Coinstar has real humans ready to help, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Your cash and coins — upgraded.
Download CINQ by Coinstar today and discover the simple, flexible way to manage your money from the kiosks you trust to the wallet you’ll love. Built for both the cash-first and digital worlds.
Disclosure(s) - Incl. both on-image copy and app store description disclosures
1 Direct deposit funds are made available depending on when your employer (or other payer) submits the payment file. We strive to make funds available on the day the payment file is received. Early access to direct deposit funds may be up to two days before the scheduled payment date.
2 Fee-free cash withdrawals available at Allpoint Network ATMs only. Out-of-network ATM withdrawal, over the counter withdrawal and balance inquiry fees may apply.
3 Subject to employer payroll policies. Not all employers support deposits into multiple accounts.
* Coinstar is not a bank. Coinstar is a financial technology company. The Coinstar Debit Card is issued by Lead Bank, Member FDIC, pursuant to licensing by Mastercard® International Inc. Fees apply. See Terms (https://cinq.trusthub.com/terms-of-service) and Cardholder Agreement (https://cinq.trusthub.com/CHA) for more details. 
Funds in your prepaid card account are held with Lead Bank, Member FDIC, and are insured up to $250,000 in the event Lead Bank fails and if specific deposit insurance requirements are met and your card is registered. FDIC insurance does not protect funds in the event of Coinstar’s failure or from the risk of theft or fraud. See FDIC Prepaid Cards and Deposit Insurance Coverage (https://www.fdic.gov/deposit/deposits/prepaid.html)

bluejetty:00022567:ios.name: Pro Snooker & Pool 2026+
bluejetty:00022567:ios.summary: Following the worldwide success of its sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Snooker & Pool 2026+, probably one of the most realistic and playable snooker and pool games available on mobile devices. Boasting fully textured game environm
bluejetty:00022567:ios.description:
Following the worldwide success of its sports games iWare Designs brings you Pro Snooker & Pool 2026+, probably one of the most realistic and playable snooker and pool games available on mobile devices. Boasting fully textured game environments and full 3D rigid body physics this game is the complete package for both casual and serious gamers.
The simple click and play interface allows you to pick up and play the game quickly, or alternatively for the more serious players the game includes cue ball control allowing you to perform more advanced shots including back spin, top spin, left spin (Left english), right spin (Right english) and ball swerve. 
So whether you want a simple easy and fun snooker game or a full on simulation this game is for you. 
Download Pro Snooker & Pool 2026+ now, you will not be disappointed. 
System Requirements: 
∙ Compatible with iPhone, iPad and iPod touch.
∙ Utilizes Retina displays on compatible devices. 
∙ Game Center compatible. 
Game Features: 
∙ Localized to English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, Canadian French and Mexican Spanish.
∙ Full High Def 3D textured environments. 
∙ Full 3D physics at 60 FPS.
∙ Free online multiplayer games
∙ Free local network multiplayer games
∙ Practice: Fine tune your game by playing on your own with no rules. 
∙ Quick Play: Play a custom match against another friend, family member or computer opponent. 
∙ League: Participate in a league event over 7 rounds where the highest points total wins. 
∙ Tournament: Test your nerves in a 4 round knockout tournament event. 
∙ Configure up to 3 player profiles to keep track of all your statistics. 
∙ Each profile contains comprehensive statistics and progression history. 
∙ Select your handicap level with 5 levels of aiming and ball guide mark-ups. 
∙ Select your preferred post shot camera through your player’s profile. 
∙ Progress through the ranks from Rookie to Legend. Beware you can go down the ranks as well as up. 
∙ Play against 25 different computer opponents spread over 5 difficulty levels. 
∙ Fully customizable tables, choose from over 100 combinations of table finish effects and baize colors. 
∙ Play snooker on regulation 10ft and 12ft rectangular tables.
∙ Play pool on regulation 7ft, 8ft and 9ft rectangular tables. 
∙ Test your skills on the non-regulation Casket, Clover, Hexagonal, L-Shaped and Square tables.
∙ Play 6 Red Ball Snooker, 10 Red Ball Snooker and 15 Red Ball Snooker based on WPBAS rules. 
∙ Play US 8 Ball, US 9 Ball, US 10 Ball and Black Ball based on WPA rules. 
∙ Play World Eight Ball Pool based on WEPF rules.
∙ 14.1 Continuous pool based on WPA rules.
∙ Rotation Pool based on WPA rules.
∙ Bonus 8ft snooker table for pool games. 
∙ Bonus Chinese 8 Ball table.
∙ Fully featured ball control system allowing back spin, top spin, left spin (Left english), right spin (Right english) and swerve shots. 
∙ Choose from various camera views including 3D, Top Cushion and Overhead views. 
∙ 20+ game achievements to collect locally or via Game Center. 
∙ Take action photos and share them via Email or save them to your device. 
∙ In game tips and help.

NOAA Buoy Reports is the no-nonsense app focused exclusively on real-time buoy and ship observations worldwide - without the clutter of tide or weather forecasts.
NOAA Buoy Reports includes:
• Intuitive map interface
• Quick-view Favorites
• Locations of Tropical Storms, Hurricanes, and Cyclones from the NHC
• Full buoy current conditions (always free)
• Ship observations (free preview)
• Buoy Cams (free preview)
• Past buoy data up to 45 days (Premium feature)
• Wave heights and directions (when available)
• Wind, gusts, and directions (when available)
• Air and Water temperatures (when available)
• Atmospheric pressure (when available)
• Interactive graphs
• Add your own Wind, Wave, or Temperature graph levels
• Units in Metric or English
• Readings in your local time
• Share data via iMessage, Email, Facebook, etc.
• Full Dark Mode support
• Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy Mode Widgets to monitor your favorites
Coverage includes more than 1000 buoys and 200 ships worldwide, spanning the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans near the U.S. and Canada, the Great Lakes, the Caribbean, and waters around Ireland and Great Britain.

Add favorites to quickly view the locations that matter most to you, and monitor them anytime with the included widgets.
This app DOES NOT provide tide data, or maritime or other weather forecasts. There are dedicated apps for these from other publishers that do an excellent job. This app specializes exclusively in buoy and ship observation data.
Please note that not all buoys have all types of data available, and buoys do experience intermittent outages — a life at sea can be harsh!
Additionally, note that some buoys may be seasonal, and may be physically removed from the water during winter months, such as in the Great Lakes.

bluejetty:00026839:ios.description:
Welcome, future Trainliner. Get on board with millions of world-wide users, today, to travel confidently with us – Europe’s leading train and bus app. 
Why? 
Whether heading to an international city or from an international terminal, in a matter of clicks you’ll be booking the best seats in advance or saving money on-the-day with our Best Price Guarantee. And for those who like to stay looped, you can turn on real-time notifications and keep an eye on live timetable tracking – you can even use Crowd Alerts to find out how busy your train is. Plus, forgetting, misplacing, or totally destroying your paper tickets becomes a thing of the past when you purchase digital versions through our app! 
With so much to see and do, getting there should be the easy part – and when you book through our app, it is! Find cheap tickets for Eurostar, Avanti West Coast, GWR, LNER, National Express, Renfe, Iryo, Trenitalia, Italo, and many other European rail lines. Or if you want to buy bus tickets, simply search and book directly in the app. Need some travel inspo first? We got that covered, too, with travel blogs and suggested “popular journeys”.
So, whether you want to book bus seats, get cheap train tickets, or stay updated during your journey, you can always rely on our app to deliver the goods. 
Why use Trainline to book train and bus tickets? 
- Buy all your tickets in one place – plan your dream country-hopping journey on our app.
- Compare train and bus options from 260 train and bus companies.
- Compare prices and get cheap tickets in your preferred currency (USD, GBP, EUR, AUD, CAD, CHF, and SEK).
- Buy tickets with Amex, Apple Pay, PayPal, and all major credit cards and debit cards.
- Add loyalty and discount cards to get benefits on cheap tickets on UK rail services, Eurostar, SNCF, Thalys, and Renfe.
- Book tickets in advance or buy same-day train tickets up to 15 minutes before departure. 
- Buy tickets on your phone to skip station queues for selected routes.
- Add Cancel for Any Reason to your booking for cover up to 15 minutes before departure. 
- Save plans for later and lock in tickets for up to 7 days. 
- Find the best value train tickets using our price calendar. 
Our partners: 
Across Europe and the UK, you can browse routes with
Eurostar (UK, France and the Netherlands)
Heathrow Express (UK)
Avanti West Coast (UK)
GWR (UK)
National Express (UK)
London Overground (UK)
SNCF (France)
TGV Lyria (France)
Thalys (France)
Trenitalia (Italy)
Italo (Italy)
Renfe (Spain)
Alsa (Spain)
Deutsche Bahn (Germany)
ÖBB (Austria)
SBB (Switzerland)
NS (the Netherlands)
SNCB (Belgium)
Flixbus and many, many more… 
No matter who you choose to rail with, we make buying European tickets a smooth experience while bringing you the best fares available for every fuss-free journey. But should you need it, our dedicated customer support team is on-hand (and on the phone) to help you navigate the railways of Europe. Just give us a call! 
So, download our FREE Trainline app and get access to everything you need to train across the UK and Europe like a pro. 
Visit our FAQs page to find out more: https://www.thetrainline.com/en/help/ 
Or, follow us on social: 
FB: thetrainlinecom 
TW: /thetrainline 
IG: @trainline 
*Promo Code offering 10% off (up to $20) available exclusively on the Trainline app for the purchase of train tickets to travel in Europe or between the UK and Europe (excluding booking fees). Offer valid for US customers based in the US, for their first in-app purchase, limited to 1091 discount codes and can be used once per customer. This offer is subject to availability and bookings must be made before 23:59 EST on 31 May 2026 paid in US Dollars (USD). Promo Codes cannot be used with any other Trainline offer and can only be applied once. This offer is subject to availability and will end on 8 March 2026. To see all conditions that apply to this Promo Code Offer, please refer to https://www.thetrainline.com/terms.

What is an eSIM?
An eSIM is a digital SIM card you buy online and install on your device — no plastic SIM needed. Your local SIM may stay active for calls and messages, while your Ohayu eSIM handles the travel data.

The Ohayu eSIM app offers a Global Plan for 120+ countries and data plans in over 170 destinations. Simply:
— Choose your travel destination or the Global Plan
— Buy a data plan that fits your trip
— Activate your eSIM
— Use your eSIM data while flying between countries, exploring new cities, or working remotely.
Key benefits:
— One eSIM for every trip: Global Plan for 120+ countries, 10 GB or Unlimited, billed monthly
— Quick activation: download your eSIM and connect shortly after purchase

— Flexible plans: options for short trips and longer stays
— Guided setup: step-by-step installation instructions in the app

Compatible devices:
Ohayu eSIM works with eSIM-compatible Apple devices:
iPhone XR, XS, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15

iPad models with eSIM support (2019+)

Thousands of travelers have already used Ohayu eSIM. Get yours before your next trip and stay connected.

bluejetty:00144752:ios.summary: Are you looking for a good quality coloring book app to help your little one learn how to use pencil and get familiar with pictures coloring? How about spending some quality time with your little kid while he or she completes one coloring s
bluejetty:00144752:ios.description:
Are you looking for a good quality coloring book app to help your little one learn how to use pencil and get familiar with pictures coloring? How about spending some quality time with your little kid while he or she completes one coloring sketch after another?
The new painting app is designed to introduce toddlers to art without restrictions. The app offers access to an exciting collection of sketches from different categories. Spend some quality time with your little one and help him get ready for the real school and learning days with this app. 
Fill the Colorbook Sketches
Choose a category that you like, pick a drawing and enter the main coloring screen. You can find cool sketches of a butterfly, a flower, a car, happy animals and many other objects to colorize. Help your toddlers in identifying objects while they color. The app is also useful for toddlers who have a hard time in staying within the lines as the app helps with staying within the boundaries.
Cool New Painting Tools
The app offers a cool collection of tools like color pencils, eraser, stamp pencils and magic pencil. If you want to reveal exactly what colors will go in what sketch, you can use the magic pencil and color the entire sketch to reveal its colorful form. 
Save Preschool Art Creations
When your toddler is done with this preschool drawing, you can save the painting within the app or you can take a screenshot and save the creation in your device. Find out more sketches every week and make the most of your free time with your little one!
How to play Small Games - Coloring Book
Download and launch the picture coloring book app 
Choose a sketchbook and pick an image to start coloring
Choose a coloring tool, tap and swipe on the screen to fill colors in lines
Take a screenshot of your final image and save it in your gallery
Happy coloring!
Features of Small Games - Coloring Book
Simple and easy coloring book app UI/UX
Tons of new coloring book sketches available for preschool art fun 
Beautiful and relaxing music 
Useful coloring app for toddlers who have a hard time staying in margins while coloring
Fill the color in flower, car, butterfly, animals and other images to have fun
Cool collection of art tools to fill color in picture
Use magic pencil to fill all the different colors in the picture with a few strokes
Exciting categories of coloring book objects available for learning and fun
Equally fun and amazing app for toddlers, their siblings and parents alike
Use eraser tool to remove any wrong strokes from the painting and redo it
Fill colors in different sketches of the color book and save it within the app
Option to take a screenshot of your final image and save it in your app
Weekly sketches added to the color book collection to keep things fresh and exciting
Are you ready to help your toddler learn preschool coloring without any restrictions by using a fun coloring app? If yes, the new small sketch color book app is the best option for you. Download and use Small Games - Coloring Book to start coloring today!

bluejetty:00035583:ios.name: PulsePro:heart&blood monitor
bluejetty:00035583:ios.summary: PulsePro helps you monitor your heart rate, record mental wellness information, and log blood pressure, blood sugar, and blood oxygen data. It also generates AI-powered wellness summaries and provides general lifestyle suggestions, includin
bluejetty:00035583:ios.description:
PulsePro helps you monitor your heart rate, record mental wellness information, and log blood pressure, blood sugar, and blood oxygen data. It also generates AI-powered wellness summaries and provides general lifestyle suggestions, including dietary guidance, to support overall well-being.
Here’s what makes PulsePro a helpful companion for your wellness journey:
Effortless Heart Rate Monitoring
Place your finger gently on your phone’s camera, and PulsePro will estimate and record your heart rate. The app provides quick feedback and trend tracking, making heart rate monitoring convenient and accessible.
AI-Generated Wellness Summary
PulsePro analyzes the data you record using AI technology and generates personalized wellness summaries. Based on your inputs, the app may offer general lifestyle suggestions and dietary guidance intended to support overall wellness.
Blood Pressure and Blood Sugar Tracking
PulsePro allows you to manually enter blood pressure and blood sugar readings. Your entries are displayed in easy-to-read charts to help you observe changes and better understand trends over time.
Health Data Analysis
PulsePro analyzes your recorded historical data, including heart rate trends and other logged metrics, to help you identify patterns and gain clearer insight into your personal wellness tracking.
Weekly Recipe Plan
PulsePro provides weekly recipe plans designed to support balanced nutrition, heart-friendly eating, and weight management goals. Additional meal planning options are available, and you can create personalized plans according to your preferences.
Health Reminders
Set reminders to log your data or complete routine wellness check-ins. Consistent tracking can help you stay organized with your wellness records.
Mental Wellness Questionnaire
Complete a short questionnaire, and PulsePro will analyze your responses using AI to provide general feedback and suggestions related to mental well-being.
Food Analysis Guide
Browse nutritional information for common foods and receive general dietary suggestions based on your preferences.
Activity Capability Assessment
PulsePro uses AI technology to analyze your recorded activity information and generate wellness-related insights to help you better understand your activity patterns.
Secure and Private
Protecting user data is a priority. PulsePro is designed to safeguard personal information and support a secure and private experience.
How to Measure Heart Rate
• Ensure your fingers are not too cold.
• Cover the camera lens and flash completely with your fingertip.
• Press gently — excessive pressure may affect the reading.
• Remain still during measurement.
Important Notice
PulsePro is intended for general wellness and lifestyle purposes only.
Heart rate is estimated using your device’s camera. Blood pressure, blood sugar, and blood oxygen values must be manually entered for tracking purposes.
PulsePro does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
Always consult a qualified healthcare professional regarding any health-related concerns.
PulsePro integrates with Apple Health (HealthKit) to sync and analyze selected data.
Subscription is required to access all features offered by the app.
By using this app, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:
Terms of Service:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Cps3-_GpShbn-4MfTyVj6_D4agzVpzNYVolmSqHqF4U/edit?usp=sharing
Privacy Policy:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1OHxbnhNvMtFCetiQFsTE5B1cRCjIcgFRhMtoi39cpH4U/edit?usp=sharing
Contact us: davidxie@xingyuantechnology.com
Experience the convenience of tracking your wellness with PulsePro — your companion for maintaining a healthy lifestyle.

bluejetty:00068665:ios.description:
SendPulse ChatBots is a mobile version of chats with subscribers from WhatsApp, Telegram, Facebook Messenger and Instagram chatbots that gives you the ability to control your bots.
The app helps you stay in touch with your subscribers, engage in chats after instant notifications, answer questions, and view or change subscriber information.
Respond to incoming messages
Chat with subscribers of any of your bots from one easy-to-use app. Receive notifications for each new message to instantly engage with new requests and respond quickly. You can include emoji in the message body to add color to your message.
View message history and subscriber information to use a personalized approach for each customer. Information syncs quickly across all devices.
View the number of unread messages and filter chats by status: all, open, closed.
Manage chatbot subscribers
Manage Subscriber Information - change variable values and assign tags as soon as you receive new data about your subscribers.
View detailed information about each subscriber: their status, subscription date and time, avatar, and variables and tags.
View statistics for all your bots: number of subscribers, the number of messages sent and received.

bluejetty:00146975:ios.description:
Galarm is a FREE social alarm clock app that enables you to create and share alarms and reminders with your contacts. It acts as your daily planner and enables you to manage your tasks efficiently.
Why you will love Galarm:
• ANY TIME, ANY DATE: Create alarms for any date and time and use Galarm as your mobile calendar.
• FLEXIBLE REPETITION: Set alarms to repeat hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly to efficiently manage your to do list. Create reminders for taking your medicine 3 times a day, your yoga class every day, paying your rent on the 1st of every month and other such repeating activities.
• PERSONAL ALARMS: Set reminders for yourself such as morning wake up alarm and medication reminder. Add participants to alarms that you normally miss. Participants can remind you of your tasks, if you miss them.
• GROUP ALARMS: Use a group alarm as an event planner for outings, parties, or any other social activity. The alarm goes off at the same time for all the participants, and they can confirm or decline, and chat with each other to coordinate.
• BUDDY ALARMS: Create alarms for someone else (“buddy”) to remind them of things they need to do. Buddy is reminded of the task at the time of the alarm. You are notified to remind the buddy in case they miss the alarm. You will also be notified once the buddy marks the alarm done.
• NOTIFICATIONS: All your notifications and alerts in one tab.
• ALARM HISTORY: See the previous responses for repeating alarms. This allows you to see how many times you missed that gym class or that important medication.
• ALARM CHAT: Each alarm has its own chat to keep the conversations private to that alarm.
• CUSTOM RINGTONES: You can use your own music as an alarm ringtone.
• RING ON VIBRATE: You can configure alarms to ring even if the phone is on vibrate.
• BLOCK A USER: Don't want to be bothered by a not-so-special someone? Galarm allows you to block a user, so you do not receive any alarms from them.
• ADAPTS TO YOUR TIMEZONE: Whether you are on the move or participants are in different time zones, the alarms follow time zone changes.
• INSTANT NOTIFICATIONS: You are notified of any Galarm activity such as chat messages, new participant alarms, or group changes instantly through remote notifications.
• FREE CLOUD STORAGE: All your alarms are stored on the cloud, so when you switch phones, your alarms appear instantly when you reinstall the app.
• WORKS OFFLINE: Create and edit alarms even if you are offline. Changes are synchronized as soon as you are online!
• NO USERNAMES, NO PASSWORDS: Why burden yourself with having to remember yet another username and password? Galarm works with your phone number, much like SMS, and integrates with your phone’s address book.

bluejetty:00156856:ios.description:
TackTack is the equestrian marketplace built for horse riders.
Buy and sell saddles, tack, riding apparel, boots, helmets, accessories, and more from riders, professionals, retailers, and equestrian businesses.
You can also list and discover horses for sale or lease — for free.
Whether you're looking for your next saddle, clearing out your tack room, shopping your favorite brands, or searching for your next horse, TackTack brings everything together in one dedicated equestrian marketplace.
BUY EQUESTRIAN GEAR
Discover thousands of new and pre-owned equestrian products.
Shop top brands including CWD, Voltaire Design, Butet, Devoucoux, Parlanti, Samshield, KASK, and more.
Search by category, brand, size, price, and other important details to find exactly what you're looking for.
Save your favorite items, follow sellers, message directly, and make offers from the app.
SELL YOUR TACK
Turn unused equestrian gear into cash.
Create a listing in minutes:
• Add a few photos
• Write a description
• Set your price
• Publish your listing
Manage messages, offers, orders, and sales directly from your phone.
Your earnings are transferred to your bank account after the transaction is completed.
SADDLE TRIALS
Buying a saddle online shouldn't feel like a gamble.
Eligible saddles can be offered with TackTack's saddle trial process, allowing buyers to try the saddle while the transaction stays protected through the platform.
BUY & SELL HORSES
Looking for your next horse?
Browse horses available for sale or lease and connect directly with sellers.
Selling or leasing a horse?
Create your horse listing on TackTack for free.
A MARKETPLACE MADE FOR EQUESTRIANS
TackTack is designed specifically for the equestrian community.
No endless Facebook groups. No general marketplace full of unrelated listings.
Just horses, tack, saddles, riding equipment, apparel, and the people who love them.
SHOP WITH CONFIDENCE
TackTack provides buyer and seller protection to help make transactions safer and more structured.
Our team is also here to help if you need support during a transaction.
WHAT RIDERS SAY
“Awesome experience. Much better than eBay or FB.”
“Sold my old saddle within weeks of posting. Customer service is fantastic.”
“My trainer told me about this website and I have sold so many things that I thought would never sell!”
“I recently purchased a Voltaire saddle and had the best experience.”
WHY RIDERS USE TACKTACK
• Buy and sell equestrian equipment
• Shop new and pre-owned products
• Discover thousands of saddles and tack items
• Message sellers directly
• Make and receive offers
• Follow favorite sellers and searches
• Try eligible saddles before committing
• List horses for sale or lease for free
• Access buyer and seller protection
• Get support from an equestrian-focused team
TackTack is making equestrian buying and selling simpler, safer, and more accessible.
Made by horse riders, for horse riders.

bluejetty:00017052:ios.description:
Rekhta is the world’s largest portal for Urdu poetry and literature. This app presents all Urdu ghazals, sher, nazms, rubai, qita, dohe, stories, etc. in three scripts - Urdu, Hindi, and Roman. You may easily find the meanings of any Urdu word in Hindi & English by just clicking on the word.
Don’t know where to start? A specially curated list of sher on various topics, subjects, and moods like Love shayari, Sad shayari, Motivational shayari, Romantic shayari, Dosti shayari, Ishq shayari, Dard shayari, Bewafa shayari, Mohabbat shayari, Feminist shayari, etc. are available for reading and sharing with your friends.
Rekhta has the complete collection of shayari of famous Urdu poets - Jaun Elia, Mirza Ghalib, Allama Iqbal, Ahmad Faraz, Faiz Ahmed Faiz, Sahir Ludhianvi, Rahat Indori, Parveen Shakir, Gulzar, Javed Akhtar, Tahzeeb Hafi, and others. You can explore shayari of progressive poets, women poets, as well as budding young poets.
The best of Urdu stories, articles, quotes, and letters of major Urdu authors and writers like Saadat Hasan Manto, Premchand, Krishan Chander, Ismat Chughtai, and others are also available in Urdu and Hindi.
Rekhta’s powerful search engine enables you to precisely look for any sher-o-shayari in English, Hindi, or Urdu script. Download the app to read and dive deep into the world of Urdu poetry and literature.
Existing app features:
· Read in any script you are comfortable with - Urdu, Hindi, or English
· Click on any difficult word to know its meaning in all three languages
· Lakhs of content of thousands of poets, authors, and artists
· Search and find everything related to Urdu poetry & prose at one place
· Switch between dark & light theme as per your reading comfort
· Share with your friends and family across WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, and X

bluejetty:00175231:ios.summary: "Anatomy Learning is an interactive 3D atlas of human anatomy for students of medicine, nursing, physiotherapy and dentistry. Over 6,000 labeled anatomical points on a real 3D model, and it works offline: study in class, at the hospital or
bluejetty:00175231:ios.description:
"Anatomy Learning is an interactive 3D atlas of human anatomy for students of medicine, nursing, physiotherapy and dentistry. Over 6,000 labeled anatomical points on a real 3D model, and it works offline: study in class, at the hospital or on your commute.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
- Full real-3D anatomical model, rotatable to any angle and zoomable down to the detail
- Over 6,000 labeled anatomical points
- Layer-by-layer dissection: remove each structure to reveal the one underneath
- Interactive muscle and joint animations
- Cross-sectional anatomy for radiology
- Over 500 labeled quizzes to test yourself
- Atlas structured by systems and by regions: head and neck, trunk, upper limb and lower limb
- Turn each anatomical system on and off independently
- Works without an internet connection
CONTENTS
- Bones, ligaments and joints
- Muscles
- Circulatory system: arteries, veins and heart
- Central and peripheral nervous system
- Sense organs
- Respiratory, digestive and urinary systems
- Male and female reproductive systems
LANGUAGES
Available in Spanish, English, Italian, French, German, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Chinese and Japanese."

bluejetty:00130610:ios.description:
Make Every Decision Fun! 
Tired of indecisiveness or boring choices? Turn decisions into excitement with Spin The Wheel – Raffle App! Whether you’re choosing what to eat, who goes first, or just adding fun to your day — spin your way to answers with style.
Perfect for games, giveaways, dares, team tasks, classroom fun, and more!
 Key Features:
* Create Unlimited Custom Wheels Add your own text, emojis, or numbers – perfect for any event or decision.
* Multiple Wheel Styles Choose from a variety of colorful themes and wheel designs.
* Sound & Confetti Effects Make every spin exciting with fun sound effects and confetti celebrations!
* Save & Reuse Wheels No need to recreate – save your favorite wheels and use them again and again.
* Instant Results Spin the wheel and get your answer in seconds. No bias, no delays!
Premium Features (Require Subscription):
Some features are available through an optional subscription:
Ad-Free Experience
Remove all ads for uninterrupted use.
Exclusive Wheel Designs
Unlock premium templates and styles.
Advanced Wheel Options
Create wheels with more segments and customization.
Priority Support
Get faster help from our support team.
Spin Wheel Pro Subscription Info : 
- Monthly Subcription - $9.99 with 3 day free trial
- Yearly Subcription - $49.99 with 3 day free trial
 Use Cases:
* Classroom fun & learning activities
* Random name or task picker
* Social media giveaways
* Truth or Dare games
* Workout selector
* Chore or duty assignments
* Icebreakers and parties 
 We know its always so hard to decide as to what to eat, a pizza or a burger? Should I choose truth or dare? Should I wear something in pink or black. These decisions are not easy, so we are here to help. 
We have some features which will allow you to make your own personal wheel, touch, or spin to decide, generate random numbers, flip a coin, built in trendy decision templates, different cool colour themes, weights for options, anything you want, just one click away.
Put anything you want on the wheel and make unique raffle pickers, random name pickers to draw names of price winners, create your own spinner games which are much more fun that just flipping a coin or make unlimited lucky wheels to help you answer such questions.
Use this wheel for anything whether it be a tiny decision or a big decision, we are here to help and have fun with you. 
Cheers!

Terms Of Use: - https://solitudecolorsllc.wordpress.com

bluejetty:00161402:ios.description:
The official app of Perisher. Make the most of your day at Australia’s Favourite ski resort. Connect with your friends on the slopes, track your ski days, view real-time lift and trail status.
REAL-TIME LIFT AND TRAIL STATUS
Know which trails are groomed, which lifts are open, and when they are scheduled to open all in real-time.
REAL-TIME WEATHER DATA
No more guessing how many layers you’ll need with real-time weather including minimum temperature, wind speeds and how much snow has fallen in the last 24 hours.
VIEW LIVE SNOW CAMS
Keep an eye on snowfalls and see real time mountain views with live cams from various locations around the resort.
FIND AND TRACK YOUR FRIENDS
Stay connected with friends by creating your own private group. See their current location in real-time on the resort map, what run or lift each person in your group is riding and the difficulty rating.
TRACK YOUR DAY AND SEASON
Keep track of all the details about your ski day and season. How many days skied, runs completed and vertical kilometres logged are all at the touch of a button. If you have an Apple Watch, record your runs as a workout and see your workout in the Health app.
LEADERBOARD
Compete for the top spot on the Perisher Leader board through days skied, lifts ridden, and vertical metres logged.
SHOP ONLINE
Buy early and save on lift tickets, lessons, rentals and more.
Created exclusively for Perisher by the Resorts Tapped LLC.
Note: Location and Logging services require a GPS-equipped device. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00161933:ios.description:
Darza's Dominion has been FULLY rebuilt from the ground up. If you played the original version, you'll be welcomed by: completely new artwork, redesigned environments, a fresh take on the UI, lots of new content, and new powerful weapons to wield!
Also, if your account was linked by email, you'll still have your characters and every piece of loot you stored waiting for you!
===========
We think it's important to disclose that, even though we plan on providing a consistent update cycle with the re-release of mobile, the last time Darza's was playable on mobile was December 2019. In that time we as developers have dropped the ball on releasing a follow-up(date), and we wanted that to be acknowledged up front before you as a player consider supporting us either monetarily or with your time.
===========
Darza's Dominion is a Co-Op Roguelite MMORPG Bullet-Hell Shooter with cross-play for Mobile and PC! Enter the Dominion and fight for your life taking on the role of 9 unique character classes and together with your companions use their abilities to traverse and conquer the lands controlled by an angry deity named Darza! Scattered around the Dominion are dangerous creatures in different biomes who want nothing more than to clear you out! Don't take this sitting down, or do! Play anywhere with your friends today and take back the Dominion!
What do you experience?
● Fast-paced gameplay
● Rare and exciting loot to stand out from your friends
● Unique character classes
● Multiple dungeons with unique mechanics
● Intense boss fights
● Dozens of players by your side at any time
● A vibrant player-based economy
● Daily challenges that give you free gold
See you in the Dominion!

bluejetty:00128515:ios.description:
Screen Mirroring for Roku is the easy mirror app to share your iPhone or iPad screen on your Roku Streaming Player, Roku Stick or Roku TV. It's the most advanced screen mirroring solution with zero delay and the highest screen quality.
Mirror photos, videos, games, websites, apps, presentations, documents and spreadsheets on Roku.

* No hidden subscriptions or costs
* Black screen issues: Some third party apps prevent screen mirroring. When you try to mirror them, you will just see a black screen on your TV, for example with Netflix and Disney+. This is a restriction chosen by Netflix and others, so we cannot fix it at the moment.

bluejetty:00087503:ios.summary:
Welcome to handwriting in the 21st century.
