The Ge
bluejetty:00087503:ios.description:
Welcome to handwriting in the 21st century. 
Compatibility: iPad Pro 12.9", iPad Pro 11", iPad Air 10.9" or iPad 10.2". Requires iOS 13.0 or later, and the use of Apple Pencil or similar paired stylus with palm-rejection features. 
The Getty-Dubay® Handwriting Success App brings the popular Getty-Dubay® handwriting program in eight workbooks to your tablet and stylus. Each ebook is a complete program that you can write in, with pages and pages of instruction and practice. You’ll be able to use the worksheets over and over by digitally erasing your previous sessions — practice to your heart's content. Free ebook samples come with the download. Full content is available via the in-app bookstore, with monthly and yearly subscription options, each with a free trial period.
All nine Getty-Dubay® handwriting ebooks are available via in-app purchase or subscription. Free samples allow you to try before you buy. There’s a responsive drawing engine, screen rotation for smaller tablets and pinch-zoom. 
The Getty-Dubay® Handwriting Success App is simple to use. Turn pages, scroll, navigate and create bookmarks in the same way you would with an ebook. 
The fun comes when you touch your stylus to the screen. Now you can select the color, width and opacity of your pen line. Trace and copy the handwriting models, reading the instructions and tips as you go. Redo your work and practice more by selecting the eraser icon, or by erasing the entire page at once.
Teachers and parents, with the Getty-Dubay® Italic Handwriting Series ebooks you can now incorporate technology into your handwriting instruction with seven age-appropriate workbooks (Books A-G) and an Instruction Manual. Books A through G are available on this app as one-year subscriptions. 
Adults and professionals, with the WRITE NOW ebook you can learn to use your stylus with confidence and ease to produce notes that you feel good about sharing, and that your colleagues & friends (and your handwriting recognition software) can read.
This is not your grandparent's handwriting. For over 40 years, the authors Barbara Getty and Inga Dubay have been teaching people — from medical professionals to school children — how to have legible, handsome handwriting without the loops and curlicues of conventional looped cursive. Getty-Dubay® Italic is already enjoyed by tens of thousands of adults and students worldwide.
It's real handwriting, for real life. 
The App content takes you step-by-step through the printed italic alphabet (lowercase and capitals) and numerals, then onto joining these letters for flowing, legible cursive italic writing. And the books walk the talk: All are handwritten by the authors.
Students can take a screenshot of their work to send to their teacher.
This App replaces the need for the paperback workbook, which means you're saving paper and the resources that would have gone into producing and shipping the product.
While you may experience improved handwriting after just a few sessions, most gains will come from repeated practice over time. As you use this app, try out your new handwriting on whiteboards, or with pen and paper for thank you notes, other correspondence or school work.
For help, and to access the free online resources that come with this app: www.handwritingsuccess.com/app-support
Privacy Policy: https://handwritingsuccess.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://handwritingsuccess.com/app-terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00077463:ios.description:
Feeltracker: 4.8 stars with 23K+ ratings • 800K+ downloads • 250K+ users/year • 5M+ saves/year • 96% satisfaction
Finally understand why you're not sleeping well—and fix it. Sleep Journal combines intelligent sleep tracking with AI chat, hands-free voice conversations, and on-device intelligence to identify what's disrupting your rest and build habits for better sleep. Whether you're battling insomnia, optimizing CPAP therapy, or want to wake up refreshed, get data-driven guidance to transform your nights.
COMPREHENSIVE SLEEP TRACKING:
• Log sleep sessions and naps with precise start/end times
• Track sleep quality, duration, and consistency patterns
• AI Dream Analysis with symbol interpretation and emotional insights
• CPAP therapy tracking with comprehensive AHI and mask fit analysis
• Calm Me Down for Sleep: AI-guided relaxation and breathing
• Record factors affecting sleep: caffeine, exercise, stress levels
• Multiple daily entries for shift workers and nappers
• Add notes and dream journals to track sleep quality
YOUR PRIVACY, GUARANTEED:
• No account required—start tracking sleep immediately
• Apple Intelligence (iOS 26+): run AI fully on-device, 100% offline and private
• Automatic iCloud sync keeps your data safe across devices
• Export sleep reports in PDF, CSV, Excel, or JSON formats
DESIGNED FOR BETTER SLEEP:
• Beautiful Liquid Glass design with sleep-friendly Dark Mode
• Quick-entry widgets for easy bedtime logging
• Smart reminders, 24-hour clock option, localized in-app FAQ
• Custom sleep schedule teaches the AI your natural rhythm
• Integration with Apple Health for complete wellness tracking
DISCOVER YOUR SLEEP PATTERNS:
• Detailed trends show sleep quality over weeks and months
• Interactive charts—tap any point to view detailed sessions instantly
• Weekly, monthly, and six-month averages for sleep specialists
• Identify factors disrupting your rest
• Generate professional reports for healthcare providers
AI-POWERED FEATURES:
• Voice Chat: hands-free two-way conversations with the AI
• Ask a Question: instant answers about your sleep data
• Chat: interactive conversations about your sleep health
• Voice Summary: audio summaries of your sleep trends
• Quick and Pro Dream Analysis with symbol interpretation
• CPAP Report: detailed analysis of your sleep therapy progress
• Pattern Detective: discover correlations affecting your sleep
• Goal Assistant: personalized sleep improvement goals
• Doctor Summary, Pro Health Report, Deep Research Report
• Song Recommendations: music matched to your sleep needs
• Personalized Quiz, Make Me Laugh, Sick Note
• Personalized greeting shares the meaning of your name
• Optional profile context (age, gender, sleep schedule, weather) for sharper insights
FREE WITH PRO OPTIONS:
• All core sleep tracking features completely free
• Pro unlocks Dream Analysis, CPAP Report, deep AI analysis, and Apple Intelligence mode
• Affordable pricing for your journey to better rest
IMPORTANT HEALTH DISCLAIMER:
This app is for personal tracking and informational purposes only. AI insights and recommendations do not constitute medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified sleep specialist before making health decisions. If you suspect a sleep disorder, seek professional medical evaluation.

bluejetty:00171762:ios.description:
Worried about your child's online safety? 
From cyberbullying and mental health concerns to inappropriate content, KidsGuard Pro is your ultimate parental control solution.
Designed for modern parents, KidsGuard Pro helps you remotely monitor activities, manage screen time, and ensure your child’s physical and digital well-being 24/7. Keep an eye on what matters most with the best cell phone tracker and activity manager.
-- HOTTEST FEATURES --
√ NEW | WhatsApp Voice Monitoring
 • Listen to WhatsApp voice messages to ensure safe interactions.
 • Detect inappropriate conversations and protect your child from potential digital risks.
【CALLS & MESSAGES MONITORING】
 • Stay informed by checking call logs and text messages.
 • Advanced keyword detection alerts you to potential dangers immediately.
 • Monitor integrated text and emoji content to filter out explicit or harmful material.
【LIVE SCREEN VIEWER】
 • Capture your child's screen in real-time or at set intervals.
 • See exactly which apps are being used and detect inappropriate content instantly.
【SMART SCREEN TIME CONTROL】
 • Build healthy digital habits by setting strict screen time limits.
 • Balance their daily routine and restrict usage during study or sleep hours.
【REAL-TIME LOCATION TRACKER】
 • GPS Tracking: Know your kid's exact whereabouts 24/7.
 • Geofence Alerts: Create safe zones (e.g., Home, School) and get instant notifications when they enter or leave.
【APP BLOCKER & ACTIVITY REPORT】
 • Block or restrict access to inappropriate games and social apps.
 • Receive a thorough daily report of device usage to understand their habits better.
【SOCIAL MEDIA MONITORING】
 • Cover all major platforms: TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, WeChat, LINE, Kik, and more.
 • View viewing history and track time spent on TikTok and YouTube.
 • Check exchanged media files, emojis, and chat history.
【SENSITIVE CONTENT DETECTION】
 • Set custom keywords (e.g., drugs, violence, anxiety).
 • Get immediate alerts when these words are typed or viewed.
WHY CHOOSE KIDSGUARD PRO?
We offer more than just monitoring; we offer peace of mind.
• Read Chats: Access WhatsApp, Snapchat, Discord, and more.
• Track Locations: View location history to see where they've been.
• Record Surroundings: Hear what's happening around the phone remotely.
• Search History: View all online search queries and keystrokes.
• Stealthy & Secure: The app works discreetly to keep you informed.
• Broad Compatibility: Supports most iPhone and iPad models seamlessly.
HOW TO GET STARTED
 Step 1-Install KidsGuard Pro on your device.

• All prices include applicable local taxes.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation.
• Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.

Terms of Use: https://www.useapp.net/ios/eula/

Woody Puzzle: Slide Out – Solve Puzzles & Explore the USA
Woody Puzzle: Slide Out is more than just a wood block puzzle – it's a journey! Slide wooden blocks to their correct color zones, clear the board, and unlock stunning pieces of a bigger picture. As you progress, each completed level reveals a beautiful scene from the USA, showcasing its breathtaking landscapes, rich culture, and famous landmarks.
How to Play
- Woody Puzzle: Slide Out across the board to the correct color zone.
- Use slide puzzle solver strategies to clear wood blocks
- Think ahead to avoid getting stuck and use power-ups when needed.
- Complete each level before time runs out to unlock new challenges.
- Unlock hidden images after each level and complete the full picture
- Discover the beauty of American scenery, landmarks, and culture
Key Features
- Hundreds of engaging levels – From simple toyblocks puzzles to complex challenges.
- Realistic wooden block mechanics – A smooth and satisfying slider puzzle solver experience.
- Brain-boosting gameplay – A perfect mix of block puzzle wood, problem-solving, and strategy.
- Challenging obstacles & power-ups – Plan your moves wisely with the help of boosters.
- Vibrant color design – A mix of colorblocks and IQ block puzzles for a visually stunning experience.
Train Your Brain & Master the Puzzle!
With its simple yet deep gameplay, Woody Puzzle: Slide Out offers the best block puzzle to sharpen your mind and improve your logic skills. Whether you're a fan of block wood games or just looking for a relaxing wood block puzzles experience, this game has something for everyone.

Quite literally! This challenging physics game will keep you occupied for hours as you try to solve what should be a very simple puzzle: all you need to do is unscrew the pieces in the right order, causing all of them to drop to the bottom. What seems easy will soon become quite the brain workout as you try to twist your way to success, one screw and one piece at a time.
TIGHTEN THE SCREWS
This brain game is perfect for when you want to both de-stress a little bit, and also give your mind something useful to focus on – this isn’t a mindless puzzle game, we promise that by the end of your session you’ll have gotten a real brain workout in! With no timer, cheerfully colorful graphics, and tons of levels, the game is guaranteed to be fun for all. Get started by unscrewing pieces in the right order and matching screw colors, and you’ll be flying through levels like a pro in no time flat.
FEATURES:
Brain training – This puzzle solving game is really quite easy in theory, but as more and more pieces are added to the puzzle, unlocking all them in just the right order will become increasingly difficult. Thankfully there are tons of fun boosters that you can use when the going gets tough, but you also can stop and come back whenever you want to keep trying out different ideas. With dozens of levels varying from easy to extra super hard, you’ll always have something to test out your creativity and logic skills.
Stress-free fun – Riddles are inherently stressful to some, but thankfully we’ve done everything possible to make this one super relaxed! With no timer or penalties you can take as long as you need to figure this brain game out, so no need to rush or sweat. There also aren’t any crazy rules or hoops to jump through, just nice, straightforward controls so you can get down to puzzle solving immediately.
Bright graphics – In keeping with the stress-free nature of this logic puzzle, the graphics are bright and cheerful to make you feel as chill as possible. The perfect game for when you’ve got 5 or 50 minutes to kill, you’ll always feel better after playing.
POP, LOCK, AND UNSCREW IT
Unblock your mind and let your creativity and thinking skills run free as you try out this fun and challenging puzzle game! Unscrew pieces to solve tricky puzzles and match screw colors to complete stages, all while watching your stress slip away thanks to the untimed game play and chill graphics. Download Screw Stars today to get to brain training and relaxing like never before!

bluejetty:00157703:ios.summary: Want more peace, clarity, and mindfulness in your daily life? Spiritual wellness is your answer. Skylight is a one-of-a-kind app to help you develop everyday spiritual health. Like mental health, physical health, and emotional wellness, we
bluejetty:00157703:ios.description:
Want more peace, clarity, and mindfulness in your daily life? Spiritual wellness is your answer. Skylight is a one-of-a-kind app to help you develop everyday spiritual health. Like mental health, physical health, and emotional wellness, we need to consistently nurture our souls just like we would our mind and body. Start your spiritual awakening today by trying exercises that improve your overall spiritual health.
HOW DOES SKYLIGHT WORK?
With the Skylight app, you have instant access to daily spiritual wellness with short, simple exercises that generate deep love, strength, and healing.
These spiritual exercises are activities that can be done virtually anywhere, with no prior spiritual training or commitment to a particular religion or belief system. 
Skylight offers a variety of experiences to fit your needs. Perhaps you feel lonely, need a simple daily prayer, or are just looking for the peacefulness that comes through receiving daily grace. Whatever your circumstances may be, Skylight has something for you.
HOW WILL SKYLIGHT HELP ME?
Deepest of all—beneath your physical and mental selves, is your spiritual self. Like your body and mind, it can feel, it can hurt, it can heal, and experience wellness. Yes, its feelings are often subtle, but they’re also deep and foundational. Researchers are just beginning to uncover what many have known for centuries: that spiritual health affects other parts of our wellbeing.
The latest studies show that people who regularly care for their spirituality experience: 
- Decreased anxiety and depression
- Increased resilience
- A heightened sense of purpose
- An expanded perspective
- A more profound feeling of love for the world around you
With just a few minutes a day in the Skylight app, you’ll discover how to connect with yourself, with others, and with God. This is the spiritual app to help take your overall wellness to the next level!
In addition to our app be sure to follow our other channels:
WEB:
https://www.skylight.org
YOUTUBE:
https://www.youtube.com/c/OKwellness
INSTAGRAM:
https://www.instagram.com/skylight.app/
Terms and Conditions found at https://www.skylight.org/terms-conditions/

Daily AI soccer tips, live scores and real-time match stats - all in one app.
Scouter turns soccer data into clear match predictions. Every day, our AI models analyze form, head-to-head records, xG, lineups and market movement across 1,000+ leagues to give you soccer predictions with a confidence score — so you always know which tips are the strongest.
WHY FANS CHOOSE SCOUTER
AI Soccer Predictions & Daily Tips
• Daily soccer tips for match winner, over/under goals, both teams to score and first-half markets
• Confidence score on every prediction, sorted from safest to riskiest
• Accuracy tracked openly inside the app — see how the AI performed yesterday, last week and last month
• Free soccer tips every day, plus VIP tips for the biggest matches
Scouter Oracle – Live AI Verdicts
The Oracle re-reads every match live. At half-time it delivers a verdict on your pre-match tip: HOLD, HEDGE, SWITCH or STAY OUT — based on live xG, pressure and momentum.
Scouter Edge – Pre-Match Signals
Ranked facts for every fixture: scoring windows, top threats, recent form streaks, goal timing, cards and corners trends, head-to-head patterns and live pace vs league average.
Live xG, Momentum & Advanced Stats
• Live expected goals (xG) and xG on target
• Match Momentum pressure index, minute by minute
• Possession, shots, dangerous attacks, passes, saves and more
• Full team and player statistics, lineups and league tables
Live Scores & Instant Notifications
• Live soccer scores from 1,000+ leagues and cups worldwide
• Goal, red card, kick-off and full-time alerts for your favorite teams and matches
• Starting lineups, substitutions and match events in real time
Prediction Builder
Combine AI picks into one prediction slip in seconds. Choose your risk level and let the AI screen thousands of predictions to build the highest-probability combination for today's matches.
Market Movement Tracker
Compare prices from multiple providers and follow how the market has moved since it opened — sharp, strong and notable moves highlighted next to the AI prediction.
Worldwide Soccer Coverage
MLS, Premier League, UEFA Champions League, Liga MX, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Copa Libertadores, CONCACAF Champions Cup, World Cup and 1,000+ more competitions. Follow Inter Miami, LA Galaxy, LAFC, Real Madrid, Barcelona, Manchester City, Liverpool and every club you love.
Made for You

Unlock all AI VIP tips, Scouter Oracle live verdicts, Scouter Edge, Prediction Builder and premium insights. 3-day free trial on every plan, cancel anytime.
Trusted by soccer fans in 150+ countries.

bluejetty:00148904:ios.description:
WaterH: Hydration redefined.
Welcome to the new era of hydration with WaterH 3.0, where advanced technology meets elegant design. Our latest update brings you an array of UI/UX enhancements and performance improvements, all crafted based on valuable customer feedback.
What's new in WaterH 3.0:
Enhanced user interface: Enjoy a smoother, more intuitive user experience with our redesigned app interface that makes navigating your hydration data easier than ever.
Performance boosts: Experience faster load times and more reliable app performance, ensuring your hydration tracking is as seamless as your drinking routine.
Updated customization options: Tailor your hydration reminders and goals with even more personalized settings to suit your unique lifestyle.
Key features of WaterH:
360 LED glow reminder: Never miss a sip with our visual reminder. Customize the reminder frequency directly within the WaterH app.
Personalized hydration goals: Based on your age, height, weight, sex, and activity level, the WaterH app provides daily personalized hydration targets to keep you optimally hydrated.
Auto hydration tracking: Our smart bottle's sensors automatically monitor your water intake, letting the app do the tracking so you can focus on your day.
Comprehensive history & reports: Track your hydration trends with daily, weekly, and monthly reports. Understand your habits and see your improvements over time with easy-to-export data.
Apple Health integration: Sync with Apple Health to align your activity levels with your hydration needs for precise goal setting.
Smart scan water quality sensor: Equipped with a TDS sensor, WaterH ensures you’re always aware of your water quality, directly via the app.
Optimized for everyone: Whether paired with a WaterH Smart Water Bottle or used standalone for manual tracking, the WaterH app remains completely ad-free and is designed to support everyone's hydration needs.
We are always working hard to build new features into our app so you can enjoy a more enriching WaterH experience.
Elevate your hydration experience with WaterH 3.0 and turn every sip into a step towards better health. Visit us at www.waterh.com to discover more.

bluejetty:00079824:ios.description:
When pain, stress, or sleep disruption won’t let you live your life, your mind may be the most powerful tool you haven’t tried yet. Most users feel meaningful relief in their first 10-minute session. No drugs. No side effects. Try it free for 7 days.
Reveri delivers guided, interactive sessions with Stanford’s Dr. David Spiegel, grounded in 50+ years of research and clinical experience, that help your mind directly change how your body feels. Dr. Spiegel asks what you need. The experience adapts to you in real time. Close your eyes, answer a few questions, and let your mind calm your body. This is clinical self-hypnosis, not the stage trick. The real thing, built on five decades of science. You don’t need to believe in it for it to work.
THE NUMBERS
(Two sources: peer-reviewed study for stress stat; internal user data for pain and sleep stats)
In a peer-reviewed study of over 84,000 Reveri users:
• 84% felt less stress and anxiety after one session
Based on data from hundreds of thousands of Reveri users:
• 77% felt less pain after a single session
• 90% felt more rested after their first sleep session
• 4.6 stars across thousands of reviews
Reveri was built for people who feel like they’ve tried everything. Most of them felt something different in their very first session.
THE PERSON BEHIND EVERY SESSION
Dr. David Spiegel has spent 50 years researching how the mind changes what the body feels. As co-founder of Reveri and Associate Chair of Psychiatry at Stanford School of Medicine, he has authored more than 400 research papers and helped thousands of patients find relief that other methods couldn’t deliver. When you use Reveri, you hear his voice. He is not a figurehead. He is the session.
USE REVERI TO:
• Relieve chronic pain: in minutes, without drugs
• Reduce stress and anxiety after a single session
• Fall asleep faster and stay asleep through the night
• Sharpen focus and mental clarity
• Break habits: smoking, vaping, overeating, and more
WHAT A SESSION LOOKS LIKE
• Dr. Spiegel asks what you need, you answer
• The session adapts to your responses in real time
• Eyes closed, 10 minutes, guided from start to finish

bluejetty:00029821:ios.description:
Big Picture Skiing is the online platform for skiers who want to genuinely understand how to improve — not just get vague tips.

bluejetty:00099528:ios.description:
You just blow your mind to tap, swipe or hold the finger on top of a series of tiles at the appropriate time, matching the beat or sound effects happening in the song. Let’s try and become a master!
GAME OVERVIEW
- SuperStar’s gameplay will feel familiar to anyone that has played rhythm games before.
- The mastery layer of the game is entirely based on dexterity. Improving reflexes and muscle memory, mastering the song patterns and timings, and learning appropriate finger techniques to get a bit more score.
- Each track completed in the game generates a score that is rated from one to five stars. When the player achieves the maximum star rating, silver, gold and diamond medals appear. The best scores in songs guarantee new tracks for your repertoire.
HOW TO HIT ALL TILES ON "PERFECT+"
- “Perfect+” occurs when the player plays the tile exactly at the moment the beat overlaps the perfect zone on the screen. 
- If you are a little early or late, the grade is just recorded as perfect. Even if the multiplier continues through a streak of perfect beats, without “Perfect+” on every note, the diamond medal won’t be yours.
FUN & CHALLENGING GAME
“It’s not that easy playing this game. I love the challenge every time.”
“Love this game. I’m competitive and this game feeds the soul.”
“Entertaining and challenging. Definitely holds my attention for a while! Love it”
We hope you will enjoy SuperStar when play great international music hits with the touch of your fingers.

bluejetty:00094219:android.summary: We want to be the best racer. We are eager to get out and conquer the highway with our motorcycle roaring. We make this motorcycle racing games for all of you players who love bike race and driving games. Street moto: Speed Race is a gorgeo
bluejetty:00094219:android.description:
We want to be the best racer. We are eager to get out and conquer the highway with our motorcycle roaring. We make this motorcycle racing games for all of you players who love bike race and driving games. Street moto: Speed Race is a gorgeous motorcycle racing game and motorbike game. Jump in the extreme driving and race on the streets and highways anytime and anywhere. Break through the traffic jam and become a skillful rider from the scratch. 
VARIOUS MODES
There are many modes you can chose from. Be the first rider reaching the finish lines or reach finish line before time runs out. Shift your engine into extreme driving and eliminate the other behind rider. You can even drive whatever motorcycle you like to race and jump into the free mode, where you can complete missions and claim your rewards. You can also drift on the street for bonus. Various modes make this racing 3d a fun game.
SHOW YOUR STYLE
As you play these driving games, you will receive plenty of rewards including coins. You can use coins to make the cool motorbikes yours. Expand your collections and appreciate them from all angles. Upgrade your motorcycle for extreme driving or for handling. You can even make a drift and cross through the traffic. Once you buy the motorcycle from the showroom, you have the access to modify it in your ways with different spray paint, wheel hub and sticker. Trick out as you wish in bike racing games and show your personality as a rider.
MUTIPLE CHARACTERS, DIFFERENT SKILLS
Many characters are on sale in character store. Each one has its own exquisite portrait and equipped with different skills that have some positive effects for bike racing. Chose your character mostly matching your driving style and maximize the rewards you can claim in the motorcycle racing games.
SENSE THE SPEED WITH YOUR HANDS AND EARS
We are trying our best to provide racer with the most immense experience. Therefore, we have added different control to play. Tweak your motorcycle with joystick to race or just tilt the phone as handling a real steering wheel. Pick up the control method that suits you best. Also, you can hear the real sound of moto engine when you run in the racing 3d. 
STUNNING LANDSCAPE, FEAST TO THE EYES
Form villages to cities, form plain to mountains, from desert to oasis. As you advance the storyline, roads will run through different are with distinguishable scene. There are no two racing tracks that are the same in this driving game. Developed by Unity, every map is the best playground for bike race and meanwhile enjoy the view. Now it is the time to be the bike racer in bike racing games and enjoy yourself with one tiny phone in the palms of your hands.
Remember, even this is a bike game for free we are always keep working to polish the game. we are always stay with the players and willing to read your feedbacks. It’s you that help us make our motorbike game better. We’d appreciate it if you can report any issue in the game or provide your advices to us.

bluejetty:00061174:ios.summary:

- better reading, writing, listening, and communicative skills through
bluejetty:00061174:ios.description:
Welcome to BOOKR Class, an award-winning library of curated animated books and interactive games for young English learners from 4 to 14 years old.
Why use BOOKR Class?
- better reading, writing, listening, and communicative skills through the narrated literary classics, modern stories, and songs
- develop 21st-century skills: the stories introduce new cultures, raise awareness and develop creativity, critical thinking, and social-emotional skills.
- helps to practice English spelling, grammar, and pronunciation through educational games, exercises, and quizzes
- provides a safe, ad-free environment with thoroughly researched content by educators, children's literature experts, and psychologists
We recommend downloading the app if you are
- parent: your children can have a guilt-free fun time reading and playing with the app while learning English
- English teacher: we offer a practical and easy-to-use tool for in-class, after-school, and distance learning solutions for K8 English classes and language schools.
How does BOOKR Class enhance stories to improve language skills?
- our illustrations make the characters come alive, thus laying the foundations for contextual, organic learning
- animation and zooming catch the eye of the reader and develop comprehension skills without drawing too much attention away from the linguistic features
- narration by professional voice-over artists facilitates the improvement of oral language comprehension skills and pronunciation
- text highlighting helps the reader follow along at the same pace as the narrator
- with educational games that are fun to play, created by teachers with a light-hearted layout and encouraging feedback to motivate learners
Is there more to come?
Yes, BOOKR Class is an ever-growing library. As a result, we regularly add new English books and games to each of the six proficiency levels.
Can we read the books offline?
The application requires a stable internet connection to sign in to BOOKR Class and start downloading books. However, as long as the subscription is valid, the downloaded stories are also available offline.
Read, play and learn English with BOOKR Class!

bluejetty:00114204:ios.name: Screw World 3D - Bolt Puzzle
bluejetty:00114204:ios.summary:
► TO SCREW OR UNSCREW?
That is the question! In this exciting 3D puzzle game, your job is to carefully unscrew pieces from an object, and put the colorful bolts in the corresponding box. Easy in theory, but tricky to actually do when you n
bluejetty:00114204:ios.description:
► TO SCREW OR UNSCREW?
That is the question! In this exciting 3D puzzle game, your job is to carefully unscrew pieces from an object, and put the colorful bolts in the corresponding box. Easy in theory, but tricky to actually do when you need to figure out which order to remove the screws in so as to access all of the pieces. Colorful and interesting, these puzzles are also relaxing as you can calmly and strategically spin them around to find the exact right piece that you want to unscrew.
► RIVETING FUN
Each level consists of a fun puzzle head together with tons of colorful screws, and your job is to unscrew the pieces and sort the colored bolts. It might seem easy at first, but you’ll need to pay attention to what color and which screw you’re going for, otherwise you’ll end up stuck! Thanks to the 3D puzzle though you can spin the piece around and around to find the perfect screw to keep the game going. In addition to regular levels, look forward to events and special offers that will keep the fun flowing!
You’ll love:
● Colorful play – Levels feature brightly colored 3D puzzles that are held together by equally bright screws and nuts. In addition to the riot of color, fans of ASMR will love the sound and haptic effects, although these can be turned off if you want ultimate concentration.
● Improved logic skills – Games can be both fun and educational, and Screw World is the perfect example of this. While you’re having fun unscrewing parts and sorting pieces, you’re also working on your logic skills as you figure out what order to remove everything in and how best to use your boosters for the ultimate advantage.
● Relaxing levels – No timer means no need to rush your choices in this puzzle. Take your time and make use of the 3D aspect to spin the piece around as much as you want. You can also preview what bolts are hidden under pieces, allowing you to make the smartest moves.
● Extra fun incoming – In addition to the standard levels you can explore, events and competitions will help you hone your skills as you battle against other players to see who can finish the most levels. This would be a great time to break out your stock of boosters to make sure you come in number one!
► NUTS AND BOLTS AND SCREWS, OH MY!
Unscrew bolts from pieces and watch them drop away, one by one, as you fly through levels and watch your stress melt away in this exciting 3D puzzle game that is perfect for all ages! Boosters, events, and more keep things extra exciting, but even the regular levels are sure to please thanks to their straightforward design and clean dynamics.

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

apple-macos:6760272116.name: Finance Flow
apple-macos:6760272116.description:
Finance Flow reúne suas contas, sua carteira de investimentos e seus impostos
em um app nativo para iPhone, iPad, Mac e Apple Watch.
Seus dados ficam no seu aparelho. Não temos servidores, não coletamos nada e
não há rastreamento de nenhum tipo.
CONTABILIDADE DE VERDADE, SEM COMPLICAÇÃO
• Partidas dobradas por baixo; na tela, só de onde saiu e para onde foi
• Livros separados para a vida pessoal e para a empresa
• Contas em até três níveis, com saldo somado automaticamente
• Conciliação mensal contra o extrato, que trava o período conferido
• Metas de gasto por categoria, com o progresso no painel
• Lançamentos recorrentes que se renovam sozinhos
• Anexe comprovantes e notas a qualquer lançamento
• Várias moedas, com conversão pela PTAX do Banco Central
SUA CARTEIRA INTEIRA
• Ações, FIIs, ETFs, BDRs e ativos no exterior
• Preço médio calculado pela regra brasileira, com todas as taxas no custo
• Renda fixa com oito indexadores, projeção diária e conciliação
• Previdência PGBL e VGBL, com o regime tributário correto
• Criptoativos, com staking, mineração e airdrops
• Opções da B3 e opções flexíveis de balcão, do início ao vencimento
• Proventos anunciados pela B3 chegam como sugestão, já preenchidos
• TWR e IRR lado a lado, comparados com CDI, Ibovespa, S&P 500, dólar e ouro
• Sharpe, Sortino, beta, drawdown máximo e VaR 95%, com a renda fixa na conta
• Simulador que mostra se vale resgatar um título antes do vencimento
• Perfis de alocação, metas de patrimônio e lista de acompanhamento
IMPOSTOS APURADOS ENQUANTO VOCÊ REGISTRA
• Apuração mensal por modalidade, com as isenções previstas em lei
• Prejuízo acumulado controlado por modalidade, com o prazo de cinco anos
• Carnê-leão com a tabela progressiva vigente e resultado por imóvel
• Bens e direitos da declaração anual organizados em doze grupos
• Conferência automática contra os informes de rendimento
• Tratamento separado para regime transparente e opaco no exterior
• Documento em PDF com todos os campos e atalho para o Sicalc
O app calcula e organiza. Não recolhe imposto nem substitui contador: a guia é
emitida no site da Receita Federal, e a conferência final é sua e dele.
IMPORTAÇÃO QUE POUPA A NOITE
• Notas de corretagem no padrão SINACOR e notas de opções de balcão
• Extratos de onze bancos, além de OFX e modelos que você cria
• Comprovantes por foto ou PDF, lidos pelo Apple Intelligence
• Detecção de lançamentos repetidos e categorização sugerida
• Compartilhe um PDF de qualquer app direto para o Finance Flow
• Automatize com os Atalhos da Apple, sem precisar abrir o app
• Traga seu histórico de outros programas de finanças por CSV
DEZESSEIS RELATÓRIOS
DRE, balanço patrimonial, balancete, razão de contas, fluxo de caixa,
orçamentos, saúde financeira, resultado por bem, performance, análise de risco,
alocação, composição da carteira, simulador de renda fixa, apuração de imposto,
carnê-leão e conferência da declaração.
Exportação em PDF, CSV e Markdown, com os gráficos e os anexos das transações.
FEITO PARA CADA APARELHO
• iPhone com widget e leitor de comprovantes
• iPad com layout de duas colunas e teclado externo
• Mac nativo, com mais de cinquenta atalhos e janelas separadas
• Siri, Atalhos e busca do sistema, em português e inglês
PRIVACIDADE POR ARQUITETURA
• Nenhum servidor nosso: não há para onde seus dados irem
• Sincronização opcional pela sua conta do iCloud
• Inteligência artificial processada no próprio aparelho
• Face ID ou Touch ID, com código de acesso como alternativa
• Bloqueio de Segurança por rede Wi-Fi ou local de confiança
• Backup completo
Assinatura com renovação automática pela App Store. Sem assinatura ativa, o app
fica em modo visualização: você continua consultando e exportando tudo.
Política de Privacidade: https://financeflow.money/politica-privacidade
Termos de Uso (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Suporte: https://financeflow.money/suporte

apple-itunes:654810212.name: Freeletics: Workouts & Fitness
apple-itunes:654810212.description:
Europe's #1 fitness app lets you work out anytime, anywhere with the most advanced digital personal trainer – no gym required. Whatever your fitness level, build healthy habits and achieve your goals faster than ever with a personalized fitness plan tailored to you. Add cardio workouts, weights, gym machines, mix in some running intervals, or keep it classic Freeletics with bodyweight HIIT or calisthenics-style workouts at home. Every training plan features fully personalized workouts, complete with warm-ups, cooldowns, mobility, and recovery workouts, all designed to help you recover faster and achieve your goals quicker.
WHY FREELETICS?
- Freeletics means freedom to work out where you want, when you want – on your terms. Join a community of 60 million athletes training together to stay motivated and on track.
- Develop strength, endurance, and flexibility with a fully holistic approach to fitness that helps you become a well-rounded athlete.
- Your AI Coach customizes each workout to your fitness level, adjusting in real time based on your feedback to create a perfect workout every time. No two people get the same workout plan – it's fully personalized fitness.
- Whether you want to build a six-pack, gain muscle, or lose weight, you’ll get a training plan with workouts to fit your needs.
- Easily customize your workouts in seconds to match your setup for home workouts, gym sessions, or wherever you are to stay on track, support consistency, and see long-term results.
The free version of the app contains 34 HIIT bodyweight workouts, 100+ exercises, and a community of millions. If you want to set yourself up for long-term success with the guidance of an expert personal trainer every step of the way, you can use the Freeletics Coach with a 14-day money-back guarantee.
What you get by upgrading to the Freeletics Coach:
TRAINING
- Your AI personal trainer in your pocket creates every workout based on your goals, fitness level, training preferences, and more.
- Travelling or short on time? Want to switch to an upper-body workout instead? No problem. Your digital personal trainer instantly adjusts your workout to match your needs.
- Your personalized workout plan is part of a "Training Journey." Choose from 30 fitness plans in the app, each with a different fitness focus.
- Pick your workout style. From cardio like running, cycling, and rowing, to classic Freeletics bodyweight HIIT workouts, calisthenics, weighted exercises, or gym machines – there’s a training plan for you.
- With 1 trillion workout combinations, 700+ exercises, hundreds of workouts on demand, and even a tool to create your own workout routines, you’ll always find the perfect workout for you.
- Control your workout from your Apple Watch and track your fitness data in the Apple Health app.
- Track your fitness progress, performance, and achievements using badges, streaks, and skill progressions designed to help you improve.
The Training Coach is included in the Training and Training & Nutrition Bundle.
SUBSCRIPTIONS & TERMS
We offer 6 auto-renewing subscription options:
• Training (3 / 6 / 12 months)
• Training & Nutrition (3 / 6 / 12 months)
The Nutrition Coach is part of the separate Freeletics Nutrition app.
Your subscription automatically renews if not cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You will be charged for the next subscription period up to 24 hours before the current subscription expires. Manage your subscription and disable automatic renewal anytime in your Apple account settings. You have the right to withdraw from your initial subscription within 14 days. By purchasing, you accept our Terms of Use (https://www.freeletics.com/en/pages/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.freeletics.com/en/pages/privacy).
Contact us at https://help.freeletics.com/hc/ or follow @Freeletics on social media for daily workout inspiration. Your personal trainer is ready.

apple-macos:6824305455.name: Artfluvia: Art History Map
apple-macos:6824305455.description:
All of art history on one map. Forty thousand years in a single picture, from the Chauvet cave to today, from Japan to Peru. Thirty cultural streams flow side by side through time, and about 1,700 works, artists and movements stand exactly where they were born. Every day brings a new artwork with its picture and story, and there is a quiz for the whole family. The same kind of map shows music, literature, and science and technology.
ARTWORK OF THE DAY
A new work every day at midnight, with its picture and story. “Show on the map” takes you to its place in time, next to everything made elsewhere in the same years. Also as a widget, in StandBy and in the Apple TV Top Shelf.
FAMILY QUIZ AND CLASS MODE
Up to six players on one device, three levels, twelve question types, including the picture questions “Name the picture” and “Which picture?”, plus “What is it?”. Categories: All Arts, Visual Art, Music, Literature, and Science & Technology. In class mode, the teacher starts the quiz and students answer on their own devices, no account needed. Five rounds are free; “Artfluvia Games” removes the limit (in class mode, only the teacher needs it).
SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
The fifth map, free like art, music and literature: about 1,000 discoveries and inventions, from the Ishango bone to CRISPR gene editing. 14 streams by field or 19 by region, and you can switch. Ten tours, such as “From Counting to Computers”.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Choose time span, genre and level of detail, zoom along time
• 14 editions, Lifespans, time travel on the river and world maps
• “Today on view” with museum and city; plan a day there with Weekend Pilot
• Images for more than 2,800 entries, each with a checked license and credit
• My Collection with the “My Museum” sticker album; search; share works
• 36 tours, such as “Blue”, “Japan Meets Europe” or “Christmas in Art”; galleries of key works for 104 artists
MUSIC AND LITERATURE
Music: 20 streams from Vienna to West Africa, about 1,400 works, composers, styles and instruments; on many work cards, a 30-second preview (Apple Music).
Literature: 20 streams from Gilgamesh to today, about 1,500 works, authors and movements. For public-domain works: opening lines from old editions and short readings from LibriVox.
“All Arts” puts art, music and literature on one map with 16 shared regions.
FREE FOR EVERYONE
All five maps, the Artwork of the Day and its widget, tours, previews and readings.
ARTFLUVIA KIDS
A kids mode for ages 6 to 12, two age bands, four games and an Explorer map. New rounds every day, read-aloud; a parental gate before any purchase, no ads, no links. Five rounds are free here too.
THREE ONE-TIME PURCHASES
Artfluvia Export: all formats without a watermark (images up to 4K, A3 and A2 at 300 dpi, posters 30 × 91 and 41 × 122 cm, vector PDFs), plus the screen saver: on Apple TV, iPad and Mac, Artfluvia drifts through time and spotlights your favorite works. Preview every format with a watermark first.
Artfluvia Games: the family quiz and the kids’ games without limits.
Artfluvia Complete: both together.
PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your favorites stay on your device and in your own iCloud. Larger images and readings load on demand from Wikimedia Commons, the museums, LibriVox and archive.org. One download for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV; purchases and favorites follow you across devices.
WHY ARTFLUVIA EXISTS
At home, the map hangs on our wall as a poster. The newest entries are at the very bottom, and I had to bend down every time. So I built the app, in Vienna, with the help of AI, curated by people. Stream widths are reading aids, not measurements.
One request: if you spot a mistake or a gap, tell me via the support page. And if you like Artfluvia, please leave a rating. Without ratings, hardly anyone finds the app.
